dossier.claim: The English sometimes gives a different proposition from the one constrained by the Japanese: a negation is reversed, an attraction becomes a judgment of reality, or a different action or participant takes its place.
dossier.sourcePattern: The cited Japanese distinguishes good from bad losing, awareness of a woman from awareness of her reality, running from fighting, taking someone away from being taken away, and changing an existing mark from receiving one at summoning.
dossier.englishEffect: Rin and Ayako become sore losers, Taiga’s male-friend preference joke points the other way, and Illya becomes the person Sakura takes away. Saber’s ordinary clothing makes her seem real rather than making Shirou conscious of her as a woman. Other cases change a technical dependency or replace a visible religious symbol with apparent devotion.
dossier.limits: Different wording is not sufficient. A contextual paraphrase, intelligible metaphor, or an inference already supplied by the scene may be defensible. These examples require an identifiable changed proposition; they do not establish that every departure from Japanese sentence structure is wrong. The direct confession and correctly grounded perceptions remain counterexamples.
dossier.diagnostic: 1,582 findings in this category; 8 cited passages.

findings.explanation: A firm utterance becomes an obligation to do everything possible.

contexts.japanese: きっぱりと言う
contexts.english: I have to do everything I can.

findings.description: A coincidence excuse becomes a denial of presence.
findings.sourceReading: たまたまそこにいた concedes being in the woods but explains it as coincidental, insufficient to prove involvement.
findings.explanation: A coincidence excuse becomes a denial of presence.

contexts.japanese: たまたまそこにいたと言われたら
contexts.english: if he just says he wasn't there.

findings.description: The hidden counterattack loses its before-capture timing and low-ground flight.
findings.sourceReading: He threw the swords when kicking Shirou, immediately before falling under the spell; they flew as if crawling along the ground, then attacked airborne Caster after a delay.
findings.explanation: The hidden counterattack loses its before-capture timing and low-ground flight.

contexts.japanese: キャスターの術中に落ちる直前
contexts.english: when he kicked me and got caught in the freezing spell.

contexts.japanese: 放たれた剣は這うように地面を飛び、時間をおいて
contexts.english: The blades boomeranged through the sky

findings.description: Beyond speed and sharpness becomes too swift and deadly.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator says the technique is no longer a matter of being fast or sharp at his modest level of understanding.
findings.explanation: Beyond speed and sharpness becomes too swift and deadly.

contexts.japanese: もはや速いだの鋭いだのといった次元の問題ではなかった
contexts.english: It's too swift and deadly.

findings.description: A firm grasp of Saber’s hand becomes a handshake.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou grips her hand firmly and meets her eyes as he requests instruction in fighting.
findings.explanation: A firm grasp of Saber’s hand becomes a handshake.

contexts.japanese: ぐっ、とセイバーの手を握って
contexts.english: I shake Saber's hand

findings.description: The fortunate direction of rescued lives becomes the hero’s blessed life.
findings.sourceReading: After saying he changed many people’s fates, the narrator judges those changes as at least tending toward happiness, then confirms his struggle was not wasted.
findings.explanation: The fortunate direction of rescued lives becomes the hero’s blessed life.

contexts.japanese: 控えめに言っても、それは幸福よりだったろう
contexts.english: his life was full of blessedness.

findings.description: Spider-thread faintness becomes a premonition of a spider’s web.
findings.sourceReading: 蜘蛛の糸ほど qualifies how slight the disquiet that wakes her is, anticipating the exceptionally fine actual magical thread.
findings.explanation: Spider-thread faintness becomes a premonition of a spider’s web.

contexts.japanese: 蜘蛛の糸ほどの違和感
contexts.english: a strange premonition of a spider's web

findings.description: A little over six centimeters becomes about sixteen centimeters.
findings.sourceReading: The plastic box is slightly under fifteen centimeters each way and a little over six thick.
findings.explanation: A little over six centimeters becomes about sixteen centimeters.

contexts.japanese: 厚さにして六センチ強
contexts.english: the height is about sixteen centimeters.

findings.description: A sediment-like feeling becomes a falling cage. His enjoyment and self-denial remain, but the image expressing their collision changes.
findings.sourceReading: Something like sediment or dregs descends as he recognizes his enjoyment and tells himself he does not deserve it.
findings.explanation: A sediment-like feeling becomes a falling cage. His enjoyment and self-denial remain, but the image expressing their collision changes.

contexts.japanese: 何か澱のようなモノが落ちてきて
contexts.english: something like a cage falls on me

findings.description: Rin’s subsequent handle becomes a bat.
findings.sourceReading: After two games she was at the back holding a ハンドル, a handle/control. No exact machine is named.
findings.explanation: Rin’s subsequent handle becomes a bat.

contexts.japanese: 奥でハンドル握ってた
contexts.english: held onto the bat in the back after that.

findings.description: Feigning composure becomes remaining calm.
findings.sourceReading: 取り繕って says he puts on a calm appearance after the unfamiliar red outfit has derailed his thought.
findings.explanation: Feigning composure becomes remaining calm.

contexts.japanese: 平静を取り繕って
contexts.english: I keep my calm

findings.description: Twenty deaths becomes over twenty deaths.
findings.sourceReading: 二十の死 exceeds the earlier ten; 越える compares these quantities.
findings.explanation: Twenty deaths becomes over twenty deaths.

contexts.japanese: それを越える二十の死
contexts.english: over twenty deaths

findings.description: Not only scissors becomes a cause involving many scissors.
findings.sourceReading: ハサミばかりか adds needles and thread beyond scissors.
findings.explanation: Not only scissors becomes a cause involving many scissors.

contexts.japanese: ハサミばかりか
contexts.english: It might be because there's this many scissors

findings.description: A rebounding curse becomes restoration of a true self.
findings.sourceReading: 自己に返る means the curse returns to the person, causing self-destruction through desire.
findings.explanation: A rebounding curse becomes restoration of a true self.

contexts.japanese: 自己に返る呪い
contexts.english: return to their true selves

findings.description: No rescuer becomes nothing saved.
findings.sourceReading: 助けてくれるモノなどいない means no one/thing will help him.
findings.explanation: No rescuer becomes nothing saved.

contexts.japanese: 助けてくれるモノなどいない
contexts.english: nothing would be saved

findings.description: Opposite wall becomes other side of the wall.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji watches beside the wall directly opposite Shirou.
findings.explanation: Opposite wall becomes other side of the wall.

contexts.japanese: 俺と正反対の壁際
contexts.english: the other side of the wall

findings.description: Clouds block hands instead of the way ahead.
findings.sourceReading: 行く手 is the onward path in the wall/cloud image.
findings.explanation: Clouds block hands instead of the way ahead.

contexts.japanese: 雲は壁のように行く手を阻む
contexts.english: the clouds block my hands like a wall.

findings.description: Romantic single-mindedness becomes earnestness.
findings.sourceReading: 一途 measures exclusive devotion; the next hint contrasts one partner and two.
findings.explanation: Romantic single-mindedness becomes earnestness.

contexts.japanese: 分岐条件はどのくらい一途だったか
contexts.english: the condition for how they branch is how earnest you are.

findings.description: Wooden practice swords become bamboo swords.
findings.sourceReading: 木刀 differs from the 竹刀 bag named in the next sentence.
findings.explanation: Wooden practice swords become bamboo swords.

contexts.japanese: 木刀だけだった
contexts.english: These bamboo swords are the only things

contexts.japanese: 木刀を振り回す
contexts.english: I swing around my bamboo sword

findings.description: Walking from the station becomes walking to it.
findings.sourceReading: 駅前から is the starting point of the twenty-minute walk to the church.
findings.explanation: Walking from the station becomes walking to it.

contexts.japanese: 駅前から歩くこと二十分
contexts.english: I walk to the train station for twenty minutes.

findings.description: Wooden swords repeatedly become bamboo swords.
findings.sourceReading: 木刀 is a wooden practice sword, distinct from its shinai bag.
findings.explanation: Wooden swords repeatedly become bamboo swords.

contexts.japanese: 木刀を取り出し
contexts.english: take out my bamboo sword

contexts.japanese: 手にした木刀
contexts.english: the bamboo sword in my hand

contexts.japanese: 強化した木刀
contexts.english: Strengthened bamboo sword

contexts.japanese: こんな木刀だけじゃ
contexts.english: just with this bamboo sword

contexts.japanese: 木刀は粉砕された
contexts.english: My bamboo sword is crushed

contexts.japanese: 木刀を振り回す
contexts.english: I swing around my bamboo sword

contexts.japanese: 木刀を振り回す
contexts.english: I swing around my bamboo sword

findings.description: Cutting half a body becomes removing half her power.
findings.sourceReading: 半身を断つ describes the limit of physical sword damage.
findings.explanation: Cutting half a body becomes removing half her power.

contexts.japanese: せいぜいその半身を断つ程度
contexts.english: take away half your powers at most.

findings.description: Rin’s refusal to falter becomes a generic lack of time.
findings.sourceReading: She is not someone who would hesitate over that reaction.
findings.explanation: Rin’s refusal to falter becomes a generic lack of time.

contexts.japanese: そんな事に躊躇しているあいつじゃない
contexts.english: this isn't the time to be hesitating over something like that.

findings.description: An inferior copy becomes an equal shadow.
findings.sourceReading: 真物より落ちる explicitly qualifies the otherwise identical image as inferior to the original.
findings.explanation: An inferior copy becomes an equal shadow.

contexts.japanese: 其は真物より落ちる同一の影
contexts.english: It is an equal shadow cast by the true object.

findings.description: Caster's assurance that she has other resources becomes an assurance that she can control Saber, changing her stated reason for declining Kuzuki's protection.
findings.sourceReading: Caster says she has pieces available without borrowing Kuzuki's strength, answering his offer to guard her until Saber becomes usable.
findings.explanation: Caster's assurance that she has other resources becomes an assurance that she can control Saber, changing her stated reason for declining Kuzuki's protection.

contexts.japanese: マスターに力を借りずとも手駒はあります
contexts.english: I can keep her under my control without your help

findings.description: The alternate morning repeats wooden swords becoming bamboo swords.
findings.sourceReading: 木刀 differs from the next sentence’s 竹刀 bag.
findings.explanation: The alternate morning repeats wooden swords becoming bamboo swords.

contexts.japanese: 木刀だけだった
contexts.english: These bamboo swords are the only things

findings.description: Various guards become a single guard.
findings.sourceReading: 色々な用心棒 explicitly describes a range of hired guards.
findings.explanation: Various guards become a single guard.

contexts.japanese: 色々な用心棒を雇って
contexts.english: hired a guard

findings.description: A strangely transparent dying voice becomes increasingly shallow breathing.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou feels the faltering voice is extremely transparent.
findings.explanation: A strangely transparent dying voice becomes increasingly shallow breathing.

contexts.japanese: 途絶える声は、ひどく透明な気がした
contexts.english: Her breath getting shallower with each fading second.

findings.description: A unique self-suggestion formula becomes repeated self-persuasion.
findings.sourceReading: 自己暗示 is the personal magical formula that should have no identical counterpart, uttered word-for-word by Archer.
findings.explanation: A unique self-suggestion formula becomes repeated self-persuasion.

contexts.japanese: 同じモノなどない筈の自己暗示
contexts.english: I keep telling myself it's not possible for him to whisper those words

findings.description: Lack of ethical standing becomes physical powerlessness.
findings.sourceReading: 資格などない concerns his right to object after accepting the lethal contest.
findings.explanation: Lack of ethical standing becomes physical powerlessness.

contexts.japanese: 異を唱える資格などない自分
contexts.english: being utterly powerless to oppose.

findings.description: Embodiment of an ideal becomes the same person in the conditional.
findings.sourceReading: The condition names the man as Shirou’s desired ideal, without explicitly equating their personal identities.
findings.explanation: Embodiment of an ideal becomes the same person in the conditional.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎の理想に他ならないとしたら
contexts.english: If this man is truly the same person who wanted to become stronger

findings.description: Contractual subordination and entrusted fate become creation.
findings.sourceReading: The body is under the summoner; the summoner’s fate rests in the sword.
findings.explanation: Contractual subordination and entrusted fate become creation.

contexts.japanese: 汝の身は我が下に、我が命運は汝の剣に
contexts.english: My will creates your body, and your sword creates my destiny!

findings.description: Sensory overrun becomes a deliberate coping strategy.
findings.sourceReading: The eyes cannot keep up with analysis and the senses run out of control.
findings.explanation: Sensory overrun becomes a deliberate coping strategy.

contexts.japanese: 肉眼では追い付かず感覚が暴走し
contexts.english: what I need to do now is let my senses take over and analyze them.

findings.description: Flickering vision becomes intermittent consciousness.
findings.sourceReading: 視界が点滅する describes the visual field flashing.
findings.explanation: Flickering vision becomes intermittent consciousness.

contexts.japanese: 視界が点滅する
contexts.english: I am fading in and out of my consciousness.

findings.description: Emotional latitude becomes a lack of available time.
findings.sourceReading: 余裕もなければ says the situation leaves no capacity to rejoice despite an hour of silence.
findings.explanation: Emotional latitude becomes a lack of available time.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の無事を喜ぶ余裕もなければ
contexts.english: We don't have time to be glad that Tohsaka is safe for now

findings.description: An assessment that they have no chance of winning becomes a feeling of despair.
findings.sourceReading: 勝ち目がない is a tactical conclusion reached the more they think.
findings.explanation: An assessment that they have no chance of winning becomes a feeling of despair.

contexts.japanese: 考えれば考えるほど勝ち目がないと思い知らされる
contexts.english: The more we think about it the more we are hit with the feeling of despair.

findings.description: Rin's surveillance familiar becomes a familiar placed by an invented overseer.
findings.sourceReading: For Caster countermeasures, Rin had released a familiar serving as a lookout; its destruction supports her inference.
findings.explanation: Rin's surveillance familiar becomes a familiar placed by an invented overseer.

contexts.japanese: キャスター対策で監視役の使い魔を放ってた
contexts.english: The overseer placed a familiar there to counter Caster

findings.description: The relation between stopping the Grail and defeating Gilgamesh is reversed.
findings.sourceReading: Saber asks whether stopping the Grail therefore means they must defeat Gilgamesh.
findings.explanation: The relation between stopping the Grail and defeating Gilgamesh is reversed.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を止める、という事はギルガメッシュを倒すという事ではないのですか
contexts.english: defeating Gilgamesh does not automatically equate to stopping the Holy Grail.

findings.description: Saber's request for Shirou's reasoning becomes a claim that he contradicted himself.
findings.sourceReading: Saber asks why he said she cannot stall Gilgamesh despite judging her stronger.
findings.explanation: Saber's request for Shirou's reasoning becomes a claim that he contradicted himself.

contexts.japanese: では、何故そのような事を言うのです
contexts.english: That's not what you said earlier.

findings.description: Absence of an original weapon becomes absence of any weapon with an origin.
findings.sourceReading: If a Heroic Spirit owns no Noble Phantasm, no weapon serving as its prototype/original exists for Gilgamesh to possess.
findings.explanation: Absence of an original weapon becomes absence of any weapon with an origin.

contexts.japanese: 自分の宝具を持たない英霊なら、原典になる武器さえ存在しない
contexts.english: if a Heroic Spirit doesn't possess a Noble Phantasm, it means they don't have a weapon that originated from somewhere.

findings.description: Rin's permission becomes Rin's desire.
findings.sourceReading: Saber can use her holy sword if Rin authorizes it.
findings.explanation: Rin's permission becomes Rin's desire.

contexts.japanese: 凛の許しがあれば
contexts.english: As long as Rin wishes so

findings.description: Rin's awkwardly averted gaze becomes a supposition that Shirou has something on his face.
findings.sourceReading: After an inexplicable insult, Rin awkwardly averts her gaze; her embarrassment is the observable comic beat.
findings.explanation: Rin's awkwardly averted gaze becomes a supposition that Shirou has something on his face.

contexts.japanese: 気まずそうに視線を逸らす
contexts.english: then quickly look away as if something weird is on my face.

findings.description: The floor where Shirou and Saber crossed blades becomes quality time they exchanged.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou stares at the plank floor where, for only a few days, he had truly sparred with Saber.
findings.explanation: The floor where Shirou and Saber crossed blades becomes quality time they exchanged.

contexts.japanese: たった数日、けれど確かにセイバーと打ち合った、板張りの床を見つめていた
contexts.english: It was a short few days, but we've exchanged quality time here... I think this while staring at the wooden floor.

findings.description: Rin's mistaken claim that the pair were chatting becomes a nonspecific claim of quality time.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says it looked as though Shirou and Saber had been talking companionably, while the preceding scene explicitly says they exchanged no words.
findings.explanation: Rin's mistaken claim that the pair were chatting becomes a nonspecific claim of quality time.

contexts.japanese: さっきまで道場で、セイバーと仲良く話してたみたいだけど
contexts.english: It looks like you were spending some quality time with Saber at the dojo.

findings.description: Quietly opening the door and entering becomes entering and slowly closing it behind him.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou quietly opens Rin's door and goes inside after receiving permission.
findings.explanation: Quietly opening the door and entering becomes entering and slowly closing it behind him.

contexts.japanese: 静かにドアを開けて中に入った
contexts.english: I enter the room and slowly close the door behind me.

findings.description: Shirou holding down his pounding heart before standing becomes jumping up while thinking it might burst.
findings.sourceReading: He restrains or presses the heart that feels about to leap out, then gets to his feet.
findings.explanation: Shirou holding down his pounding heart before standing becomes jumping up while thinking it might burst.

contexts.japanese: 飛び出しそうな心臓を押さえて立ち上がる
contexts.english: I jumped up thinking my heart was about to burst out.

findings.description: Rin failing to notice Shirou's groggy behavior becomes ignorance that he slept.
findings.sourceReading: 寝ぼけぶり is the observable degree or manner of his sleep-addled state as he answers her.
findings.explanation: Rin failing to notice Shirou's groggy behavior becomes ignorance that he slept.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂は俺の寝ぼけぶりにも気がつかず
contexts.english: Tohsaka didn't realize I dozed off for a bit

findings.description: Shirou's Projection showing its limitations becomes Gilgamesh noticing it.
findings.sourceReading: ボロが出る says even one projected Archer sword exposes Shirou's inadequacy or strain.
findings.explanation: Shirou's Projection showing its limitations becomes Gilgamesh noticing it.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーの剣を一本投影するだけでボロが出るんだぞ
contexts.english: He can tell that as soon as I Project one of Archer's swords.

findings.description: Lacking stored gems becomes lacking knowledge of storing mana in gems.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says he has no jewels already charged with mana as Rin does.
findings.explanation: Lacking stored gems becomes lacking knowledge of storing mana in gems.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂みたいに宝石に魔力を溜めている訳でもないし
contexts.english: I don't know how to store my magical energy into gems like you.

findings.description: Shirou's doubt that he can use the gems becomes doubt that Rin will agree.
findings.sourceReading: He cannot imagine someone without magical aptitude like him handling them.
findings.explanation: Shirou's doubt that he can use the gems becomes doubt that Rin will agree.

contexts.japanese: 元から魔術の素養がない俺がそれをなんとかできるとは、やっぱり思えない
contexts.english: I don't think she'll agree to that seeing that I don't have any training in magecraft to be able to utilize those gems.

findings.description: Magecraft shaped by successive heads becomes work of this generation's head.
findings.sourceReading: Rin uses magecraft that heads throughout the lineage gave form in the inherited crest.
findings.explanation: Magecraft shaped by successive heads becomes work of this generation's head.

contexts.japanese: 歴代の当主が“形”にした魔術を行使できる
contexts.english: magecraft that this generation's family head created.

findings.description: Rin's tendency to fail at decisive moments becomes her biggest past failure.
findings.sourceReading: ここ一番の失敗 is failure when it matters most, which she will suppress this time.
findings.explanation: Rin's tendency to fail at decisive moments becomes her biggest past failure.

contexts.japanese: ここ一番の失敗も、今回ばかりはねじ伏せてやるわ
contexts.english: I will overcome my biggest failure with everything I've got.

findings.description: Rin's hard-to-see virtues become difficulty knowing what there is to like.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says her good qualities are hard to recognize because she hides them.
findings.explanation: Rin's hard-to-see virtues become difficulty knowing what there is to like.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂のいいところって、分かりづらいよな
contexts.english: it's hard to know what to like about you.

findings.description: Feet set on the floor become legs dangling above it.
findings.sourceReading: Both feet are lowered onto the flooring while Rin sits on the bed.
findings.explanation: Feet set on the floor become legs dangling above it.

contexts.japanese: フローリングにおろした両足
contexts.english: her supple legs dangling above the floor

findings.description: Stillness becomes termination in the inner-world paradox.
findings.sourceReading: The world combines high speed with a stopped state.
findings.explanation: Stillness becomes termination in the inner-world paradox.

contexts.japanese: 高速と停止の混ざり合った世界
contexts.english: this world where acceleration and termination exist at the same time.

findings.description: A quiet, complete form becomes a finite emotional state of serenity.
findings.sourceReading: The form itself, rather than sound, is quiet and complete.
findings.explanation: A quiet, complete form becomes a finite emotional state of serenity.

contexts.japanese: カタチそのものが静かで、完結している
contexts.english: my current finite state of serenity.

findings.description: A world oriented around a visitor's intention becomes a welcoming place.
findings.sourceReading: The completed world has no will; it treats the visitor's intention as operative input.
findings.explanation: A world oriented around a visitor's intention becomes a welcoming place.

contexts.japanese: ここは訪れた者を意図とするもの
contexts.english: This place welcomes visitors.

findings.description: Shirou overcoming disgust becomes Rin not feeling disgust.
findings.sourceReading: After recognizing Rin's pain and admiring her, Shirou says his own experience is no longer disgusting.
findings.explanation: Shirou overcoming disgust becomes Rin not feeling disgust.

contexts.japanese: 気持ちの悪さなどない
contexts.english: She doesn't feel any disgust.

findings.description: A proprioceptive sense of extra fingers becomes visually seeing fingers.
findings.sourceReading: The altered body creates a mistaken sensation as though fingers increased.
findings.explanation: A proprioceptive sense of extra fingers becomes visually seeing fingers.

contexts.japanese: 指が増えたような誤認
contexts.english: I thought I was seeing more fingers.

findings.description: Rin looking ready to explode becomes general tension between them.
findings.sourceReading: She is so sulky she appears on the verge of a tantrum.
findings.explanation: Rin looking ready to explode becomes general tension between them.

contexts.japanese: 今にもカンシャクを起こしそうなぐらい、拗ねている
contexts.english: I can sense the tension between us... She's clearly sulking about something.

findings.description: Pole vault is silently normalized to high jump.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says 棒高跳び here, despite the earlier memory saying 走り高跳び.
findings.explanation: Pole vault is silently normalized to high jump.

contexts.japanese: バカみたいに棒高跳びしてるヤツ
contexts.english: an idiot who wouldn't give up on high jumping

findings.description: Moving outward becomes already going outside despite there being no exit.
findings.sourceReading: Rin inches toward the outside while watching the tentacles; the next sentence says no exit exists.
findings.explanation: Moving outward becomes already going outside despite there being no exit.

contexts.japanese: 少しずつ外へと移動する
contexts.english: She slowly goes outside

findings.description: The raining arrows' destruction is assigned to Rin.
findings.sourceReading: Arrows from overhead shatter every tentacle, net, and platform obstructing her route.
findings.explanation: The raining arrows' destruction is assigned to Rin.

contexts.japanese: 彼女の行く手を阻む全てを粉砕する
contexts.english: She smashes everything that gets in her way, whether it is a net, platform, or tentacles of meat

findings.description: Praise of Gilgamesh's capacity to hold and handle his arsenal becomes an overall 'greatest Heroic Spirit' ranking. The following limitation on his skill as a wielder remains.
findings.sourceReading: The narration places Gilgamesh's capacity to possess and handle over a thousand Noble Phantasms at the summit among Heroic Spirits.
findings.explanation: Praise of Gilgamesh's capacity to hold and handle his arsenal becomes an overall 'greatest Heroic Spirit' ranking. The following limitation on his skill as a wielder remains.

contexts.japanese: ギルガメッシュの器の大きさは、紛れもなく英霊の中でも頂点に位置するものだ
contexts.english: he is the greatest Heroic Spirit without a doubt.

findings.description: Gilgamesh's body peeling or turning inside out becomes simply being swallowed.
findings.sourceReading: めくれていく describes his body curling, peeling, or turning over before narration explains the inward swallowing.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh's body peeling or turning inside out becomes simply being swallowed.

contexts.japanese: その体が、めくれていく
contexts.english: His body is being swallowed.

findings.description: Archer's body becoming translucent becomes melting.
findings.sourceReading: The ending permeates him and makes the body manifested in this era transparent.
findings.explanation: Archer's body becoming translucent becomes melting.

contexts.japanese: この時代に現れた彼の体を透かしていく
contexts.english: melts this era's version of his body.

findings.description: Archer entrusting his other self to Rin becomes asking care for the present Archer.
findings.sourceReading: 私を頼む deliberately overlaps Archer with the distant boy, then immediately identifies that unreliable guy as the one Rin must support.
findings.explanation: Archer entrusting his other self to Rin becomes asking care for the present Archer.

contexts.japanese: 私を頼む。知っての通り頼りないヤツだからな
contexts.english: Please take care of me. I am an unreliable guy, as you know.

contexts.japanese: 君が、支えてやってくれ
contexts.english: Please support me.

findings.description: The sky's color comparison is reversed.
findings.sourceReading: The sky is closer to ash/gray than black, recalling the scene ten years earlier.
findings.explanation: The sky's color comparison is reversed.

contexts.japanese: 黒というより灰に近い空
contexts.english: The sky is closer to black than gray

findings.description: Lancer's admission that Rin's gratitude dazzles him becomes praise of her as a Master. His loyalty constraint remains, but the personal effect of her thanks is less specific.
findings.sourceReading: Speaking as someone who cannot readily betray his own master, Lancer finds the gratitude just described a little dazzling.
findings.explanation: Lancer's admission that Rin's gratitude dazzles him becomes praise of her as a Master. His loyalty constraint remains, but the personal effect of her thanks is less specific.

contexts.japanese: おいそれと主を裏切れない身としちゃあ、少しばかり眩しいってもんだ
contexts.english: She's a great Master, but I'm not one who is able to betray my Master readily.

findings.description: Saber's crucified posture becomes merely being tied from the ceiling.
findings.sourceReading: 磔 identifies her as crucified or bound in a cruciform posture at the altar, matching the earlier scene.
findings.explanation: Saber's crucified posture becomes merely being tied from the ceiling.

contexts.japanese: セイバーは磔にされたまま
contexts.english: Saber is still tied from the ceiling

findings.description: Archer's prior and present defense against the spear becomes dodging.
findings.sourceReading: He completely defended against Lancer's spear on the earlier night and has survived this far now by using that knowledge to parry or contain it.
findings.explanation: Archer's prior and present defense against the spear becomes dodging.

contexts.japanese: あの夜防ぎきったランサーの槍を、アーチャーは捌ききれない。
contexts.english: Archer cannot handle Lancer's attacks that he was able to dodge that night.

contexts.japanese: それをここまで防ぎきったのは、前回の戦いでランサーの槍を知ったからだ。
contexts.english: He was able to dodge this much because he knew Lancer's spear from the last battle.

findings.description: Lancer's sense that something does not add up becomes Archer's disgruntlement. This removes the thought that leads into Lancer questioning his own performance.
findings.sourceReading: Lancer pauses to inspect Archer because something does not add up to him, leading into his questioning of Archer's strength and his own restraint.
findings.explanation: Lancer's sense that something does not add up becomes Archer's disgruntlement. This removes the thought that leads into Lancer questioning his own performance.

contexts.japanese: どうも納得がいかぬ、と赤い弓兵を観察する。
contexts.english: He observes the disgruntled bowman in red.

findings.description: Archer's long-standing disadvantage is reversed into an advantage.
findings.sourceReading: Archer has long been on the losing side and will not last several more exchanges, yet he has still received Lancer's full-force spear.
findings.explanation: Archer's long-standing disadvantage is reversed into an advantage.

contexts.japanese: とうに劣勢、あと数合も保つまいが
contexts.english: He has been at an advantage and should not last a few more blows

findings.description: Lancer's all-out blow is made to look self-directed.
findings.sourceReading: The action is an all-out Lancer attack against Archer, canceled by an equally all-out Archer attack; neither combatant is about to hit himself.
findings.explanation: Lancer's all-out blow is made to look self-directed.

contexts.japanese: 自身に叩きつけるようなランサー渾身の一撃は、同じくアーチャー渾身の一撃によって相殺された。
contexts.english: Lancer's full-force blow, as if he is about to hit himself, is offset by Archer's full-force attack.

findings.description: The thrown Gáe Bolg is twice changed into a thrust.
findings.sourceReading: After explicitly saying Lancer will not thrust, the narration describes the spear's property when released or thrown and the legend of its scattering arrowheads when cast at an enemy.
findings.explanation: The thrown Gáe Bolg is twice changed into a thrust.

contexts.japanese: 大きく振りかぶった腕には“放てば必ず心臓を貫く”魔槍。
contexts.english: He holds up the magical spear that "always pierces the heart once it is thrust."

contexts.japanese: その槍は、敵に放てば無数の鏃をまき散らしたという。
contexts.english: That spear scatters numerous arrowheads once it is thrust into the enemy.

findings.description: “At an advantage” reverses Rin's position. The Japanese places her under pressure alongside Shirou, with the added burden of understanding how badly she is outmatched.
findings.sourceReading: Rin is at a disadvantage too; understanding the disparity in strength makes her burden greater than Shirou's.
findings.explanation: “At an advantage” reverses Rin's position. The Japanese places her under pressure alongside Shirou, with the added burden of understanding how badly she is outmatched.

contexts.japanese: 劣勢であるのは彼女も同じだった。
contexts.english: Tohsaka is also at an advantage.

findings.description: Rin's genuinely unfavorable magic battle becomes merely acting disadvantaged.
findings.sourceReading: Unable to beat Caster in magecraft, Rin deliberately conducts an unfavorable magic battle as preparation for a one-use physical ambush.
findings.explanation: Rin's genuinely unfavorable magic battle becomes merely acting disadvantaged.

contexts.japanese: あえて不利な魔術戦を演じたのか。
contexts.english: She acted like she was at a disadvantage

findings.description: Shirou’s unfinished request that Lancer go home makes Shirou himself the person going home.
findings.sourceReading: Too exhausted for a long explanation, Shirou begins telling Lancer to go home quietly before Saber interrupts him.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s unfinished request that Lancer go home makes Shirou himself the person going home.

contexts.japanese: 大人しく帰って
contexts.english: I should go home

findings.description: Archer offers his posthumous self to the World but English offers his body.
findings.sourceReading: He enters the bargain by offering what he will be after death—his continuing self as a Guardian.
findings.explanation: Archer offers his posthumous self to the World but English offers his body.

contexts.japanese: 死後の自分を差し出して
contexts.english: to give his body after death

findings.description: Roughly one hundred saved lives becomes several hundred.
findings.sourceReading: The initial miracle saves about a hundred people; Archer believes later Guardian service will save tens of thousands more.
findings.explanation: Roughly one hundred saved lives becomes several hundred.

contexts.japanese: 百人程度の命を救ったんだ。
contexts.english: saved hundreds of lives.

findings.description: A body made of swords becomes the bone of one sword.
findings.sourceReading: The verse states in the present that his body is made of swords.
findings.explanation: A body made of swords becomes the bone of one sword.

contexts.japanese: 体は剣で出来ている。
contexts.english: I am the bone of my sword.

findings.description: Iron blood and a glass heart become a steel body and fiery blood.
findings.sourceReading: The parallel attributes are blood like iron and a heart like glass.
findings.explanation: Iron blood and a glass heart become a steel body and fiery blood.

contexts.japanese: 血潮は鉄で　心は硝子。
contexts.english: Steel is my body, and fire is my blood.

findings.description: Crossing countless battlefields undefeated becomes creating a thousand blades.
findings.sourceReading: The verse says he crossed battlefields again and again without defeat.
findings.explanation: Crossing countless battlefields undefeated becomes creating a thousand blades.

contexts.japanese: 幾たびの戦場を越えて不敗。
contexts.english: I have created over a thousand blades.

findings.description: Never once retreating in defeat becomes being unknown to death.
findings.sourceReading: He did not flee a battlefield in defeat even once.
findings.explanation: Never once retreating in defeat becomes being unknown to death.

contexts.japanese: ただの一度も敗走はなく、
contexts.english: Unknown to Death,

findings.description: Never being understood becomes being unknown to life.
findings.sourceReading: Not once was he understood by others.
findings.explanation: Never being understood becomes being unknown to life.

contexts.japanese: ただの一度も理解されない。
contexts.english: nor known to Life.

findings.description: Solitude and intoxication with victory become enduring pain to make weapons.
findings.sourceReading: He is always alone, drunk on victory upon the hill of swords.
findings.explanation: Solitude and intoxication with victory become enduring pain to make weapons.

contexts.japanese: 彼の者は常に独り　剣の丘で勝利に酔う。
contexts.english: Have withstood pain to create many weapons.

findings.description: A life judged meaningless becomes hands that hold nothing.
findings.sourceReading: The verse draws its conclusion: therefore his lifetime had no meaning.
findings.explanation: A life judged meaningless becomes hands that hold nothing.

contexts.japanese: 故に、生涯に意味はなく。
contexts.english: Yet, those hands will never hold anything.

findings.description: Existential affirmation of people like Shirou becomes Rin being saved by possessing one.
findings.sourceReading: Rin is saved by the thought that Shirou must be as he is and that someone like him is allowed to exist.
findings.explanation: Existential affirmation of people like Shirou becomes Rin being saved by possessing one.

contexts.japanese: ああいうヤツがいてもいいんだって救われてる
contexts.english: I'm saved by having a guy like him.

findings.description: Refusing to turn his back on Kiritsugu’s final trust becomes not looking away from the moment.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou cannot turn his back on Kiritsugu’s end and what the relieved final words entrusted to him.
findings.explanation: Refusing to turn his back on Kiritsugu’s final trust becomes not looking away from the moment.

contexts.japanese: その最期に、背を向ける事はできない。
contexts.english: I can't look away from his final moment.

findings.description: Knowledge recorded in the original heroic-spirit source becomes knowledge stored in Archer’s body.
findings.sourceReading: The event is registered only as knowledge in the underlying original; the summoned instance does not bodily retain it.
findings.explanation: Knowledge recorded in the original heroic-spirit source becomes knowledge stored in Archer’s body.

contexts.japanese: 知識として大本に記録されるだけだ。
contexts.english: It only stays in his body as knowledge.

findings.description: Archer's metaphorical prior death becomes a possibility that Shirou may die now.
findings.sourceReading: If recognizing death is the criterion, Archer has long been dead; Shirou became as good as dead when he recognized that condition.
findings.explanation: Archer's metaphorical prior death becomes a possibility that Shirou may die now.

contexts.japanese: 死ぬというのなら、あの男はとうに死んでいる。
contexts.english: I might die, but he's long dead.

findings.description: Lancer's casual verbal reply becomes his departure.
findings.sourceReading: He answers lightly with あいよ; only after that does he stop and turn rather than depart.
findings.explanation: Lancer's casual verbal reply becomes his departure.

contexts.japanese: あいよ、と気軽に声を返す。
contexts.english: Lancer departs with an "aye."

findings.description: Becoming a so-called hero of justice becomes always doing what was right.
findings.sourceReading: Archer grants that he became the ideal's 正義の味方, then says the end yielded only regret and death.
findings.explanation: Becoming a so-called hero of justice becomes always doing what was right.

contexts.japanese: 確かにオレは理想通りの正義の味方とやらになったさ。
contexts.english: I did act according to my ideals and always did what was right.

findings.description: Archer's erosion until unrelated lives ceased to matter becomes a decorative image of scattering innocent lives.
findings.sourceReading: He says he killed so much that the lives of uninvolved people no longer mattered to him, a statement about progressive moral desensitization.
findings.explanation: Archer's erosion until unrelated lives ceased to matter becomes a decorative image of scattering innocent lives.

contexts.japanese: 無関係な人間の命なぞどうでもよくなるくらい殺して
contexts.english: scattering innocent lives like so much dust

findings.description: The general posthumous fate of Guardians becomes Archer's personal agreement to surrender his soul to them and leave the time axis.
findings.sourceReading: Anything that entrusts its posthumous existence as a Guardian is removed from the frame of reincarnation and becomes equivalent to nothing.
findings.explanation: The general posthumous fate of Guardians becomes Archer's personal agreement to surrender his soul to them and leave the time axis.

contexts.japanese: 死後、己が存在を守護者に預けたモノは輪廻の枠から外れ、無と同意になるのだと
contexts.english: I agreed to a fate of nothingness, to give up my soul to the Guardians and be removed from the time axis.

findings.description: Human desire becomes human despair.
findings.sourceReading: Archer's endpoint is an existence used only to erase the 欲望—desires or avarice—produced by humanity.
findings.explanation: Human desire becomes human despair.

contexts.japanese: 人間が生み出した欲望を消す為だけの存在。
contexts.english: an existence that erases the despair other humans make.

findings.description: An unintentional blow that spares Shinji's life becomes Shinji looking unconscious.
findings.sourceReading: Because Lancer struck without conscious intent, he apparently avoided killing Shinji; worse harm to Rin would have prompted deliberate retaliation.
findings.explanation: An unintentional blow that spares Shinji's life becomes Shinji looking unconscious.

contexts.japanese: 無意識だったので殺さずに済んだらしい。
contexts.english: He looks unconscious, but not dead.

findings.description: Kotomine's regret at losing a capable apprentice becomes an absence of criticism toward a less capable one. The change obscures how his appraisal of Rin accompanies the threat to her life.
findings.sourceReading: A less capable apprentice would give Kotomine no cause for regret at losing her; the deathbed image and Rin's recognition of her fate specify the stakes.
findings.explanation: Kotomine's regret at losing a capable apprentice becomes an absence of criticism toward a less capable one. The change obscures how his appraisal of Rin accompanies the threat to her life.

contexts.japanese: もう少し出来の悪い弟子ならば、惜しむ事もないのだが
contexts.english: I would have no criticisms of you at all if you were only a slightly less capable apprentice.

findings.description: Kotomine says his mentor was easy to betray because of their relationship. The English instead emphasizes his effort in betraying him, losing the taunt about exploiting that bond.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine says the teacher relationship made his treacherous attack easy.
findings.explanation: Kotomine says his mentor was easy to betray because of their relationship. The English instead emphasizes his effort in betraying him, losing the taunt about exploiting that bond.

contexts.japanese: 恩師であったからな。騙し討ちは容易かった
contexts.english: He was my master whom I owed a great deal. I spared no effort in betraying him.

findings.description: Rin condemning Kotomine to an unsuitable heaven becomes placing him outside heaven where he does not belong.
findings.sourceReading: After hell and purgatory reject him, Rin's punch line is that a failed corpse like him should suffer on a bed of needles in heaven precisely because heaven does not suit his nature.
findings.explanation: Rin condemning Kotomine to an unsuitable heaven becomes placing him outside heaven where he does not belong.

contexts.japanese: 性に合わない天国あたりで針の筵にくるまってろっての
contexts.english: DESERVES TO GET TURNED INTO A PINCUSHION JUST OUTSIDE OF HEAVEN, WHERE YOU DEFINITELY DON'T BELONG

findings.description: Lancer aiming his spear between Shinji's eyes becomes bringing his face close to Shinji's. The next page restores the spear threat, but this moment loses its precise, controlled intimidation.
findings.sourceReading: The object carried forward from withdrawing the spear is the spear itself: Lancer precisely aims it between Shinji's eyebrows.
findings.explanation: Lancer aiming his spear between Shinji's eyes becomes bringing his face close to Shinji's. The next page restores the spear threat, but this moment loses its precise, controlled intimidation.

contexts.japanese: 間桐慎二の眉間に合わせた。
contexts.english: He puts his face in front of Shinji's.

findings.description: Five scene-specific Japanese chant variants are replaced by unrelated stock English Unlimited Blade Works lines.
findings.sourceReading: The memories interleave altered Japanese lines: body made of swords; blood iron and heart glass; undefeated battle, no retreat, no understanding; solitary intoxication with victory on the hill of swords; and a life without meaning.
findings.explanation: Five scene-specific Japanese chant variants are replaced by unrelated stock English Unlimited Blade Works lines.

contexts.japanese: 体は、剣で出来ている。
contexts.english: I am the bone of my sword.

contexts.japanese: 血潮は鉄で、心は硝子。
contexts.english: Steel is my body, and fire is my blood.

contexts.japanese: 幾たびの戦場を越えて不敗。
contexts.english: I have created over a thousand blades.

contexts.japanese: 彼の者は常に独り　剣の丘で勝利に酔う。
contexts.english: Have withstood pain to create weapons.

contexts.japanese: 故に、その生涯に意味はなく。
contexts.english: Yet, those hands will never hold anything.

findings.description: Projection completion and Trace Off become Projection commencement and Trace On.
findings.sourceReading: After assembling all eight stages, Shirou says 'Projection, complete'; the ruby marks Trace Off.
findings.explanation: Projection completion and Trace Off become Projection commencement and Trace On.

contexts.japanese: 投影、完了
contexts.english: Trace, on. (Begin Projection.)

findings.description: A projected Kanshou distorting from one hit becomes Shirou creating it and barely deflecting the hit.
findings.sourceReading: The Kanshou made with all his remaining strength is already present; a single blow warps it.
findings.explanation: A projected Kanshou distorting from one hit becomes Shirou creating it and barely deflecting the hit.

contexts.japanese: 残った全精力で作り上げた干将も、わずか一撃で歪曲した。
contexts.english: I scrounge up every bit of mental focus I have left to create a Kanshou, and just barely deflect another slash.

findings.description: Kanshou bending and fading becomes Kanshou breaking while Shirou's life fades.
findings.sourceReading: The distorted Kanshou bends and its own existence grows thin; Shirou then feels pain in his chest from Archer's words.
findings.explanation: Kanshou bending and fading becomes Kanshou breaking while Shirou's life fades.

contexts.japanese: その干将も歪に折れ曲がり、存在そのものが薄れかかっている。
contexts.english: Kanshou breaks, and my life begins to peter out.

findings.description: Using unbroken parts of a broken body becomes using broken weapons as they are.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou reasons that if he is broken, he must use whatever part remains unbroken, then reach into still-untouched inner territory.
findings.explanation: Using unbroken parts of a broken body becomes using broken weapons as they are.

contexts.japanese: 壊れているなら壊れていないところを使えばいい。
contexts.english: If my weapons are broken, I'll just use them as they are.

findings.description: Memories of people vanishing without reason become memories arriving unbidden.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou recalls the people he could not save and the self that was not saved, seeing those memories disappear causelessly and meaninglessly, and vows against repetition.
findings.explanation: Memories of people vanishing without reason become memories arriving unbidden.

contexts.japanese: いわれもなく無意味に消えていく思い出を見て、二度と、こんな事は繰り返させないと誓った。
contexts.english: The memories come unbidden, and I swore that I'd never let this happen again.

findings.description: Kiritsugu saying the dream cannot come true becomes Shirou promising to make it come true.
findings.sourceReading: The fragment 'It won't come true' introduces Kiritsugu, who saved Shirou as a child and died leaving the dream behind sadly.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu saying the dream cannot come true becomes Shirou promising to make it come true.

contexts.japanese: 叶わないと。
contexts.english: I'll make the dream come true.

findings.description: Shirou resetting into a large sword stance becomes re-sheathing the sword.
findings.sourceReading: After deflecting Archer's blade, Shirou readies his sword again in an especially large posture for the final strike.
findings.explanation: Shirou resetting into a large sword stance becomes re-sheathing the sword.

contexts.japanese: 剣を弾き、一際大きく剣を構え直す敵の姿。
contexts.english: The enemy flicks his sword and re-sheathes it in a single, large stance.

findings.description: Archer's exposed left chest and easy defensive return become an exposed left arm and closing distance.
findings.sourceReading: Archer's left chest is open; he swings the longsword back to guard it, and for him that defense should easily arrive in time.
findings.explanation: Archer's exposed left chest and easy defensive return become an exposed left arm and closing distance.

contexts.japanese: 敵の左胸はがら空きだ。
contexts.english: The enemy's left arm is wide open.

contexts.japanese: 彼ならば、それは容易く間に合う行為だ。
contexts.english: It would be easy to close the distance.

findings.description: Shirou turning attention back to his body becomes looking around.
findings.sourceReading: With the tension gone, Shirou can finally review or attend to the state of his own body.
findings.explanation: Shirou turning attention back to his body becomes looking around.

contexts.japanese: ようやく自分の体に振り返る。
contexts.english: I finally look around

findings.description: Nothing remaining after the dust settles becomes nothing else happening.
findings.sourceReading: After the new rubble and settling dust, nothing remains visible; Archer has disappeared from before them.
findings.explanation: Nothing remaining after the dust settles becomes nothing else happening.

contexts.japanese: その後には何もない。
contexts.english: Nothing else happens.

findings.description: An ability possessed by few Masters becomes an ability possessed by none. This makes dependence on the Grail categorical where Gilgamesh's explanation allows exceptional Masters.
findings.sourceReading: Few Masters can sustain a Servant without Grail assistance; Gilgamesh's own anchor lacked the necessary energy.
findings.explanation: An ability possessed by few Masters becomes an ability possessed by none. This makes dependence on the Grail categorical where Gilgamesh's explanation allows exceptional Masters.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の助力なしでサーヴァントを維持できるマスターなどそうはいない
contexts.english: no Master could sustain a Servant without the support of the Holy Grail.

findings.description: Saber's comparison of the Masters' methods becomes a question about whether they were the same person. Gilgamesh's following answer concerns taking energy from others, which fits the Japanese comparison.
findings.sourceReading: Saber begins comparing Gilgamesh's Master with Rider's Master; the reply supplies the relevant similarity, taking energy from others.
findings.explanation: Saber's comparison of the Masters' methods becomes a question about whether they were the same person. Gilgamesh's following answer concerns taking energy from others, which fits the Japanese comparison.

contexts.japanese: 貴方のマスターは、ライダーのマスターと同じように
contexts.english: is your Master the same person Rider was contracted to?

findings.description: The Grail producing a weapon from Servants becomes the Grail summoning Servants.
findings.sourceReading: Saber asks whether the thing the Grail produces by means of Servants is a weapon.
findings.explanation: The Grail producing a weapon from Servants becomes the Grail summoning Servants.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯が、サーヴァントをもって生み出すモノが兵器だというのか
contexts.english: Do you say that because it can summon Servants

findings.description: Rin arguing that a king is meaningless without any humans becomes saying one death does not matter to a king.
findings.sourceReading: She attacks Gilgamesh's extermination plan: if not a single human remains, the very meaning of being king disappears.
findings.explanation: Rin arguing that a king is meaningless without any humans becomes saying one death does not matter to a king.

contexts.japanese: 人間が一人もいなくなったら、それこそ王様の意味なんてないじゃない！
contexts.english: It doesn't matter to a king whether one person dies or not!?

findings.description: The ceiling turning red by the moment becomes crumbling by the second.
findings.sourceReading: Sparks enter the hall and the ceiling grows progressively red as the fire advances.
findings.explanation: The ceiling turning red by the moment becomes crumbling by the second.

contexts.japanese: 天井は刻一刻と赤く染まる。
contexts.english: the ceiling is crumbling by the second.

findings.description: Shinji's complaint that Lancer took Rin from him becomes a complaint that Lancer “got” him. This obscures the possessive grievance, although it need not refer only to his injury.
findings.sourceReading: Following the statement that Rin escaped, Shinji complains about having her taken from him by someone who was nearly dead.
findings.explanation: Shinji's complaint that Lancer took Rin from him becomes a complaint that Lancer “got” him. This obscures the possessive grievance, although it need not refer only to his injury.

contexts.japanese: あんな死に損ないにとられるなんて、思い出しただけで吐き気がする！
contexts.english: I want to throw up just thinking about how that cockroach got me!

findings.description: A Master serving as the Grail's host becomes a Master serving as the Holy Grail itself.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh says another Master who can become the anchoring host is right here, identifying Shinji as the body to connect with the child's heart.
findings.explanation: A Master serving as the Grail's host becomes a Master serving as the Holy Grail itself.

contexts.japanese: 依り代になるマスターなら、ここにもう一人いるじゃないか
contexts.english: another Master that can serve as a Holy Grail

findings.description: Caster's inability as a bodiless Servant to anchor another Servant becomes Assassin needing a physical body.
findings.sourceReading: Even a magus cannot sustain a Servant when that magus is herself a non-corporeal Servant; the anchor must belong to the current era, so Caster selected the gate.
findings.explanation: Caster's inability as a bodiless Servant to anchor another Servant becomes Assassin needing a physical body.

contexts.japanese: いかに魔術師と言えど、実体を持たぬサーヴァントにサーヴァントは維持できぬ。
contexts.english: A Servant cannot maintain themselves without a physical body, even if one is a mage.

findings.description: A nameless swordsman being forbidden a duel with a superior becomes being unable to witness one.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin imagines that, even at death, his unnamed self may have dreamed of crossing swords with a swordsman too exalted for him to face.
findings.explanation: A nameless swordsman being forbidden a duel with a superior becomes being unable to witness one.

contexts.japanese: 上等すぎる剣士との対決を、死の際でさえ夢見た
contexts.english: superior swordsman, something he was never allowed to witness in life.

findings.description: The flesh mass's breathing becomes mechanical exhaust.
findings.sourceReading: The living atmosphere filling the forest is the thing's breath, continuing the mountain-as-organ image.
findings.explanation: The flesh mass's breathing becomes mechanical exhaust.

contexts.japanese: 山林に満ちていた空気はアレの呼吸だ。
contexts.english: We had been breathing in that thing's exhaust

findings.description: The Grail being active but neither complete nor broken becomes a rule that it cannot break until it returns to its original form.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says there is still time because the Grail has activated, but has neither reached its proper wish-machine form nor yet broken apart.
findings.explanation: The Grail being active but neither complete nor broken becomes a rule that it cannot break until it returns to its original form.

contexts.japanese: 願望機っていう本来の姿になってなければ壊れてもいない。
contexts.english: it won't break as long as it doesn't return to its original wish-granting form.

findings.description: A one-meter difference in fighting range becomes a one-meter distance between the fighters. This obscures the reach advantage that Saber must overcome.
findings.sourceReading: Their effective fighting ranges differ by one meter, a gap Saber cannot close while Assassin controls her approach.
findings.explanation: A one-meter difference in fighting range becomes a one-meter distance between the fighters. This obscures the reach advantage that Saber must overcome.

contexts.japanese: セイバーとアサシンの間合いの差は一メートル。
contexts.english: There's one meter between Saber and Assassin.

findings.description: Gilgamesh aiming an unfamiliar straight sword becomes Shirou responding and pointing it toward himself.
findings.sourceReading: In response to Gilgamesh's taunt, a straight blade Shirou has never seen turns its point toward him and is loaded for launch.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh aiming an unfamiliar straight sword becomes Shirou responding and pointing it toward himself.

contexts.japanese: ヤツの声に応じ、見たこともない直刀が切っ先を返す。
contexts.english: I respond to his voice, and a straight sword I've never seen before points towards me.

findings.description: The one stance used by a swordsman who normally has none becomes an “imaginary stance.” The change removes what makes this preparation exceptional before Swallow Reversal.
findings.sourceReading: This is Assassin's sole stance, exceptional because he ordinarily has nothing resembling a fixed stance.
findings.explanation: The one stance used by a swordsman who normally has none becomes an “imaginary stance.” The change removes what makes this preparation exceptional before Swallow Reversal.

contexts.japanese: 構えらしき物を持たぬアサシンの唯一の構え。
contexts.english: An unknown, imaginary stance for an unknown, imaginary man.

findings.description: An asura's art challenging gods and Buddhas in a human body becomes man's attempt to challenge them.
findings.sourceReading: The sword is the terrible art or karma of an asura: a feat that challenges gods and Buddhas while performed in mortal flesh.
findings.explanation: An asura's art challenging gods and Buddhas in a human body becomes man's attempt to challenge them.

contexts.japanese: この魔剣は、人の身で神仏に挑む修羅の業。
contexts.english: This magical sword is man's attempt at challenging the gods and Buddha.

findings.description: Saber pulling her embedded sword out of Assassin becomes drawing her sword.
findings.sourceReading: After Assassin tells her to go, Saber pulls the sword back out of his pierced body and runs up the steps.
findings.explanation: Saber pulling her embedded sword out of Assassin becomes drawing her sword.

contexts.japanese: セイバーは剣を引き抜き、全速で階段を駆け上がっていく。
contexts.english: Saber draws her sword and runs up the stairs with all her might.

findings.description: Shirou cursing a thought he has never had before becomes cursing himself for never considering implications.
findings.sourceReading: He knew he was inexperienced, yet now for the first time he bitterly curses the fact framed by the following question: why he has only this many circuits.
findings.explanation: Shirou cursing a thought he has never had before becomes cursing himself for never considering implications.

contexts.japanese: それでも今まで一度も思わなかった事を、心の底から罵倒した。
contexts.english: But I seriously curse at myself for never really thinking of the implications or how that would affect me.

findings.description: Resigning himself to what human beings are becomes resigning himself to human weakness.
findings.sourceReading: Unable to bear the terror before him, the child could only accept that indiscriminate death and his inability to save anyone were simply the human condition.
findings.explanation: Resigning himself to what human beings are becomes resigning himself to human weakness.

contexts.japanese: 人間なんてそんなものだと諦めるしか
contexts.english: I had no choice but to resign myself to the fact that humans were weak.

findings.description: An unknown cause of Shirou's survival becomes something outside his control.
findings.sourceReading: He concludes that if he survived there must have been a reason; it was simply something beyond his knowledge.
findings.explanation: An unknown cause of Shirou's survival becomes something outside his control.

contexts.japanese: 単にそれが、俺の与り知らぬ物であっただけ。
contexts.english: It's something that I just have no control over.

findings.description: The skull that creates counterfeits becomes a cranium that makes Shirou a fake.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh threatens to leave not one fragment of the skull or mind that manufactures fake weapons.
findings.explanation: The skull that creates counterfeits becomes a cranium that makes Shirou a fake.

contexts.japanese: 偽物を造るその頭蓋、一片たりとも残しはせん
contexts.english: I will not leave a single piece of cranium that makes you a fake!

findings.description: Saber postponing what she herself wants to tell Shirou becomes asking whether he has anything to tell her.
findings.sourceReading: After affirming him as her Master, Saber says she will discharge her Servant duty and tell him what she wants to say afterward.
findings.explanation: Saber postponing what she herself wants to tell Shirou becomes asking whether he has anything to tell her.

contexts.japanese: 伝えたい事は、その後に
contexts.english: If there is anything you want to tell me, we shall talk afterwards.

findings.description: Creating the Reality Marble as the only full defense becomes creating the incoming Noble Phantasms.
findings.sourceReading: With nearly thirty weapons deployed, Shirou concludes that to block them all he now has no choice but to bring his inner world fully into being.
findings.explanation: Creating the Reality Marble as the only full defense becomes creating the incoming Noble Phantasms.

contexts.japanese: 防ぎきるには、もはや作り上げるしかない。
contexts.english: If I want to block them, I'll just have to create them.

findings.description: Shield fractures causing Shirou's body to lose pieces becomes his body being full of holes.
findings.sourceReading: The shield is already moth-eaten with holes; because it is Shirou himself, each fracture has chipped away parts of his body even though the projectiles have not physically reached him.
findings.explanation: Shield fractures causing Shirou's body to lose pieces becomes his body being full of holes.

contexts.japanese: その時点で衛宮士郎の体は欠けている。
contexts.english: my body is full of holes already.

findings.description: Counterpart swords already lying to Shirou's left and right become Gilgamesh's earlier swords themselves surrounding him.
findings.sourceReading: For each sword now floating behind Gilgamesh, its matching counterfeit already sleeps in the Reality Marble beside Shirou.
findings.explanation: Counterpart swords already lying to Shirou's left and right become Gilgamesh's earlier swords themselves surrounding him.

contexts.japanese: 左右には、ヤツの背後に浮かぶ剣が眠っている。
contexts.english: Surrounding me are the swords that were floating behind him earlier.

findings.description: What Sakura may have told Rin becomes something Rin and Sakura discussed.
findings.sourceReading: Rin refuses to say what Matou was talking about, using privacy to avoid confirming whether Sakura supplied the suspected information.
findings.explanation: What Sakura may have told Rin becomes something Rin and Sakura discussed.

contexts.japanese: 間桐さんが何を話していたのかも個人のプライバシーですから
contexts.english: it would be improper to say what I've discussed with Miss Matou

findings.description: A moment of calm judgment that Shirou should stop becomes a matter of being honest with himself.
findings.sourceReading: For an instant he rationally concludes that he should stop until the arm heals, then immediately rejects the sensible thought.
findings.explanation: A moment of calm judgment that Shirou should stop becomes a matter of being honest with himself.

contexts.japanese: 一瞬、左腕が治るまでやめるべきだ、と冷静に考えて
contexts.english: If I'm being honest with myself, I should stop until my arm no longer feels this way

findings.description: Projection as an extension of Strengthening is reversed into Strengthening as an extension of Projection.
findings.sourceReading: Rin calls Shirou’s method nonsense because he skips both full and abbreviated procedures and attempts Projection by extending his Strengthening process.
findings.explanation: Projection as an extension of Strengthening is reversed into Strengthening as an extension of Projection.

contexts.japanese: 強化の延長で投影をしようなんていう貴方
contexts.english: if you think Strengthening is an extension of Projection.

findings.description: Rin’s command to master an achieved result becomes a claim that any success proves reproduction at will.
findings.sourceReading: Whether yesterday’s success was accident or necessity, Rin orders Shirou to make it his own now that he has once accomplished it.
findings.explanation: Rin’s command to master an achieved result becomes a claim that any success proves reproduction at will.

contexts.japanese: 出来た以上は偶然だろうが必然だろうがモノにしなさい！
contexts.english: whether on purpose or not, it means you're capable of doing it at will!

findings.description: Saber’s tolerance of badly prepared food becomes tolerance of an unspecified mistake.
findings.sourceReading: She insists Shirou’s meals are faultless and says that even in the nearly unimaginable event that his method of cooking were bad, she would have no complaint.
findings.explanation: Saber’s tolerance of badly prepared food becomes tolerance of an unspecified mistake.

contexts.japanese: 調理の仕方がまずい時があったとしても不満などありません
contexts.english: if you were to make a mistake, I do not think I would dislike it even then.

findings.description: 'Weak point' becomes 'what you find dull,' including in Saber's reply. The exchange loses the overlap between food preferences and a fighter's vulnerability.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou moves from food preferences to wanting Saber's 'weak point.' Saber repeats that term suspiciously before he returns to practical dietary questions.
findings.explanation: 'Weak point' becomes 'what you find dull,' including in Saber's reply. The exchange loses the overlap between food preferences and a fighter's vulnerability.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの弱点も知っておきたい
contexts.english: I want to know what you find dull.

findings.description: Saber boasting that food is a domain in which she has no weakness becomes a claim that her palate is not dull.
findings.sourceReading: Because she will eat anything provided it is delicious, she proudly declares herself invulnerable where meals are concerned, completing Shirou’s earlier weakness joke.
findings.explanation: Saber boasting that food is a domain in which she has no weakness becomes a claim that her palate is not dull.

contexts.japanese: こと食事に関して、私に弱点はないのです
contexts.english: not even my palate is dull.

findings.description: Rin wondering whether Shirou is all right as he is becomes reassuring him that he need not learn differently and is fine as he is.
findings.sourceReading: The unusual house makes her reflect on others and question whether Shirou can safely remain in his present condition.
findings.explanation: Rin wondering whether Shirou is all right as he is becomes reassuring him that he need not learn differently and is fine as he is.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮くんはそのままでもいいのかなって、ふと思った
contexts.english: maybe you don't have to learn like that. I suppose, well, it might be you're just fine the way you are.

findings.description: Rin originally points out that Shirou's defense itself proves how blunt he is. English makes her say the remark was predictable, changing the punchline.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's claim that he copied Rin's indirectness itself bluntly criticizes her. Rin points to that very response as evidence of his directness.
findings.explanation: Rin originally points out that Shirou's defense itself proves how blunt he is. English makes her say the remark was predictable, changing the punchline.

contexts.japanese: そういうところが直球だって言ってるの
contexts.english: I saw it coming a mile away.

findings.description: Shirou recognizing his burden narrative as his own assumption becomes claiming general ignorance about such matters.
findings.sourceReading: After Rin explains her chosen path, he explicitly retracts his projection that the Tohsaka lineage must weigh on her as a dark shadow.
findings.explanation: Shirou recognizing his burden narrative as his own assumption becomes claiming general ignorance about such matters.

contexts.japanese: けれどそんなのはこっちの思いこみだ。
contexts.english: But I guess I don't really have a clue about that sort of thing.

findings.description: Rin’s gauntlet-throwing tone becomes smacking Shirou with a glove.
findings.sourceReading: Her declaration sounds as though she is throwing down a glove as a formal challenge.
findings.explanation: Rin’s gauntlet-throwing tone becomes smacking Shirou with a glove.

contexts.japanese: 手袋を叩きつけるような口調
contexts.english: as if smacking me with a glove.

findings.description: Rin cornering Shirou and demanding surrender becomes Shirou being about to surrender.
findings.sourceReading: During the school chase she drove him into a corner while telling him to give up, but Rider interrupted before any result.
findings.explanation: Rin cornering Shirou and demanding surrender becomes Shirou being about to surrender.

contexts.japanese: 降参しろと追い詰められた
contexts.english: I was cornered and about to surrender

findings.description: Sleeping with an arm trapped under his body becomes deliberately using it as a pillow.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou compares the numbness to waking after accidentally sleeping on and cutting circulation to an arm.
findings.explanation: Sleeping with an arm trapped under his body becomes deliberately using it as a pillow.

contexts.japanese: 腕を下敷きにしちまって、起きたら血が通ってなかった
contexts.english: If I use my arm as a pillow, it'll often feel like this.

findings.description: Saber not being taciturn becomes Saber not being unfriendly.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou distinguishes her quietness from inability or reluctance to speak and concludes that she treats silence as a virtue.
findings.explanation: Saber not being taciturn becomes Saber not being unfriendly.

contexts.japanese: 無口という訳ではなく、沈黙を美徳としている節がある。
contexts.english: Though she isn't unfriendly, she does consider silence as a virtue.

findings.description: Saber’s throat being slit or torn becomes her throat being crushed.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou minimizes his own condition against Saber having her throat cut open and being smashed into a wall.
findings.explanation: Saber’s throat being slit or torn becomes her throat being crushed.

contexts.japanese: セイバーは喉を裂かれ壁に叩きつけられた。
contexts.english: Saber got her throat crushed and was smashed against a wall.

findings.description: The numb half growing heavier becomes sensation itself getting stronger.
findings.sourceReading: Although he cannot feel the left side, Shirou thinks it is becoming heavy; the paradox deepens his concern.
findings.explanation: The numb half growing heavier becomes sensation itself getting stronger.

contexts.japanese: 感じないクセに重くなってきた気がする
contexts.english: the sensation is getting stronger, like everything is heavier.

findings.description: Shirou’s inexplicable guilt under Rin’s silent pressure becomes concluding that her anger “must be bad.”
findings.sourceReading: Although he recalls no act deserving anger, her glare makes him start to feel as though he has done something terribly wrong.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inexplicable guilt under Rin’s silent pressure becomes concluding that her anger “must be bad.”

contexts.japanese: 怒られる覚えはないんだが、すごく悪いコトをした気になってきた。
contexts.english: I don't know why she's mad, but it must be bad.

findings.description: A joint expert judgment that the temple assault is considerably difficult becomes impossible.
findings.sourceReading: Because Saber and Rin both reject the direct plan, Shirou infers that taking Ryudou Temple must be extremely difficult.
findings.explanation: A joint expert judgment that the temple assault is considerably difficult becomes impossible.

contexts.japanese: 柳洞寺攻略は相当に困難なんだろう。
contexts.english: attacking the temple must really be impossible.

findings.description: Releasing a sensation becomes removing a nerve. The English makes the description more concrete, though the magical context does not require literal anatomical extraction.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou disengages the sensation embedded in his spine, after which circuit-related tension releases.
findings.explanation: Releasing a sensation becomes removing a nerve. The English makes the description more concrete, though the magical context does not require literal anatomical extraction.

contexts.japanese: 背骨に抉り込んだ感覚を外す。
contexts.english: I remove the nerve I gouged into my spine.

findings.description: Kiritsugu’s maxim about fully enjoying occasions of enjoyment becomes a general injunction to enjoy life to the fullest.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu would say that when it was time to have fun, one should enjoy it wholeheartedly, and then romp like a child.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s maxim about fully enjoying occasions of enjoyment becomes a general injunction to enjoy life to the fullest.

contexts.japanese: 楽しむ時は思いっきり楽しむんだ
contexts.english: you need to enjoy life to its fullest

findings.description: Archer’s diagnosis of movements displaced about seven centimeters inward is recast as displacement from Shirou’s center.
findings.sourceReading: The numb side’s movements are shifted roughly seven centimeters toward the inside relative to where Shirou intends them.
findings.explanation: Archer’s diagnosis of movements displaced about seven centimeters inward is recast as displacement from Shirou’s center.

contexts.japanese: 動作が中よりに七センチほどずれている
contexts.english: your movements are seven centimeters off from your center

findings.description: Archer’s “the answer is obvious” becomes “it is nothing worth mentioning.”
findings.sourceReading: Asked what he fights for, Archer answers that it is self-evident: he fights solely for himself.
findings.explanation: Archer’s “the answer is obvious” becomes “it is nothing worth mentioning.”

contexts.japanese: 知れた事。私の戦う意義は、ただ己の為のみだ。
contexts.english: It is nothing worth mentioning. The reason I fight is simply for myself.

findings.description: Archer’s distinction between outside rescue and a person being realized through their own will and result is flattened into another statement about saving.
findings.sourceReading: Outside salvation is not true salvation; only the person’s own will and its result can bring that person to fulfillment or realization.
findings.explanation: Archer’s distinction between outside rescue and a person being realized through their own will and result is flattened into another statement about saving.

contexts.japanese: 人を叶えるのは本人の意思と結果だけだ。
contexts.english: The only things that save a person are their own will and results.

findings.description: The dream world’s limitless inorganic quality becomes a spatially endless world, while “lifeless” absorbs the separate statement that no living thing exists.
findings.sourceReading: The world is inorganic to an unlimited degree, and no living thing inhabits it.
findings.explanation: The dream world’s limitless inorganic quality becomes a spatially endless world, while “lifeless” absorbs the separate statement that no living thing exists.

contexts.japanese: 世界は限りなく無機質で、生きているモノは誰もいない。
contexts.english: This world is endless and lifeless; not a single living thing inhabits it.

findings.description: The two images Shirou thinks prompted the dream are rewritten as Saber’s battle in the graveyard plus a fire.
findings.sourceReading: He starts to attribute the dream to having seen a sword-bearing girl and a graveyard wrapped in flames.
findings.explanation: The two images Shirou thinks prompted the dream are rewritten as Saber’s battle in the graveyard plus a fire.

contexts.japanese: 剣を持った少女と、炎に包まれた墓地を見たからで
contexts.english: because of the battle Saber had in the graveyard and that fire that

findings.description: Shirou’s instantaneous backward leap to the wall becomes scurrying like a startled cat.
findings.sourceReading: In a split second, Shirou jumps back as far as the wall to put distance between himself and Rin.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s instantaneous backward leap to the wall becomes scurrying like a startled cat.

contexts.japanese: そのままコンマで壁際まで跳び退いて
contexts.english: Like a startled cat, I scurry so my back is to the wall

findings.description: About half a day becomes an unspecified part of the day.
findings.sourceReading: From the daylight and return home, Shirou infers that only roughly half a day has elapsed.
findings.explanation: About half a day becomes an unspecified part of the day.

contexts.japanese: あれから半日ぐらいしか経ってないのか。
contexts.english: So part of the day has passed since then?

findings.description: Shirou’s conclusion that he and Rin can only be competitors becomes saying they can only fight each other.
findings.sourceReading: Having both declared participation, he understands their relationship as one of unavoidable competition.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s conclusion that he and Rin can only be competitors becomes saying they can only fight each other.

contexts.japanese: 競い合うしかない関係なんだ。
contexts.english: we can only fight each other.

findings.description: Rin’s displeased throat-rumble becomes clearing her throat because she is troubled.
findings.sourceReading: Caught in her contradiction, Rin makes an increasingly displeased “uu” sound in her throat.
findings.explanation: Rin’s displeased throat-rumble becomes clearing her throat because she is troubled.

contexts.japanese: うー、とますます不愉快そうに喉を鳴らす。
contexts.english: She clears her throat, even more troubled.

findings.description: Rin’s admission of carelessness born from superior strength becomes saying she simply is not afraid.
findings.sourceReading: She classifies sparing and tending Shirou as her own lost point: the lapse in vigilance produced by being stronger than he is.
findings.explanation: Rin’s admission of carelessness born from superior strength becomes saying she simply is not afraid.

contexts.japanese: 貴方よりわたしの方が強いから生じた油断かな。
contexts.english: I suppose I'm not afraid since I'm so much stronger than you.

findings.description: Rin’s warning to refrain from needless words and actions becomes advice to think for a long time.
findings.sourceReading: She tells Shirou to curb unnecessary speech and behavior because rash action will only invite death.
findings.explanation: Rin’s warning to refrain from needless words and actions becomes advice to think for a long time.

contexts.japanese: これからは余計な言動は控えた方がいいわよ。
contexts.english: you should think real long and hard from here on out.

findings.description: Shirou’s declared reason for entering the war is replaced by an assertion that he had no real choice.
findings.sourceReading: Above all, Shirou recalls that he said he would fight precisely because he cannot leave the conflict and its danger alone.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s declared reason for entering the war is replaced by an assertion that he had no real choice.

contexts.japanese: 俺はこの戦いが放っておけないからこそ戦うと口にした。
contexts.english: I said that I would fight. Not that I had any real choice.

findings.description: Stopping ruthless contestants even by force becomes doing everything possible to stop them, echoing their unrestricted methods.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou distinguishes his end from winning: he will stop, by force if necessary, anyone trying to win by using any means.
