findings.explanation: Stopping ruthless contestants even by force becomes doing everything possible to stop them, echoing their unrestricted methods.

contexts.japanese: どんな手を使っても勝ち残ろうとするヤツを、力ずくでも止める事。
contexts.english: It's to do everything I can to stop those who will try to win by any means necessary.

findings.description: The sentence replaces explicit awareness of Saber as a woman with thinking she is real. This repeats the same attraction-related change in another route.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou becomes conscious of Saber as a woman because her ordinary clothes make her presence feel immediate and familiar.
findings.explanation: The sentence replaces explicit awareness of Saber as a woman with thinking she is real. This repeats the same attraction-related change in another route.

contexts.japanese: 否応なしに異性を意識してしまうのだ。
contexts.english: I can't help but actually think she's real now.

findings.description: Shirou’s involuntary awareness of Saber as a member of the opposite sex becomes thinking she is real.
findings.sourceReading: Her ordinary, present-day clothing has too much everyday reality, forcing him to register her as a woman and explaining his physical nervousness.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s involuntary awareness of Saber as a member of the opposite sex becomes thinking she is real.

contexts.japanese: 否応なしに異性を意識してしまうのだ。
contexts.english: I can't help but actually think she's real now.

findings.description: Saber’s distinction between accurate instruction and unskillful method becomes correct purpose versus problematic methods.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou’s method of intervention was poor, but the direction or tactical instruction he gave Saber was accurate.
findings.explanation: Saber’s distinction between accurate instruction and unskillful method becomes correct purpose versus problematic methods.

contexts.japanese: 方法こそ巧くはありませんでしたが、シロウの指示は的確でした
contexts.english: The methods by which you acted were problematic, but your purpose was correct.

findings.description: Incomplete magical replenishment becomes no replenishment under any degree of restraint.
findings.sourceReading: Sleep can suppress consumption, but replenishment cannot be made fully adequate.
findings.explanation: Incomplete magical replenishment becomes no replenishment under any degree of restraint.

contexts.japanese: 魔力の補充は万全とはいかないらしい。
contexts.english: she can't replenish it no matter how much she limits herself.

findings.description: Saber’s drip of self-generated recovery is misattributed to Shirou supplying it through the sealed faucet.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou’s faucet is blocked; Saber recovers only at the drip rate produced by her own circuits.
findings.explanation: Saber’s drip of self-generated recovery is misattributed to Shirou supplying it through the sealed faucet.

contexts.japanese: 俺という蛇口を封じられているセイバーは、魔力回復がとんでもなく遅い
contexts.english: since I am figuratively Saber's faucet, she can only restore magical energy at a slow pace since I am only providing the equivalent of a drip.

findings.description: Shirou’s fire-burglar-circus list is replaced by robbery and death.
findings.sourceReading: He jokes that no fire, burglar, or circus has come to the house, so Taiga can safely continue club activities.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s fire-burglar-circus list is replaced by robbery and death.

contexts.japanese: こっちには火事も泥棒もサーカスも来てない
contexts.english: nobody here is being robbed or dying

findings.description: Shirou's surprise at Rin's efficiency becomes surprise at her kindness. His more specific surprise that she owns ladylike clothes also becomes a broader judgment about her mature taste.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou is surprised by Rin's efficient arrangements—or, more precisely, that these ladylike clothes belong to her.
findings.explanation: Shirou's surprise at Rin's efficiency becomes surprise at her kindness. His more specific surprise that she owns ladylike clothes also becomes a broader judgment about her mature taste.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の手際の良さ、というより、このお嬢様っぽい洋服が遠坂の持ち物だってコトがびっくりだ。
contexts.english: I'm surprised at Tohsaka's kindness, but I'm more surprised that she has such mature tastes.

findings.description: Shirou asks Sakura to fetch Taiga; the English asks her to deliver the lunch. The final handoff is not established here.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou asks Sakura to bring Taiga over.
findings.explanation: Shirou asks Sakura to fetch Taiga; the English asks her to deliver the lunch. The final handoff is not established here.

contexts.japanese: あそこで無茶苦茶言ってる教師を連れてきてくれ
contexts.english: can you take this to that manic teacher over there?

findings.description: The English introduces mentally hitting targets during magecraft practice. The Japanese only says that nightly training enables Shirou to make his arrows strike as imagined.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou credits his nightly magecraft training with enabling arrows to strike as he imagines, explaining why he expects to retain his former archery results.
findings.explanation: The English introduces mentally hitting targets during magecraft practice. The Japanese only says that nightly training enables Shirou to make his arrows strike as imagined.

contexts.japanese: 魔術の鍛錬があるからこそ、イメージ通りに矢を的中させられる
contexts.english: I can hit the target like I do mentally while I'm working on magecraft.

findings.description: Doubt that Shirou can enter 会心 becomes doubt that he can hit the target.
findings.sourceReading: Because his attitude is not prepared, Shirou doubts whether he can enter the concentrated or unified state he calls 会心.
findings.explanation: Doubt that Shirou can enter 会心 becomes doubt that he can hit the target.

contexts.japanese: これじゃ会心に入れるかも怪しい

contexts.english: seeing off her friend who lives in the town three train stops away.

findings.description: Her estranged sense that events concern someone else becomes asking whether nobody cares.
findings.sourceReading: 他人事のよう describes her dissociated experience in the imitation-like deserted city.
findings.explanation: Her estranged sense that events concern someone else becomes asking whether nobody cares.

contexts.japanese: こんなにも、他人事のようなのか
contexts.english: Does no one really care?

findings.description: People without knowledge of eternity become people knowing a half-done eternity.
findings.sourceReading: なまじ永久を知らぬ者 refers to those who do not know eternity; Zouken’s lived eternity is harder than their ordinary condition.
findings.explanation: People without knowledge of eternity become people knowing a half-done eternity.

contexts.english: worse than that of those who only know a half-done eternity.

findings.description: The English replaces a judgment about Zouken's departure from ordinary human bounds with a specific claim that he has lost sight of his goal. The passage instead links his altered mentality to prolonged decay.
findings.sourceReading: The narration speculates that Zouken has long departed from ordinary human bounds, then explains the incomprehensible mental effects of centuries of bodily decay.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a judgment about Zouken's departure from ordinary human bounds with a specific claim that he has lost sight of his goal. The passage instead links his altered mentality to prolonged decay.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯はとうに常軌を逸している
contexts.english: Zouken Matou has long lost sight of his goal.

findings.description: The trapped-rat joke’s escalation to all humanity becomes correcting rat to human.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou exaggerates his cornered position into humanity having no escape.
findings.explanation: The trapped-rat joke’s escalation to all humanity becomes correcting rat to human.

contexts.japanese: うう人類に逃げ場なし
contexts.english: I'm like a rat—I mean, human trapped in a bag.

findings.description: Lightly dismissing Zouken’s valuation becomes do not ignore Rin.
findings.sourceReading: 軽く聞き流す tells Shirou not to take that valuation to heart; she emphasizes it is only Zouken’s view.
findings.explanation: Lightly dismissing Zouken’s valuation becomes do not ignore Rin.

contexts.japanese: 軽く聞き流しなさいよね
contexts.english: so don't ignore me.

findings.description: Rin’s unfinished address becomes a farewell.
findings.sourceReading: じゃあ、衛宮くん trails into addressing him; he states withdrawal and leaves before she can continue.
findings.explanation: Rin’s unfinished address becomes a farewell.

contexts.japanese: じゃあ、衛宮くん
contexts.english: Bye, Emiya.

findings.description: Permission to take Sakura away becomes Shinji’s promise to bring her.
findings.sourceReading: If Shirou comes alone, he may take Sakura as she is and leave with her.
findings.explanation: Permission to take Sakura away becomes Shinji’s promise to bring her.

contexts.japanese: 一人で迎えに来るなら桜はそのまま連れて行っていい
contexts.english: I'll bring Sakura if you come alone.

findings.description: The incantation’s wrong-becomes-right ruby becomes the fault lies here.
findings.sourceReading: The raw Japanese semantic ruby on Weiß ist schwarz reads 非は / 是に, a transformation from wrong/no to right/yes.
findings.explanation: The incantation’s wrong-becomes-right ruby becomes the fault lies here.

contexts.japanese: Weiß ist schwarz.
contexts.english: Weiß ist schwarz. (The fault lies here.)

findings.description: Being taught incorrectly becomes Shirou’s way of thinking being incorrect.
findings.sourceReading: 教え方が間違えられていた assigns the problem to faulty instruction, after questions about his teacher.
findings.explanation: Being taught incorrectly becomes Shirou’s way of thinking being incorrect.

contexts.japanese: 貴方の場合は教え方が間違えられていた
contexts.english: your way of thinking is incorrect.

findings.description: Avoiding an irritating recollection becomes avoiding forgetting to say something.
findings.sourceReading: 思い出すのも癪だから concerns Rin’s irritation at having to recall the matter again.
findings.explanation: Avoiding an irritating recollection becomes avoiding forgetting to say something.

contexts.japanese: 思い出すのも癪だからいまのうちに教えといてあげる
contexts.english: I might forget to say it later, so I'll tell you this now.

contexts.japanese: 思い出すのも癪だからいまのうちに教えといてあげる
contexts.english: I might forget to say it later, so I'll tell you this now.

findings.description: Pain from previously grabbing the knife becomes still holding its blade.
findings.sourceReading: ナイフを掴んだ手の痛み is belated awareness of the injury; page0 explicitly discards the knife.
findings.explanation: Pain from previously grabbing the knife becomes still holding its blade.

contexts.japanese: ナイフを掴んだ手の痛み
contexts.english: I'm holding a knife in my left hand by the blade.

findings.description: Sakura’s apparent apology that she did not want Shirou to know becomes apology for not telling him sooner.
findings.sourceReading: Her shrinking gesture seems to confess she particularly wanted to conceal this from him.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s apparent apology that she did not want Shirou to know becomes apology for not telling him sooner.

contexts.japanese: 俺にだけは知られたくなかったと、謝罪しているようだった
contexts.english: apologize to me for not telling me sooner.

findings.description: Rider's grip on Shinji's arm becomes Shinji clinging to hers. Her verbal refusal to let him hurt Sakura remains, but the physical expression of that refusal changes.
findings.sourceReading: After Rider releases him, Shinji holds his own arm where she had seized it and staggers backward.
findings.explanation: Rider's grip on Shinji's arm becomes Shinji clinging to hers. Her verbal refusal to let him hurt Sakura remains, but the physical expression of that refusal changes.

contexts.japanese: ライダーに掴まれた腕を押さえながら
contexts.english: Shinji, who had been clinging to her arm.

findings.description: Shinji having no remaining chance becomes Sakura not caring about him.
findings.sourceReading: アンタにもう目はない denies prospects of becoming a Master, alongside her refusal to fight.
findings.explanation: Shinji having no remaining chance becomes Sakura not caring about him.

contexts.japanese: アンタにもう目はない
contexts.english: she doesn't care about you.

findings.description: Holding one’s breath becomes breathing.
findings.sourceReading: 息を止めている describes keeping breath held to avoid the burning air.
findings.explanation: Holding one’s breath becomes breathing.

contexts.japanese: 息を止めているだけでも苦しい
contexts.english: Breathing is hard enough

findings.description: Archer not using his Noble Phantasm becomes inability to use it.
findings.sourceReading: 使わない is nonuse; Rider offers possible restrictions or concern but says she does not know the reason.
findings.explanation: Archer not using his Noble Phantasm becomes inability to use it.

contexts.japanese: 貴方は宝具を使わない
contexts.english: You cannot use your Noble Phantasm

findings.description: Initial petrification up to the knees becomes up to the thighs.
findings.sourceReading: 膝まで locates the first stage at the knees; the later stage reaches the waist.
findings.explanation: Initial petrification up to the knees becomes up to the thighs.

contexts.japanese: その両足は、すでに膝まで石化していた
contexts.english: his legs have already petrified up to his thighs.

findings.description: Seeing Rider with physical or mental vision becomes everything she sees, physical or spiritual, being cursed.
findings.sourceReading: 肉眼/心眼 describe the observer’s means of seeing her; 今の私を見る事自体 is the curse.
findings.explanation: Seeing Rider with physical or mental vision becomes everything she sees, physical or spiritual, being cursed.

contexts.japanese: 肉眼であろうが心眼であろうが、今の私を見る事自体が呪い
contexts.english: Everything I see is cursed, whether physical or spiritual.

findings.description: The imminent Rin stabbing is described as completed before the attack turns away.
findings.sourceReading: The spear-like threat changes course immediately before impact; the next page explicitly says it was about to pierce her.
findings.explanation: The imminent Rin stabbing is described as completed before the attack turns away.

contexts.japanese: 目の前にいる遠坂を貫く黒槍を見つめる事しか出来ず
contexts.english: a dark spear stabs Tohsaka.

findings.description: The attack on Shirou becomes the attack on Rin.
findings.sourceReading: 俺を襲った belongs to the no-rescue-shove variant, after the wave turns and strikes him.
findings.explanation: The attack on Shirou becomes the attack on Rin.

contexts.japanese: 俺を襲った槍のようなもの
contexts.english: The spear-like thing that attacked Tohsaka

findings.description: Saving others remains his purpose, but the English shifts from what has allowed him to keep living to how he has chosen to live. This softens the personal dependence expressed at this decision.
findings.sourceReading: The commitment to save people from arbitrary calamity has enabled or justified his continuing to live.
findings.explanation: Saving others remains his purpose, but the English shifts from what has allowed him to keep living to how he has chosen to live. This softens the personal dependence expressed at this decision.

contexts.japanese: 人々を救うからと、こうして生きていられた
contexts.english: lived the way I do:

findings.description: Shirou driving Illya away for his own relief becomes Illya trying to make him feel better.
findings.sourceReading: 自分が楽になりたくて describes the selfish motive he condemns in himself.
findings.explanation: Shirou driving Illya away for his own relief becomes Illya trying to make him feel better.

contexts.japanese: 自分が楽になりたくてイリヤを追い払っている
contexts.english: Illya's just trying to make me feel better, but I'm pushing her away.

findings.description: The condition for a colder night changes from rain to wind.
findings.sourceReading: The wind is already cold; the new hypothetical is if it rains.
findings.explanation: The condition for a colder night changes from rain to wind.

contexts.japanese: もし雨が降るなら
contexts.english: if there's wind.

findings.description: A box resembling a movie treasure chest becomes one filled with movie treasures.
findings.sourceReading: そっくり describes the box's appearance, not its contents.
findings.explanation: A box resembling a movie treasure chest becomes one filled with movie treasures.

contexts.japanese: 箱は冒険物の映画で出てくる宝箱そっくり
contexts.english: It's filled with treasures straight out of an adventure movie.

findings.description: No point using Kischur's agate becomes having to use it.
findings.sourceReading: 使ってもしょうがない dismisses this candidate before Rin searches for sage.
findings.explanation: No point using Kischur's agate becomes having to use it.

contexts.japanese: 瑪瑙なんか使ってもしょうがない
contexts.english: Guess I'll have to use Grandmaster Kischur's agate

findings.description: General feasibility of concealing energy becomes Rin's personal current act of hiding Archer.
findings.sourceReading: 魔力を隠すだけならどうとでもなる concludes that concealment can be arranged either way, after discussing the Matou house.
findings.explanation: General feasibility of concealing energy becomes Rin's personal current act of hiding Archer.

contexts.japanese: 魔力を隠すだけならどうとでもなる
contexts.english: One way or another, I hide his magical energy.

findings.description: The hair-binding accessory itself being a corresponding magical item becomes bindings being suitable tools.
findings.sourceReading: 相応の魔術品 identifies what the actual accessory must be, explaining rarity of replacements.
findings.explanation: The hair-binding accessory itself being a corresponding magical item becomes bindings being suitable tools.

contexts.japanese: 縛り付ける物だって相応の魔術品
contexts.english: Bindings are suitable as tools of magecraft

findings.description: Deferring thought about consequences becomes promising to find a way.
findings.sourceReading: その結果がどうなるかは、これから考える leaves consequences unresolved after admitting he cannot save everyone.
findings.explanation: Deferring thought about consequences becomes promising to find a way.

contexts.japanese: その結果がどうなるかは、これから考える
contexts.english: I'll think of a way.

findings.description: Threatening the restraining arm at its root becomes blasting Shirou generally.
findings.sourceReading: 手を離して、さもないと、根元から吹っ飛ばされて is a threat to the arm he holds her with, followed by being sent outside.
findings.explanation: Threatening the restraining arm at its root becomes blasting Shirou generally.

contexts.japanese: 根元から吹っ飛ばされて
contexts.english: I'll blast you so hard you go flying outside.

findings.description: Never having conceived of losing Sakura becomes unable to bear thinking of it.
findings.sourceReading: 失うことさえ、思いつかなかった says loss had not occurred to him, a retrospective blind spot.
findings.explanation: Never having conceived of losing Sakura becomes unable to bear thinking of it.

contexts.japanese: 失うことさえ、思いつかなかった
contexts.english: Who I can't bear the thought of losing.

findings.description: Everything around Sakura being frightening becomes everyone being scary.
findings.sourceReading: まわりはみんな怖いコトだらけ describes surrounding things/situations as full of fear, not every nearby person as frightening.
findings.explanation: Everything around Sakura being frightening becomes everyone being scary.

contexts.japanese: まわりはみんな怖いコトだらけ
contexts.english: everyone around me was so scary

findings.explanation: Disclosure being the right outcome becomes being fine with the preceding unrealized separation.

contexts.english: I'm sure I would have been fine with that.

contexts.japanese: それだと、俺はずっと桜を泣かし続けたままだった
contexts.english: so I kept her crying all this time.

findings.description: Expecting eventual return becomes checking the house as a last resort.
findings.sourceReading: 最後にはここに戻ってくると踏んでいた locates the expectation at their eventual return, not Rin's failed prior search.
findings.explanation: Expecting eventual return becomes checking the house as a last resort.

contexts.japanese: 最後にはここに戻ってくると踏んではいた
contexts.english: I decided to check here as a last resort

findings.description: Finally feeling home becomes realizing he can sleep.
findings.sourceReading: 帰ってきたという実感 is the felt reality of returning home after the day.
findings.explanation: Finally feeling home becomes realizing he can sleep.

contexts.japanese: ようやく帰ってきた、という実感
contexts.english: it finally hits me that I can sleep now.

findings.description: Blood draining from cold extremities becomes the limbs losing blood.

findings.explanation: Blood draining from cold extremities becomes the limbs losing blood.

contexts.japanese: 手足は逆に血の気を失っている
contexts.english: her limbs are losing blood.

findings.description: An invitation to ask for blood becomes blanket permission to drink anytime.
findings.sourceReading: いつでも言ってくれていい explicitly invites communication, followed by her asking again and his agreement.
findings.explanation: An invitation to ask for blood becomes blanket permission to drink anytime.

contexts.japanese: いつでも言ってくれていい
contexts.english: feel free to drink it anytime.

findings.description: Both of them breaking becomes one of them breaking.
findings.sourceReading: どちらも壊れてしまう makes the destructive fantasy mutual.
findings.explanation: Both of them breaking becomes one of them breaking.

contexts.japanese: どちらも壊れてしまうぐらい
contexts.english: until one of us broke.

findings.description: Bad instruction becomes incorrect thinking.
findings.sourceReading: 教え方が間違えられていた blames the method by which he was taught.
findings.explanation: Bad instruction becomes incorrect thinking.

contexts.japanese: 教え方が間違えられていた
contexts.english: your way of thinking is incorrect.

findings.description: Annoyance at even recalling the issue becomes a risk of forgetting to say it.
findings.sourceReading: 思い出すのも癪だから gives irritation, not memory failure, as her reason for stating it now.
findings.explanation: Annoyance at even recalling the issue becomes a risk of forgetting to say it.

contexts.japanese: 思い出すのも癪だから
contexts.english: I might forget to say it later

findings.description: Three remaining steps becomes three seconds.
findings.sourceReading: 三歩 measures approach distance, not elapsed time.
findings.explanation: Three remaining steps becomes three seconds.

contexts.japanese: あと三歩
contexts.english: In just three seconds,

findings.sourceReading: Rider strikes only Shirou's exposed abdomen and chest, avoiding the gaps in the arms guarding his head.
findings.explanation: Rider's attacks on the exposed chest and stomach become attacks on the arms and stomach. The English retains the reduced force, but changes the bodily pattern Shirou is assessing.

contexts.japanese: がら空きの腹と胸だけ
contexts.english: my arms and unprotected stomach.

findings.sourceReading: 一撃で俺の胃袋ぐらい破裂させる describes the blunt-force outcome his stomach should suffer at temple strength.
findings.explanation: The hypothetical stomach rupture becomes being cut in half.

contexts.japanese: 一撃で俺の胃袋ぐらい破裂させる
contexts.english: She could have cut me in half

findings.description: The oath-restraint made beside the heart becomes one binding the heart itself.
findings.sourceReading: 心臓の横に作られた identifies the separate magical formation beside the heart, explicitly distinguishing it from the heart’s motion.
findings.explanation: The oath-restraint made beside the heart becomes one binding the heart itself.

contexts.japanese: 心臓の横に作られた、誓約という名の戒め
contexts.english: an oath binding it.

findings.sourceReading: もうその意味もなくなった refers to the point of hiding it now, not a lack of freedom to choose.
findings.explanation: Concealment having lost its purpose becomes Rin having no choice.

contexts.japanese: もうその意味もなくなった
contexts.english: nor do I have a choice.

findings.description: Being unable to meet properly becomes not getting to know her well.
findings.sourceReading: まともに会えなかった concerns restricted meetings after an already shared childhood, not initially discovering who she was.
findings.explanation: Being unable to meet properly becomes not getting to know her well.

contexts.japanese: あの子とはまともに会えなかった
contexts.english: I haven't really gotten to know her well since then.

findings.description: The body failing before complete invasion becomes possible permanent damage.
findings.sourceReading: その前に体の方が保つまい forecasts inability of the body to endure that long, not merely a possible lasting injury.
findings.explanation: The body failing before complete invasion becomes possible permanent damage.

contexts.japanese: その前に体の方が保つまい
contexts.english: they may cause permanent damage before then.

findings.description: Defeating Sakura first becomes also having to fight her.
findings.sourceReading: 先に桜を倒す is Rin’s tactical conclusion before defeating Zouken, with both priority and result stated.
findings.explanation: Defeating Sakura first becomes also having to fight her.

contexts.japanese: 先に桜を倒すしかない
contexts.english: you'll have to fight Sakura, too.

findings.description: Being unrelated becomes being a stranger.
findings.sourceReading: 他人 challenges lack of a family tie or obligation despite their obvious long acquaintance and daily care.
findings.explanation: Being unrelated becomes being a stranger.

contexts.japanese: おまえと間桐桜は他人なのだから
contexts.english: Sakura Matou is a stranger to you.

findings.description: Lacking the mental room to turn becomes not bothering to turn.
findings.sourceReading: 振り向く余裕などない marks his overwhelmed capacity after the accusations.
findings.explanation: Lacking the mental room to turn becomes not bothering to turn.

contexts.japanese: 振り向く余裕などない
contexts.english: I don't bother turning around.

findings.description: Acknowledging repeated apologies becomes acknowledging an excessive request.
findings.sourceReading: 謝ってばっかりだけど refers to his constant apologizing in this awkward approach.
findings.explanation: Acknowledging repeated apologies becomes acknowledging an excessive request.

contexts.japanese: 謝ってばっかりだけど
contexts.english: I know it's really pushing it

contexts.japanese: 謝ってばっかりだけど
contexts.english: I know it's really pushing it

findings.description: Shaking off the voice behind him becomes turning to look back at it.
findings.sourceReading: 振り切って means escaping despite her call, while continuing into the corridor.
findings.explanation: Shaking off the voice behind him becomes turning to look back at it.

contexts.japanese: 背中にかかるあくまの声を振り切って
contexts.english: turning to look back at the devil's voice

findings.description: Moving desks to the four corners becomes arranging them in groups of four.
findings.sourceReading: 四隅 is the four corners of the room, used by the girls to avoid the noisy central group.
findings.explanation: Moving desks to the four corners becomes arranging them in groups of four.

contexts.japanese: 机を四隅に寄せていく
contexts.english: move their desks into fours.

findings.description: The classmates still want Shirou's food, but the English replaces the joke that his lunch determines cafeteria attendance with a request that he join them.
findings.sourceReading: Whether Shirou brings a packed lunch substantially changes who joins the cafeteria group.
findings.explanation: The classmates still want Shirou's food, but the English replaces the joke that his lunch determines cafeteria attendance with a request that he join them.

contexts.japanese: おまえが弁当かどうかで学食組が激変する
contexts.english: Why don't you switch sides from the home lunch to the cafeteria team?

findings.description: Two more repetitions of the echo becomes twice the volume.

findings.explanation: Two more repetitions of the echo becomes twice the volume.

contexts.japanese: 俺の時より二回も多い
contexts.english: Her voice echoed twice as loud.

findings.explanation: Harmfulness beneath apparent harmlessness becomes crook-like daring combined with naïveté.

contexts.japanese: 無害さを装った有害さ
contexts.english: as daring as a crook while simultaneously being so naïve it hurts!

contexts.english: Who else besides me would invite you out here?

findings.explanation: Wondering whether to avoid Shinji for a while becomes finding another way that will not involve Sakura.

contexts.japanese: しばらくは顔を合わせない方がいいのだろうか
contexts.english: I need to think of another way that won't involve Sakura.

findings.explanation: The English changes extra energy into Taiga's usual cheerfulness. Her unusually early arrival remains, but Shirou's observation that she is livelier than normal is lost.

contexts.english: she's as chipper as ever.

findings.explanation: Arching his back to move his face away becomes shying from Rin’s reach.

contexts.japanese: 背をエビ反りにして遠坂から顔を離す
contexts.english: I shy away from Tohsaka's reach.

contexts.japanese: いささか買いすぎたきらいはある

findings.explanation: Rejecting the relevance of a like-or-dislike question becomes not knowing his own feelings.

contexts.japanese: 好きか嫌いかもないだろう
contexts.english: I don't even know how to feel about that!

contexts.english: cross him off our list of people to watch

findings.explanation: Fear of what Saber will do on a lapse becomes a completed beating when Taiga let her guard down.

contexts.english: She pounded me flat as soon as I let my guard down

findings.description: Nobody collecting his corpse becomes no corpse remaining to collect.
findings.sourceReading: 死して屍拾うものなし leaves a dead body with no collector, rather than annihilating it.
findings.explanation: Nobody collecting his corpse becomes no corpse remaining to collect.

contexts.japanese: 死して屍拾うものなし
contexts.english: won't even have a corpse left to collect

findings.description: Stacking phone books into a platform becomes slamming a phone book on a table.
findings.sourceReading: 電話帳を重ねて台にする describes the inferred noise of assembling a height aid behind him.
findings.explanation: Stacking phone books into a platform becomes slamming a phone book on a table.

contexts.japanese: 電話帳を重ねて台にするような物音
contexts.english: a phone book being slammed on a table

findings.description: Passing out in the sleeper hold becomes falling physically.
findings.sourceReading: 本気で落ちる follows an effective neck choke; he then separately protests transition into a throw and narrates fading consciousness.
findings.explanation: Passing out in the sleeper hold becomes falling physically.

contexts.japanese: 本気で落ちる
contexts.english: I'm really gonna fall!

findings.description: Being dropped nearly vertically becomes being bent into a right angle.
findings.sourceReading: 直角に落とされ describes the throw’s downward angle, not a bend in his body.
findings.explanation: Being dropped nearly vertically becomes being bent into a right angle.

contexts.japanese: ほぼ直角に落とされながら
contexts.english: Bent nearly at a right angle

findings.description: Not yet having asked Sakura becomes an unfinished claim about what she is going to do.
findings.sourceReading: それはこれから answers whether he has told her: that is still to come.
findings.explanation: Not yet having asked Sakura becomes an unfinished claim about what she is going to do.

contexts.japanese: いや、それはこれから
contexts.english: But she's going to

findings.description: Escorting unwell students home becomes sending the students home.
findings.sourceReading: 体調悪い子たちを家まで送って identifies illness and personal transport/escort, explaining the early club departure.
findings.explanation: Escorting unwell students home becomes sending the students home.

contexts.japanese: 体調悪い子たちを家まで送って
contexts.english: after sending the students home.

findings.description: Her vanished gloomy shadow becomes a vanished physical bruise.
findings.sourceReading: 朝の暗い翳り follows the facial swelling observation but refers to morning emotional gloom, opposed to her present good mood.
findings.explanation: Her vanished gloomy shadow becomes a vanished physical bruise.

contexts.japanese: 朝の暗い翳り
contexts.english: the dark bruise from this morning.

findings.description: The rising chill already absent becomes the vital tremble of life gone.
findings.sourceReading: 悪寒 is a chill/shudder rising from the throat, no longer felt as his innards change.
findings.explanation: The rising chill already absent becomes the vital tremble of life gone.

contexts.japanese: 喉元よりせりあがる悪寒も既にない
contexts.english: The vital tremble of life has already left his throat.

findings.description: Unable to hold his sword becomes simply lacking a weapon.
findings.sourceReading: 長刀を持つ事もならない locates inability in his ruined body, denying even suicide.
findings.explanation: Unable to hold his sword becomes simply lacking a weapon.

contexts.japanese: もはや長刀を持つ事もならない
contexts.english: Without a weapon

findings.description: His organs becoming another being’s organs becomes just morphing into something else.
findings.sourceReading: まったく別の何者かの内臓 identifies the replacement as the internal organs of a different entity being born inside him.
findings.explanation: His organs becoming another being’s organs becomes just morphing into something else.

contexts.japanese: まったく別の何者かの内臓に変わっていく
contexts.english: morph into something else.

findings.description: A request for continuing care becomes thanks for past teaching.
findings.sourceReading: ご指導よろしくお願いします is the grandfather’s reported request for the teacher’s guidance/care during the stay.
findings.explanation: A request for continuing care becomes thanks for past teaching.

contexts.japanese: ご指導よろしくお願いしますだって
contexts.english: thanked me for teaching you.

findings.description: Blushing would disqualify him as her senior becomes simply not embarrassing himself.
findings.sourceReading: そういう後輩に照れてたら先輩失格 ties sexual self-consciousness to failure of his senior role; Taiga repeats 失格 and he then invokes responsibility for a friend’s sister.
findings.explanation: Blushing would disqualify him as her senior becomes simply not embarrassing himself.

contexts.japanese: 後輩に照れてたら先輩失格
contexts.english: I wouldn't embarrass myself in front of her like that!

contexts.japanese: 士郎は失格したくないんだ
contexts.english: you don't want to embarrass yourself

findings.description: Sakura having no need to worry over the old incident becomes Shirou denying attraction.
findings.sourceReading: 桜が気にする事でもない locates unnecessary concern in Sakura after he recounts her guilt-related assistance.
findings.explanation: Sakura having no need to worry over the old incident becomes Shirou denying attraction.

contexts.japanese: 桜が気にする事でもないのに
contexts.english: It's not like I see her that way.

findings.description: Guiding Sakura to her prepared room becomes letting her stay.
findings.sourceReading: 部屋に案内しよう is the next physical action after cleaning, while lodging has already been agreed.
findings.explanation: Guiding Sakura to her prepared room becomes letting her stay.

contexts.japanese: 桜を部屋に案内しよう
contexts.english: Then I can let Sakura stay here.

findings.description: Quickly pouring and gulping tea becomes fragrant liquid soothing his throat.
findings.sourceReading: じゃー and ざーっと喉に流し込んだ give an abrupt flow matching his attempt to shake off fantasy.
findings.explanation: Quickly pouring and gulping tea becomes fragrant liquid soothing his throat.

contexts.japanese: ざーっと喉に流し込んだ
contexts.english: let the fragrant liquid soothe my throat.

findings.description: Scrabbling at her chest becomes clutching it.
findings.sourceReading: 胸を掻きむしる fingers claw/scratch insistently, a stronger action than the earlier 胸の中心を掴む.
findings.explanation: Scrabbling at her chest becomes clutching it.

contexts.japanese: 苦しげに胸を掻きむしる指
contexts.english: her fingers clutching painfully at her chest

findings.description: Hair stuck to her forehead becomes hair on her cheek.
findings.sourceReading: 額 locates the sweat-stuck hair on her forehead as it falls and she opens her eyes.
findings.explanation: Hair stuck to her forehead becomes hair on her cheek.

contexts.japanese: 額に張り付いていた髪
contexts.english: The hair stuck to her cheek

findings.description: Sitting up from under the covers becomes jumping out of bed.
findings.sourceReading: 布団から飛び起きて is rapidly rising from reclining to explain herself; she remains at the bed for the subsequent conversation and instruction to lie down.
findings.explanation: Sitting up from under the covers becomes jumping out of bed.

contexts.japanese: 布団から飛び起きて
contexts.english: Sakura jumps out of bed

findings.description: Shirou sitting on the floor and leaning against the bed becomes entering the bed and lying down.
findings.sourceReading: 床に腰を下ろす followed by 背中はベッドに預ける places him on the floor with his back resting against the bed, physically separated from her.
findings.explanation: Shirou sitting on the floor and leaning against the bed becomes entering the bed and lying down.

contexts.japanese: 床に腰を下ろす
contexts.english: I sit down on the bed.

contexts.japanese: 背中はベッドに預けてしまう
contexts.english: Then, I lie down on my back.

findings.description: Raising and waving one hand becomes gesturing to her spot on the bed.
findings.sourceReading: 片手をヒラヒラとあげて is a light hand wave while speaking without turning.
findings.explanation: Raising and waving one hand becomes gesturing to her spot on the bed.

contexts.japanese: 片手をヒラヒラとあげて
contexts.english: I gesture to her spot on the bed

findings.description: Two figures looking identical becomes two figures being perfect for each other.
findings.sourceReading: うり二つ denotes extreme visual likeness, which makes the beautiful sisters appear like twins in this vision.
findings.explanation: Two figures looking identical becomes two figures being perfect for each other.

contexts.japanese: 双子のようにうり二つ
contexts.english: so perfect for each other they might as well be twins

findings.description: Being unsteadily drawn toward the scene becomes the predator draining its prey.
findings.sourceReading: ふらふらと吸い寄せられる is passive attraction, continuing the narrator’s movement into the classroom before his attempt to rescue Mitsuzuri.
findings.explanation: Being unsteadily drawn toward the scene becomes the predator draining its prey.

contexts.japanese: ふらふらと吸い寄せられる
contexts.english: It giddily drains its prey of life.

findings.description: Softening tissue, melting below the neck, and removing bones are weakened to seepage, flow, and limpness.
findings.sourceReading: 柔らかくふやかしていく, 溶かされて, and 骨が抜かれていた continue bodily dissolution beyond general fluid entry.
findings.explanation: Softening tissue, melting below the neck, and removing bones are weakened to seepage, flow, and limpness.

contexts.japanese: 骨を、筋肉を、皮膚を柔らかくふやかしていく
contexts.english: It seeps into my bones, muscles, and skin.

contexts.japanese: 首から下もどんどんと溶かされて
contexts.english: It flows down from my neck

contexts.japanese: 骨が抜かれていた
contexts.english: turning it limp.

findings.description: Only moans escaping his melted throat becomes inability even to moan.
findings.sourceReading: 呻きしか漏れない excludes every sound except moaning; his throat has already melted.
findings.explanation: Only moans escaping his melted throat becomes inability even to moan.

contexts.japanese: 喉はもう溶けて、呻きしか漏れない
contexts.english: It floods my throat, and I can't even moan.

findings.description: Shirou's report that breakfast is mostly prepared becomes a report that cleanup has just finished, changing the work Sakura finds him doing.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says he has mostly dealt with making breakfast, answering Sakura's question about that task.
findings.explanation: Shirou's report that breakfast is mostly prepared becomes a report that cleanup has just finished, changing the work Sakura finds him doing.

contexts.japanese: だいたい片付けた
contexts.english: I just finished cleaning up.

findings.description: A blood-vomiting image describing Caster's anguished laughter becomes an assertion that she actually coughs blood.
findings.sourceReading: Caster laughs as though vomiting blood, following her bitter response to the accusation that she killed Souichirou.
findings.explanation: A blood-vomiting image describing Caster's anguished laughter becomes an assertion that she actually coughs blood.

contexts.japanese: 血を吐くように笑う
contexts.english: She coughs blood as she laughs.

findings.description: Going missing from tonight becomes taking his last breath tonight.
findings.sourceReading: 消息を絶ち、生死不明のまま describes his public disappearance and unknown life/death status before eventual forgetting.
findings.explanation: Going missing from tonight becomes taking his last breath tonight.

contexts.japanese: 今夜を限りに消息を絶ち
contexts.english: Tonight, he took his last breath

findings.description: Feeling reluctant to leave becomes physical tingling behind him.
findings.sourceReading: 後ろ髪を引かれる感覚 is the idiom of lingering attachment/reluctance after he tries to remember the corpse.
findings.explanation: Feeling reluctant to leave becomes physical tingling behind him.

contexts.japanese: 後ろ髪を引かれる感覚
contexts.english: the nagging tingling from behind me

findings.description: The swamp consuming the body and its red bloodstain becomes the swamp’s red mass spreading to consume the body.
findings.sourceReading: 男の動かぬ身体と粘つく紅い染み are the paired objects being swallowed by the floor.
findings.explanation: The swamp consuming the body and its red bloodstain becomes the swamp’s red mass spreading to consume the body.

contexts.japanese: 男の動かぬ身体と粘つく紅い染みを平らげていく
contexts.english: its crimson mass spreading out to consume the man's unmoving body.

findings.description: A soul-like thing that formed Caster becomes a soul modeled after Caster.
findings.sourceReading: キャスターを象っていた魂とも言えるもの is the soul-like thing that constituted/shaped the Servant, not a copy patterned on an already separate Caster.
findings.explanation: A soul-like thing that formed Caster becomes a soul modeled after Caster.

contexts.japanese: キャスターを象っていた魂とも言えるもの
contexts.english: The soul modeled after the Servant Caster

findings.description: Zouken's almost visible killing intent becomes hostility in the surrounding insects. His chuckle remains, but the direct description of his murderous intent is lost.
findings.sourceReading: The old insect-user laughs with killing intent so palpable that it seems visible.
findings.explanation: Zouken's almost visible killing intent becomes hostility in the surrounding insects. His chuckle remains, but the direct description of his murderous intent is lost.

contexts.japanese: 目に見えるほどの殺気を伴って笑う
contexts.english: the mass of hostile bugs.

findings.description: No resistance felt in the blow becomes feeling he did not hit Zouken.
findings.sourceReading: 手応えはなかった describes the ease/lack of physical resistance as the next line shows the cut body split like a tomato.
findings.explanation: No resistance felt in the blow becomes feeling he did not hit Zouken.

contexts.japanese: 手応えはなかった
contexts.english: It doesn't feel like I got him.

findings.description: Crawling solely with his arms becomes using knee position and foot stumps to escape.
findings.sourceReading: 這いつくばったまま、両腕だけで ... 出ようと試みる explicitly limits propulsion to the arms after both feet detach.
findings.explanation: Crawling solely with his arms becomes using knee position and foot stumps to escape.

contexts.japanese: 両腕だけでぬかるみから出ようと試みる
contexts.english: On my hands and knees, I try to escape the bog on the remaining stumps of my feet.

findings.description: Rapid loss of heat/color becomes pain as if bleeding.
findings.sourceReading: 急速に熱を失っていく with いろ ruby layers fading heat and color after the attempted recall.
findings.explanation: Rapid loss of heat/color becomes pain as if bleeding.

contexts.japanese: 急速に熱を失っていく
contexts.english: It hurts where the Command Spells are, almost like I'm bleeding there.

findings.description: A dagger aimed between his eyebrows becomes one aimed at his groin.
findings.sourceReading: 眉間 is the brow, distinct from the separately named abdomen in the four targets.
findings.explanation: A dagger aimed between his eyebrows becomes one aimed at his groin.

contexts.japanese: 眉間と喉、心臓と腹部
contexts.english: my groin, throat, heart, and stomach

findings.description: Never mind and kill that interferer too becomes indifference toward them and kill all obstructors.
findings.sourceReading: かまわぬわ dismisses the complication; そやつも directs Assassin to kill Rider too if she interferes.
findings.explanation: Never mind and kill that interferer too becomes indifference toward them and kill all obstructors.

contexts.japanese: ええい、かまわぬわアサシン！　邪魔をするのならそやつも始末せい！
contexts.english: Damn it. They mean nothing to me, Assassin! Kill all who would stand in my way!

findings.description: Cannot pull it out becomes Fool.
findings.sourceReading: 抜ケ、ヌ is Assassin’s interrupted report that he cannot extract the lodged dagger; the next narration names that attempt.
findings.explanation: Cannot pull it out becomes Fool.

contexts.japanese: 抜ケ、ヌ
contexts.english: Fool—ngh!?

findings.description: Rolling down from the mountain gate becomes rolling to a stop at it.
findings.sourceReading: 山門から転がり落ちていった continues his fall beyond/down from the gate after bouncing through the yard.
findings.explanation: Rolling down from the mountain gate becomes rolling to a stop at it.

contexts.japanese: 山門から転がり落ちていった
contexts.english: rolls to a stop at the mountain gate

findings.description: Normalizing longstanding hazards becomes claiming unprecedented current safety.
findings.sourceReading: He calls those incidents ordinary and argues that, if they mean danger, he has been in danger all along.
findings.explanation: Normalizing longstanding hazards becomes claiming unprecedented current safety.

contexts.japanese: そんなの全然普通じゃんか。それで危ないってんなら、今までずっと危なかったよ俺は
contexts.english: Well, I'm doing just fine. If anything, I'm safer now then I've ever been before.

findings.description: The indispensable disposition in which Shirou is unsurpassed becomes refusing to let himself lose.
findings.sourceReading: それだけは他の誰にも負けない identifies the one quality where he is unsurpassed; Rin subsequently defines it as other-directed striving and self-hatred.
findings.explanation: The indispensable disposition in which Shirou is unsurpassed becomes refusing to let himself lose.

contexts.japanese: それだけは他の誰にも負けない、彼が一番たり得るところよ
contexts.english: he won't let himself lose to anyone.

findings.description: Only being able to watch her leave becomes being unable even to see her.
findings.sourceReading: 去っていく遠坂凛を見つめる事しかできない describes his immobilized watching, with the next sentence explaining why he cannot attack.
findings.explanation: Only being able to watch her leave becomes being unable even to see her.

contexts.japanese: 去っていく遠坂凛を見つめる事しかできない
contexts.english: can't even see the departing Rin anymore.

findings.description: Believing he is full inside becomes believing he is stuck.
findings.sourceReading: 詰まっている contrasts supposed inner substance with the preceding empty interior and following inflated balloon.
findings.explanation: Believing he is full inside becomes believing he is stuck.

contexts.japanese: 詰まっているように思えるのは本人だけ
contexts.english: You're the only one who thinks you're stuck

findings.description: Going out into the corridor becomes exiting the corridor.
findings.sourceReading: 廊下に出て identifies the corridor as the destination on the way to the rear temple.
findings.explanation: Going out into the corridor becomes exiting the corridor.

contexts.japanese: 廊下に出て寺の裏側に向かう
contexts.english: We exit the corridor and head for the back of the temple.

findings.description: Loud footsteps become faint but firm footsteps.
findings.sourceReading: 足音は高く describes their high/loud sound, as Shirou hears her recede.
findings.explanation: Loud footsteps become faint but firm footsteps.

contexts.japanese: 足音は高く
contexts.english: Saber's footsteps are faint but firm.

findings.description: Disregarding appearances becomes disregarding whether escape is futile.
findings.sourceReading: なりふりなど構わない means appearances or decorum no longer matter in the attempt to escape.
findings.explanation: Disregarding appearances becomes disregarding whether escape is futile.

contexts.japanese: なりふりなど構わない
contexts.english: It doesn't matter if it's a futile gesture.

findings.description: That was your mistake becomes that is certainly true.
findings.sourceReading: それが間違い rejects her one-on-one premise before contrasting her one with their two.
findings.explanation: That was your mistake becomes that is certainly true.

contexts.japanese: そう、それが間違いだ
contexts.english: That's certainly true.

findings.description: An arm unable even to strike becomes an arm only able to strike.
findings.sourceReading: 相手を殴りつける事さえできまい is the initial judgment of the apparently nonfunctional folded limb, before it unfolds.
findings.explanation: An arm unable even to strike becomes an arm only able to strike.

contexts.japanese: 相手を殴りつける事さえできまい
contexts.english: All it can do is dumbly strike his opponent.

findings.description: Having never said he would withdraw becomes having said nothing about fighting or forfeiting.
findings.sourceReading: まだ戦うつもりも何も dismisses the question of still fighting because he never said he was quitting.
findings.explanation: Having never said he would withdraw becomes having said nothing about fighting or forfeiting.

contexts.japanese: まだ戦うつもりも何も、降りるなんて言った覚えはないからだ
contexts.english: I still haven't said anything about fighting or forfeiting the war.

findings.description: Rider's earnest request to repeat the thanks becomes Shirou's thought that she will hear him. The change removes his observation of how seriously she receives the unexpected gratitude.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou remarks that Rider is earnestly asking what he just said, adding to his embarrassment about thanking her.
findings.explanation: Rider's earnest request to repeat the thanks becomes Shirou's thought that she will hear him. The change removes his observation of how seriously she receives the unexpected gratitude.

contexts.japanese: まじめに聞いてくるし
contexts.english: Because she'll hear me, after all.

findings.description: Touching her forehead becomes touching her cheek.
findings.sourceReading: 額に手を当てる tests the heat at her forehead after a chill.
findings.explanation: Touching her forehead becomes touching her cheek.

contexts.japanese: 額に手を当てる
contexts.english: touches her cheek.

findings.description: Sinking into heat becomes trying to gather the warmth by drawing face and hands inward.
findings.sourceReading: 熱に沈む describes being immersed in the heat affecting face, fingers and body.
findings.explanation: Sinking into heat becomes trying to gather the warmth by drawing face and hands inward.

contexts.japanese: 顔を、指を、身体を熱くする熱に沈む
contexts.english: She brings her face and hands in, trying to ball up the warmth heating her body.

findings.description: Self-reproach cooling the arousal-like heat becomes awakening it.
findings.sourceReading: 熱を覚まして is cooling here, fixed by preceding25 cooling through contrition and the immediate26 next line saying 熱が冷めても.
findings.explanation: Self-reproach cooling the arousal-like heat becomes awakening it.

contexts.japanese: 自責の念が、どこか昂奮に似た熱を覚ましていった
contexts.english: Her guilty conscience awakened a fever that was somehow like arousal.

contexts.japanese: 熱が冷めても
contexts.english: Even though the fever has cooled

findings.description: Being unable to judge at this stage becomes finding it unremarkable.
findings.sourceReading: この段階ではなんとも言えん suspends a judgment before distinguishing unprecedented scale from manageable cover-up if it stops.
findings.explanation: Being unable to judge at this stage becomes finding it unremarkable.

contexts.japanese: この段階ではなんとも言えん
contexts.english: It's still unremarkable at this stage.

findings.description: Extraction amount predicted to exceed limits in a few more days becomes victim count already exceeding expectations.
findings.sourceReading: あと数日ほどで規定量を超える forecasts future excessive extraction; the preceding row says its amount increases daily.
findings.explanation: Extraction amount predicted to exceed limits in a few more days becomes victim count already exceeding expectations.

contexts.japanese: 二日前から始まったこの異常搾取は、あと数日ほどで規定量を超える
contexts.english: The number of bizarrely drained victims that began to appear two days ago has exceeded expectations in only a manner of days.

findings.description: Discoloring fingernails scratching his throat become nails scratching the throat red.
findings.sourceReading: 喉を掻き毟る爪が変色している makes the claws/nails the thing changing color in the heat.
findings.explanation: Discoloring fingernails scratching his throat become nails scratching the throat red.

contexts.japanese: 喉を掻き毟る爪が変色している
contexts.english: my nails scratching it red.

findings.description: Heat at the forehead becomes heat on his cheeks.
findings.sourceReading: 額に熱さを感じる specifies the forehead after waking.
findings.explanation: Heat at the forehead becomes heat on his cheeks.

contexts.japanese: 額に熱さを感じながら
contexts.english: still feeling the heat on my cheeks.

findings.description: Sweat-soaked nightclothes feeling unpleasant become a wish to prevent the sheets getting soaked.
findings.sourceReading: 寝巻きは汗を吸って気持ち悪い describes an already wet garment’s present discomfort.
findings.explanation: Sweat-soaked nightclothes feeling unpleasant become a wish to prevent the sheets getting soaked.

contexts.japanese: 寝巻きは汗を吸って気持ち悪い
contexts.english: I don't want my sheets to soak it up and get all gross

findings.description: A joke about urgent laundry protecting Shirou's household standing becomes a joke about purification and choosing silence. The feared social consequence changes.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou imagines urgently bleaching and spin-drying the evidence to avoid losing his standing to speak in the household.
findings.explanation: A joke about urgent laundry protecting Shirou's household standing becomes a joke about purification and choosing silence. The feared social consequence changes.

contexts.japanese: すみやかに漂白・脱水しなくては今後の発言権に支障をきたす
contexts.english: My first priority is to purify myself and then exercise my right to silence.

findings.description: A food stall appearing in the shopping district becomes a bakery.
findings.sourceReading: 出没する屋台 describes a stall, with takoyaki alongside taiyaki and dorayaki.
findings.explanation: A food stall appearing in the shopping district becomes a bakery.

contexts.japanese: 商店街に出没する屋台さん
contexts.english: a bakery in the shopping district

findings.description: Shirou's thought that Sakura is welcome to eat becomes a statement about her appetite, removing his reassurance that she need not hold back.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks Sakura need not hold back: he has no objection to her eating the dorayaki.
findings.explanation: Shirou's thought that Sakura is welcome to eat becomes a statement about her appetite, removing his reassurance that she need not hold back.

contexts.japanese: どら焼きの一つや二つ、いくら食べても構わない
contexts.english: She's always ready for a dorayaki or two.

findings.description: Not listening to nonsense becomes failing to understand a joke.
findings.sourceReading: 戯言はもちろん耳に入ってこない dismisses her haughty lecture while he remains angry.
findings.explanation: Not listening to nonsense becomes failing to understand a joke.

contexts.japanese: そんな戯言はもちろん耳に入ってこない
contexts.english: the joke goes over my head.

findings.description: Her refusal to forgive him becomes a prohibition on talking to him.
findings.sourceReading: 話せるのは楽しいけど、やっぱり許してなんてあげない contrasts enjoyable conversation with her own continued unforgiving hostility.
findings.explanation: Her refusal to forgive him becomes a prohibition on talking to him.

contexts.japanese: やっぱり許してなんてあげない
contexts.english: It's fun talking to you, but I'm not supposed to.

findings.description: Being unable to choose either impulse becomes having to choose one.
findings.sourceReading: どっちかを取るなんてできない explicitly denies her ability to choose between talking and hostility.
findings.explanation: Being unable to choose either impulse becomes having to choose one.

contexts.japanese: どっちかを取るなんてできない
contexts.english: I have to choose one.

findings.description: Illya being different from the maids becomes simply their serving her.
findings.sourceReading: 私たちとは違うお方 gives Sella’s asserted distinction between Illya and themselves as her reason for proper address.
findings.explanation: Illya being different from the maids becomes simply their serving her.

contexts.japanese: イリヤスフィール様は私たちとは違うお方です
contexts.english: We serve Lady Illyasviel.

findings.description: Even specialists do not use transfer offensively becomes an exception allowing specialists.
findings.sourceReading: わたしや遠坂の魔術師でさえ、攻撃になんて使わない includes Illya and Tohsaka specialists in those avoiding offensive use because success is too low.
findings.explanation: Even specialists do not use transfer offensively becomes an exception allowing specialists.

contexts.japanese: 転移を得意とするわたしや遠坂の魔術師でさえ、攻撃になんて使わない
contexts.english: most mages wouldn't use it offensively, unless they're specialists like me or the Tohsakas.

findings.description: Shirou glaring at Illya while holding the bag becomes Illya looking at his shopping bag.
findings.sourceReading: スーパーのビニール袋を手に、キッとイリヤを睨みつける has Shirou holding groceries and glaring at her before her curious stare back.
findings.explanation: Shirou glaring at Illya while holding the bag becomes Illya looking at his shopping bag.

contexts.japanese: スーパーのビニール袋を手に、キッとイリヤを睨みつける
contexts.english: Illya shoots a glance at the shopping bag in my hand.

findings.description: Fear he will dislike her if forced becomes her disliking coercion as a principle.
findings.sourceReading: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃう gives her fear of being disliked as the reason to leave despite not wanting to.
findings.explanation: Fear he will dislike her if forced becomes her disliking coercion as a principle.

contexts.japanese: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃう
contexts.english: I don't like forcing people to do things.

findings.description: Questioning his own lack of anger becomes knowing better than to say it.
findings.sourceReading: 自分でもどうかと思うけど doubts the appropriateness of his not being angry.
findings.explanation: Questioning his own lack of anger becomes knowing better than to say it.

contexts.japanese: 自分でもどうかと思うけど、怒ってない
contexts.english: I should know better than to say this, but I'm not mad.

findings.description: Wait without expectations becomes do not wait.
findings.sourceReading: 期待しないで待っててね asks him to wait while not expecting her, matching the deliberately coy conditional offer.
findings.explanation: Wait without expectations becomes do not wait.

contexts.japanese: 期待しないで待っててね
contexts.english: Don't wait for me, though.

findings.description: Replacement of the head or controlling authority becomes someone switching heads with Caster.
findings.sourceReading: 頭をすげ替えられた is the replacement-of-leadership idiom, offered as another explanation for the changed site after her death.
findings.explanation: Replacement of the head or controlling authority becomes someone switching heads with Caster.

contexts.japanese: 頭をすげ替えられたって線もある
contexts.english: someone might have switched heads with her.

findings.description: Pain failing to stop him becomes pain driving him into flight.
findings.sourceReading: 痛みで止まらねえんなら explains why a disabling cut would have been preferable: pain does not immobilize him.
findings.explanation: Pain failing to stop him becomes pain driving him into flight.

contexts.japanese: 痛みで止まらねえんなら
contexts.english: if I'd known the pain would drive him into flight.

findings.description: Putting that tactic off becomes having to clean up a mess.
findings.sourceReading: つい後回しにしちまった says he deferred the method because it does not work on the others.
findings.explanation: Putting that tactic off becomes having to clean up a mess.

contexts.japanese: つい後回しにしちまった
contexts.english: now I have to clean up this mess.

findings.description: A left-thigh strike becomes cleaving from the left hip.
findings.sourceReading: 左足大腿部 identifies the left thigh as his aimed strike, interrupted by his retreat.
findings.explanation: A left-thigh strike becomes cleaving from the left hip.

contexts.japanese: 水蜘蛛の左足大腿部を一閃しかけ
contexts.english: cleave the fleeing water strider from the left hip

findings.description: The full-rune defense failing even to delay becomes barely slowing the encroachment.
findings.sourceReading: 足止めにさえならない denies even a delaying effect despite the defense’s Noble Phantasm resistance.
findings.explanation: The full-rune defense failing even to delay becomes barely slowing the encroachment.

contexts.japanese: 足止めにさえならない
contexts.english: they barely even manage to slow the thing down.

findings.description: Acquiring lacking intelligence becomes acquiring knowledge.
findings.sourceReading: 経験不足 and 足りない知能 distinguish experience from intellectual capacity the attacker wants to supplement.
findings.explanation: Acquiring lacking intelligence becomes acquiring knowledge.

contexts.japanese: タリナい知能ヲ、補ワネバ
contexts.english: I wiLL gAIN THE KNOWlEdGe I lack.

findings.description: Feigning indifference until sensing an enemy becomes feigning helplessness to lure one out.
findings.sourceReading: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装う keeps a collective indifferent appearance until detecting enemy presence.
findings.explanation: Feigning indifference until sensing an enemy becomes feigning helplessness to lure one out.

contexts.japanese: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装おう
contexts.english: I'll act helpless until we lure out an enemy.

findings.description: Pedestrian traffic having ceased becomes merely fewer people than usual.
findings.sourceReading: 人通りが途絶えている says traffic has stopped, matching the deserted station and terminal.
findings.explanation: Pedestrian traffic having ceased becomes merely fewer people than usual.

contexts.japanese: 人通りが途絶えているだけだ
contexts.english: There are just fewer people out than usual.

findings.description: Physical depletion becomes despondency.
findings.sourceReading: 眠気にも似た虚脱感 follows reconsideration of bodily recovery and motivates resting, then lethargic bedding preparation.
findings.explanation: Physical depletion becomes despondency.

contexts.japanese: 眠気にも似た虚脱感
contexts.english: a sense of despondency that feels similar to drowsiness.

findings.description: Laying out a futon becomes lifting bedcovers.
findings.sourceReading: 布団を敷いて is spreading the bedding before collapsing into it.
findings.explanation: Laying out a futon becomes lifting bedcovers.

contexts.japanese: 布団を敷いて
contexts.english: lift up the bed covers

findings.description: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou notices that Sakura has lowered her face for some unexplained reason, then asks whether she feels unwell.
findings.explanation: Sakura's lowered face becomes her standing in Shirou's way. His ensuing question about her health loses its stated visual cue.

contexts.japanese: なぜか、桜は俯いていた
contexts.english: Sakura is in my way.

findings.description: Grating daikon becomes peeling it.
findings.sourceReading: 摩り下ろしていた names the cooking operation he stops to inspect the entrance.
findings.explanation: Grating daikon becomes peeling it.

contexts.japanese: 摩り下ろしていた大根
contexts.english: the daikon I've been peeling

findings.description: A flushed face with fever not apparently much higher becomes a worsening fever with other body parts unchanged.
findings.sourceReading: 顔は熱で上気したまま and 熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそう distinguish continuing facial flush from apparent fever degree.
findings.explanation: A flushed face with fever not apparently much higher becomes a worsening fever with other body parts unchanged.

contexts.japanese: 顔は熱で上気したままだったが、熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそうだ
contexts.english: The fever appears to have worsened, though the rest of her body doesn't feel any warmer.

findings.description: The English keeps the broken-VCR joke but changes “I'd sooner fix that” into “this is like fixing that,” softening the heater's exaggerated difficulty.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou had complained that he would sooner repair Taiga's bisected VCR than tackle the heater.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the broken-VCR joke but changes “I'd sooner fix that” into “this is like fixing that,” softening the heater's exaggerated difficulty.

contexts.japanese: あんなの直すぐらいなら藤ねえが真っ二つにしたビデオデッキを直すぞ
contexts.english: This is like asking me to fix the VCR that Fuji-nee cut in half!

findings.description: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.
findings.sourceReading: 迷惑をかけてばかりですけど……反省したんですよ continues her first-person acknowledgment of troubling him and reflecting she truly did something bad earlier.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.

contexts.japanese: さっきのは、ほんとに悪いコトをしたんだなあって反省したんですよ
contexts.english: I hope you realize that you were out of line earlier.

findings.description: Helping the weak and defeating the strong becomes being strong and helping the weak.
findings.sourceReading: 弱きを助け強きをくじく pairs protection with resistance to the strong.
findings.explanation: Helping the weak and defeating the strong becomes being strong and helping the weak.

contexts.japanese: 弱きを助け強きをくじく
contexts.english: someone strong who helps the weak.

findings.description: Reflecting on himself in embarrassment becomes regretting everything he ever did.
findings.sourceReading: 我が身を振り返っちまう and 恥ずかしい say praise makes him look back at himself and feel embarrassed.
findings.explanation: Reflecting on himself in embarrassment becomes regretting everything he ever did.

contexts.japanese: 我が身を振り返っちまう
contexts.english: regret everything I've ever done.

findings.description: An unresolved search for the meaning of his solitary survival becomes an achieved sense of purpose through helping others. This changes why Shirou says he kept himself constantly occupied.
findings.sourceReading: He ran around town searching for meaning in having been the only one saved.
findings.explanation: An unresolved search for the meaning of his solitary survival becomes an achieved sense of purpose through helping others. This changes why Shirou says he kept himself constantly occupied.

contexts.japanese: 一人だけ助かった意味を探して
contexts.english: found meaning in helping as many people as I could

findings.description: Being liable to mistake her for a model student despite knowing her nature becomes immunity to being fooled because he knows.
findings.sourceReading: 本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない says the disguise is so convincing it might fool even him.
findings.explanation: Being liable to mistake her for a model student despite knowing her nature becomes immunity to being fooled because he knows.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない
contexts.english: I know who you really are, so you can't fool me with that overachiever image.

findings.description: Shirou freezing because he did not understand the reason becomes him wondering why Rider froze.
findings.sourceReading: 理由が分からなくて固まってた is his answer that he was stalled by not understanding her concern.
findings.explanation: Shirou freezing because he did not understand the reason becomes him wondering why Rider froze.

contexts.japanese: 理由が分からなくて固まってた
contexts.english: I just wasn't sure why you froze up.

findings.description: A shirt hem becomes a sleeve.
findings.sourceReading: 桜 grasps the shirt’s hem to detain him.
findings.explanation: A shirt hem becomes a sleeve.

contexts.japanese: シャツの裾
contexts.english: my shirt sleeve

findings.description: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.
findings.sourceReading: The quoted 嬉しいかって is the question he asked about her feeling at Rin’s stay, identified by31 and repeated to her in32.
findings.explanation: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんがここで寝泊りするようになって嬉しいかって
contexts.english: I said that you looked happy when she decided to sleep over.

contexts.japanese: 桜にとって今の状況がどんなものなのか、それを聞いていたんだっけ
contexts.english: I was listening to Sakura talk about our current living situation.

findings.description: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.
findings.sourceReading: Both 姉さんにも自分にも are perceived sources of accusation; 気がして preserves Sakura’s feeling rather than authenticating Rin’s blame.
findings.explanation: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにも自分にも、何をしてるんだって責められてる気がして
contexts.english: no matter what she or I do, it ends up with her scolding me.

findings.description: Feeding only on other people’s pain becomes only causing pain.
findings.sourceReading: 他人の痛みしか糧にせず specifies parasitic sustenance; lack of teaching to return joy contrasts extraction with beneficence.
findings.explanation: Feeding only on other people’s pain becomes only causing pain.

contexts.japanese: 他人の痛みしか糧にせず、他人の喜びを還元する教えがない
contexts.english: All they do is cause people pain without showing them how to be happy again.

findings.description: Self-disgust becomes a guilty conscience.
findings.sourceReading: 嫌悪感 directed toward herself follows abhorrence of imposed Matou arts.
findings.explanation: Self-disgust becomes a guilty conscience.

contexts.japanese: 自分に対して嫌悪感を抱いてしまう
contexts.english: the worse her guilty conscience gets.

findings.description: Inability to solve the root problem and a plan to consult Rider become no help and Rider’s possible ideas.
findings.sourceReading: 根本的な解決 limits the inability to fundamental resolution; Sakura then undertakes to ask Rider later for an idea.
findings.explanation: Inability to solve the root problem and a plan to consult Rider become no help and Rider’s possible ideas.

contexts.japanese: 間桐の魔術じゃ根本的な解決はできないから、今度、ライダーにいいアイデアがないか聞いてみますね
contexts.english: I can't help you with the Matou magecraft, but Rider might have some good ideas...

findings.description: Shirou’s stunned observation becomes Illya staring at him.
findings.sourceReading: The first-person narrator watches Illya before describing her; she has also separately observed him, mentioned in12.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s stunned observation becomes Illya staring at him.

contexts.japanese: 呆然と、目の前にいるイリヤを観察する
contexts.english: Illya is staring at me.

findings.description: An involuntary stirring of his chest becomes feeling ashamed.
findings.sourceReading: 不覚にも胸が is interrupted by her teasing, which brakes his racing heart.
findings.explanation: An involuntary stirring of his chest becomes feeling ashamed.

contexts.japanese: 不覚にも胸が
contexts.english: feel ashamed

findings.description: The room’s occupant becomes the person in charge of the house.
findings.sourceReading: 部屋の主 refers to the adolescent whose room she entered.
findings.explanation: The room’s occupant becomes the person in charge of the house.

contexts.japanese: 部屋の主たる思春期の少年
contexts.english: adolescent young man who's in charge of this house.

findings.description: Replicating viewed armaments for his own use becomes replicating any weapon as swords.
findings.sourceReading: 複製し自らの剣とする concerns using copied armaments as his own weapons;36 explicitly retains replication of any viewed weapon.
findings.explanation: Replicating viewed armaments for his own use becomes replicating any weapon as swords.

contexts.japanese: 視認した“武装”を複製し自らの剣とする
contexts.english: replicates any weapon he sees as swords...

findings.description: Departure to the veranda becomes departure into a hallway.
findings.sourceReading: 縁側 identifies the veranda-side space.
findings.explanation: Departure to the veranda becomes departure into a hallway.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは縁側へ去っていく
contexts.english: Illya leaves into the hallway.

findings.description: Illya’s own difficulty becomes difficulty for Shirou dealing with her.
findings.sourceReading: イリヤはイリヤで、やっぱり大変なんだ recognizes her separate predicament; he finds responding to that difficult.
findings.explanation: Illya’s own difficulty becomes difficulty for Shirou dealing with her.

contexts.japanese: イリヤはイリヤで、やっぱり大変なんだ
contexts.english: Illya is who she is, and this isn't easy for me.

findings.description: Rin's observation that the scene has not been cleaned becomes a claim that Zouken cannot clean it. Her conclusion that he was absent survives, but its stated evidential basis changes.
findings.sourceReading: Rin points to the unfinished cleanup as evidence that Zouken was absent: he would not have left body parts behind.
findings.explanation: Rin's observation that the scene has not been cleaned becomes a claim that Zouken cannot clean it. Her conclusion that he was absent survives, but its stated evidential basis changes.

contexts.japanese: 後片付けが出来てないでしょ
contexts.english: Because he can't clean this up.

findings.description: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.
findings.sourceReading: She had proposed installing a circuit switch and now cancels that plan because making easy on/off possible would endanger him.
findings.explanation: Rin canceling her proposed switch installation becomes warning Shirou not to flip a switch.

contexts.japanese: この前は士郎の体にスイッチをいれようって言ってたけど、アレは止めるわ
contexts.english: You've talked about flipping a switch in your body before, but don't do that this time.

contexts.japanese: ここで簡単に魔術回路の開閉ができるようになったら
contexts.english: You'll be in danger if you open and close your Magic Circuits carelessly.

findings.description: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.
findings.sourceReading: 腹に当てられた手 is current abdominal contact, already hard to bear; a small rodlike object passes through skin into his body.
findings.explanation: The current palm on his abdomen becomes the earlier palm on his chest, with added digging around.

contexts.japanese: 腹に当てられた遠坂の手の平だけでも耐えられない
contexts.english: Tohsaka's palm on my chest was unbearable enough, but now something small and stick-like is under my skin, digging around inside my body...!

findings.description: Sakura rebuking his fluster at her sister becomes Sakura rebuking herself.
findings.sourceReading: As his girlfriend she says it is wrong for HIM to get flustered around her sister;39 explicitly asks him to restrain it.
findings.explanation: Sakura rebuking his fluster at her sister becomes Sakura rebuking herself.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにドキマギするのおかしいですっ
contexts.english: I'm just being weird for letting my sister get to my head!

findings.description: A dish everyone can share becomes a light lunch.
findings.sourceReading: みんなでつつける proposes shared eating from communal food.
findings.explanation: A dish everyone can share becomes a light lunch.

contexts.japanese: みんなでつつけるようなもの
contexts.english: something light for lunch.

findings.description: Rin immediately correcting Sakura’s errors becomes Sakura worrying she has erred.
findings.sourceReading: 桜が何か失敗するとすぐ注意をする keeps Rin as the correcting actor; her constant attention under brusqueness is then inferred.
findings.explanation: Rin immediately correcting Sakura’s errors becomes Sakura worrying she has erred.

contexts.japanese: 桜が何か失敗するとすぐ注意をする
contexts.english: Sakura immediately worries she's done something wrong.

findings.description: Normally disregarding others’ circumstances becomes being open and unreserved.
findings.sourceReading: 人の事情なんてお構いなし contrasts ordinary uninhibited disregard with special romantic/familial reserve here.
findings.explanation: Normally disregarding others’ circumstances becomes being open and unreserved.

contexts.japanese: 普段は人の事情なんてお構いなし
contexts.english: usually so open and unreserved

findings.description: Not being able to do everything Rin can becomes not being able to do anything as she can.
findings.sourceReading: なんでもできるワケじゃない denies all-capability, not all competence.
findings.explanation: Not being able to do everything Rin can becomes not being able to do anything as she can.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんみたいになんでもできるワケじゃない
contexts.english: I can't do anything like she can.

findings.description: The empty room being equivalent to a facade nameplate becomes unchanged ownership of the door name.
findings.sourceReading: ここは……表札と変わらない compares room to the externally displayed name, explaining its merely formal role.
findings.explanation: The empty room being equivalent to a facade nameplate becomes unchanged ownership of the door name.

contexts.japanese: ここは玄関にかけられた、間桐桜という表札と変わらない
contexts.english: It won't change the fact that her name is the one on the door.

findings.description: Scratching or tearing at sheets becomes tearing them off.
findings.sourceReading: 掻き毟る is violent clawing/tearing at the fabric.
findings.explanation: Scratching or tearing at sheets becomes tearing them off.

contexts.japanese: シーツを掻き毟る
contexts.english: He tears off the bedsheets.

findings.description: An order of confinement or disciplinary restriction becomes a warning to restrain himself.
findings.sourceReading: 謹慎を申し付けている is an imposed disciplinary restriction.
findings.explanation: An order of confinement or disciplinary restriction becomes a warning to restrain himself.

contexts.japanese: 謹慎を申し付けている
contexts.english: warned Shinji to restrain himself.

findings.description: Illya eating only the potatoes becomes there having been no potatoes.
findings.sourceReading: She bites sweet-cooked potatoes, and he regrets her taking only potato pieces from the meat-and-potato dish.
findings.explanation: Illya eating only the potatoes becomes there having been no potatoes.

contexts.japanese: 肉じゃがなのにじゃがいもだけをつつかれる
contexts.english: It's too bad that I didn't have any potatoes on hand

contexts.japanese: 甘く煮たじゃがいもを頬ばるイリヤ
contexts.english: Illya is enjoying a mouth full of savory sweet beef stew.

findings.description: Three extra helpings become asking for a third helping.
findings.sourceReading: おかわりを三杯 is three refills beyond the initial serving, an achieved appetite demonstration.
findings.explanation: Three extra helpings become asking for a third helping.

contexts.japanese: おかわりを三杯
contexts.english: She even asked for a third helping.

findings.description: Not like Tohsaka becomes so like Tohsaka.
findings.sourceReading: 遠坂らしくない describes her unusually strained performance compared with normally effortless dismissals.
findings.explanation: Not like Tohsaka becomes so like Tohsaka.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂らしくない
contexts.english: That's so like Tohsaka.

findings.description: Reported treatment as an accident becomes not treating it as an accident.
findings.sourceReading: 事件じゃなく事故 explicitly contrasts criminal incident with accident in the public treatment she reports.
findings.explanation: Reported treatment as an accident becomes not treating it as an accident.

contexts.japanese: 世間じゃ事件じゃなく事故って扱いみたい
contexts.english: They aren't treating it as an accident.

findings.description: Which body parts are missing becomes where the bodies are.
findings.sourceReading: 体の何処がなくなった concerns absent bodily portions along with identities.
findings.explanation: Which body parts are missing becomes where the bodies are.

contexts.japanese: 誰が死んで体の何処がなくなったのか
contexts.english: who died or where the bodies are

findings.description: Separated blackened patches become bloodstains apart from blackened ground.
findings.sourceReading: 黒ずんだ地面が離れている means the darkened areas are separated from one another, probably through escape attempts.
findings.explanation: Separated blackened patches become bloodstains apart from blackened ground.

contexts.japanese: 黒ずんだ地面が離れている
contexts.english: They're some distance from the blackened ground

findings.description: Head pressed to tatami becomes head tucked into his stomach.
findings.sourceReading: 頭を畳に押し付けたまま maintains contact with the floor after the actual head impact in11.
findings.explanation: Head pressed to tatami becomes head tucked into his stomach.

contexts.japanese: 頭を畳に押し付けたまま
contexts.english: tuck my head into my stomach

findings.description: Awareness fragmenting becomes a mental ordeal.
