findings.sourceReading: 意識がボロボロと欠けた describes disintegrating consciousness after only slight loosening and shoulder exposure.
findings.explanation: Awareness fragmenting becomes a mental ordeal.

contexts.japanese: 意識がボロボロと欠けた
contexts.english: was enough of mental ordeal.

findings.description: Forgetting how to look back one second becomes forgetting how he felt then.
findings.sourceReading: He cannot recall the METHOD of directing his thought one second backward, not merely the contents of a feeling.
findings.explanation: Forgetting how to look back one second becomes forgetting how he felt then.

contexts.japanese: 一秒前に思いを馳せる、という方法が思い出せなかった
contexts.english: I can't remember how I was feeling just a second ago.

findings.description: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.
findings.sourceReading: 人の手が入りまくった頭 describes his mind having other people’s intervention throughout, echoing invasive/cooking reconstruction imagery.
findings.explanation: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.

contexts.japanese: お節介なまでに人の手が入りまくった頭
contexts.english: My useless head, that only knows how to help other people so much it's a nuisance

findings.description: A more vigorous blood flow becomes brighter blood.
findings.sourceReading: 景気よく qualifies the amount/strength of blood emerging.
findings.explanation: A more vigorous blood flow becomes brighter blood.

contexts.japanese: 思ったより景気よく血が出てくる
contexts.english: Blood leaks out, brighter than I expected.

findings.description: Realizing she herself can do it becomes thinking an it might do it for her.
findings.sourceReading: 自分にはソレが出来る assigns the capacity to her, with ソレ the elimination she imagined.
findings.explanation: Realizing she herself can do it becomes thinking an it might do it for her.

contexts.japanese: 自分にはソレが出来るコトに気がついた
contexts.english: she naturally thought that it might be able to do it for her.

findings.description: Being bedridden for life becomes sleeping forever.
findings.sourceReading: 一生寝たきり follows possible inability to use limbs; she could accept bodily disability but not loss of self.
findings.explanation: Being bedridden for life becomes sleeping forever.

contexts.japanese: 手足がきかなくなって、一生寝たきりでも怖くはない
contexts.english: She isn't afraid of falling asleep forever.

findings.description: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願う modifies the person whose happiness SHE wishes, whom she fears ruining for her own happiness.
findings.explanation: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願うただ一人の人間
contexts.english: the one and only person who wants her to become happy.

findings.description: Not relaxing his guard becomes not forgiving.
findings.sourceReading: 気を許す concerns letting his vigilance/trust loosen toward Sakura’s tormentor.
findings.explanation: Not relaxing his guard becomes not forgiving.

contexts.japanese: 少しでも気を許すものか
contexts.english: I don't have an ounce of forgiveness

findings.description: His head cooling rapidly becomes his brain grinding to a halt.
findings.sourceReading: 冷めていく describes anger/heat cooling as the realization takes shape.
findings.explanation: His head cooling rapidly becomes his brain grinding to a halt.

contexts.japanese: 頭が急速に冷めていく
contexts.english: My brain grinds to a halt.

findings.description: Inability to communicate with the shadow becomes uncertainty whether it thinks independently.
findings.sourceReading: 意思疎通 concerns mutual communication, not the absence of autonomous thought.
findings.explanation: Inability to communicate with the shadow becomes uncertainty whether it thinks independently.

contexts.japanese: アレと意思疎通など出来るものか
contexts.english: I'm not sure it's even capable of thinking on its own.

findings.description: Preparing its path to prevent rampage becomes preparing a path for rampage.
findings.sourceReading: 暴れださぬよう is explicit negative purpose in Zouken’s professed damage control.
findings.explanation: Preparing its path to prevent rampage becomes preparing a path for rampage.

contexts.japanese: アレが暴れださぬよう道を整えていた
contexts.english: I simply laid out a path for its rampage.

findings.description: Giving its existence form on this side becomes modeling itself after creatures on this side.
findings.sourceReading: 桜を原型にし assigns Sakura as prototype; こちら側での存在を象った says it shapes existence here.
findings.explanation: Giving its existence form on this side becomes modeling itself after creatures on this side.

contexts.japanese: こちら側での存在を象ったモノにすぎぬ
contexts.english: It has merely modeled itself after the creatures on this side.

findings.description: What sustained Shirou becomes something he rejects, instead of something that now rejects him. The change alters the direction of his internal accusation.
findings.sourceReading: What has sustained him would turn against and negate him if he allowed the tragedy to recur.
findings.explanation: What sustained Shirou becomes something he rejects, instead of something that now rejects him. The change alters the direction of his internal accusation.

contexts.japanese: 今までおまえを支えてきたモノが、おまえ自身を否定する
contexts.english: you'd be rejecting everyone and everything that's supported you this far.

findings.description: Preparing the household bath becomes getting ready to take a bath.
findings.sourceReading: 風呂の準備してくる is an offered chore alongside taking care of laundry while Rin cooks.
findings.explanation: Preparing the household bath becomes getting ready to take a bath.

contexts.japanese: 風呂の準備してくる
contexts.english: I should get ready to take a bath.

findings.description: A failed attempt to turn the lights on becomes never touching the switch.
findings.sourceReading: スイッチ入れてもつかない says they will not light even with the switch on.
findings.explanation: A failed attempt to turn the lights on becomes never touching the switch.

contexts.japanese: スイッチ入れてもつかない
contexts.english: I didn't touch the light switch.

findings.description: Having no way to defeat the shadow directly becomes choosing the most direct method.
findings.sourceReading: 直接倒す手段がないのなら is a conditional lack of a direct means, leading to the obscured action against Sakura.
findings.explanation: Having no way to defeat the shadow directly becomes choosing the most direct method.

contexts.japanese: 直接、あの影を倒す手段がないのなら
contexts.english: The most direct way to defeat it

findings.description: An eruption compared more to an explosion than to water becomes a geyser of water. The violent image survives, but the source's contrast disappears.
findings.sourceReading: The red eruption suggests an explosion more than a discharge of water.
findings.explanation: An eruption compared more to an explosion than to water becomes a geyser of water. The violent image survives, but the source's contrast disappears.

contexts.japanese: 吹き出す赤は、放水より爆発を思わせる
contexts.english: The gushing red reminds me of a sudden geyser of water.

findings.description: Leaving people to die becomes killing them directly.
findings.sourceReading: 見殺し identifies failure to save in his self-accusation.
findings.explanation: Leaving people to die becomes killing them directly.

contexts.japanese: 多くの人間を見殺しにした正義の味方
contexts.english: A "hero" who will kill many people tonight

findings.description: Her interruption while he withdraws the raised knife becomes while he leaves the room.
findings.sourceReading: ナイフを戻そうとした瞬間 locates her speech at the attempted safe return of the blade, before departure.
findings.explanation: Her interruption while he withdraws the raised knife becomes while he leaves the room.

contexts.japanese: ナイフを戻そうとした瞬間
contexts.english: Just as I try to leave the room...

findings.description: Remembering how she came to sleep beside him becomes remembering only that they slept together.
findings.sourceReading: 経緯 identifies the circumstances/process leading to her being next to him, which alone he retains amid identity failure.
findings.explanation: Remembering how she came to sleep beside him becomes remembering only that they slept together.

contexts.japanese: 隣で桜が眠っている経緯だけは憶えている
contexts.english: all I remember is that we went to sleep next to each other.

findings.description: Lost time when trying to think becomes getting lost in thought.
findings.sourceReading: 深く考えようとすると十秒後の世界にいる describes finding himself ten seconds further on when attempting thought.
findings.explanation: Lost time when trying to think becomes getting lost in thought.

contexts.japanese: 深く考えようとすると十秒後の世界にいる
contexts.english: I end up getting lost in thought for ten seconds.

findings.description: The outdoor gate becomes the front door.
findings.sourceReading: 門 near the property boundary is distinct from the interior house doorway; her shoes remain at the entrance while she collapsed outside.
findings.explanation: The outdoor gate becomes the front door.

contexts.japanese: 門の近くで倒れていた桜
contexts.english: Sakura who had collapsed near the front door

contexts.japanese: なんで門の前でなんか倒れてたのかな
contexts.english: why you were on the ground in front of the door.

findings.description: Thought refusing thought becomes mutually contradictory thoughts.
findings.sourceReading: 思考が思考を拒絶 describes thinking refusing the attempt to think, immediately followed by a missing interval his body remembers.
findings.explanation: Thought refusing thought becomes mutually contradictory thoughts.

contexts.japanese: 思考が思考を拒絶している
contexts.english: My thoughts deny each other.

findings.description: Trying to remain the Sakura she has always been becomes at least living life.
findings.sourceReading: 今まで通りの間桐桜であろうとする ties her domestic role to preserving her familiar self when powerless.
findings.explanation: Trying to remain the Sakura she has always been becomes at least living life.

contexts.japanese: せめて今まで通りの間桐桜であろうとする
contexts.english: She wants to at least live life, even if she can't do anything about our situation.

findings.description: Projection identical to the original becomes intended reproductions treated the same.
findings.sourceReading: 複製でありながら本物と同一のもの asserts the defining identity despite copying.
findings.explanation: Projection identical to the original becomes intended reproductions treated the same.

contexts.japanese: 本物と同一のもの
contexts.english: are meant to be reproductions that are treated the same as their originals.

findings.description: Single-minded purity becomes a simpler life.
findings.sourceReading: 純粋 praises the purity of dedicating oneself without calculating outcomes.
findings.explanation: Single-minded purity becomes a simpler life.

contexts.japanese: どんなに純粋な事なんだろう
contexts.english: Life would probably be a lot simpler

findings.description: Inability to think through circumstances becomes inability to remember details.
findings.sourceReading: 考えるコトも出来ない concerns reasoning through different circumstances.
findings.explanation: Inability to think through circumstances becomes inability to remember details.

contexts.japanese: 色んな経緯を考えるコトも出来ない
contexts.english: I can't remember the details anymore

findings.description: No room for the Grail’s own soul becomes inability to hold all Servant souls.
findings.sourceReading: 聖杯自体の魂 is the vessel’s own personality/soul, excluded by containing seven; next20 explains personality erasure.
findings.explanation: No room for the Grail’s own soul becomes inability to hold all Servant souls.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯”自体の魂の入る余地なんてない
contexts.english: The container can't hold all of them.

findings.description: No particular wish becomes never having said it before.
findings.sourceReading: これといってない says nothing specific she wants after thinking.
findings.explanation: No particular wish becomes never having said it before.

contexts.japanese: なんか、これといってないみたいです
contexts.english: I don't think I've ever said this before, actually.

findings.description: Not knowing what she ought to obtain becomes not knowing how to aspire.
findings.sourceReading: 得るべきもの and 手に入れなくてはならないもの are unknown objects/opportunities, in deprivation of normal life.
findings.explanation: Not knowing what she ought to obtain becomes not knowing how to aspire.

contexts.japanese: 得るべきもの、手に入れなくてはならないものを、桜は知らないまま
contexts.english: Sakura doesn't know what it means to aspire to something, or to feel the need to obtain something.

findings.description: Sensing his current intent becomes general knowledge of what a killer feels like.
findings.sourceReading: 自分を殺す為にやってきた事は空気でわかる identifies why this visitor came from the atmosphere.
findings.explanation: Sensing his current intent becomes general knowledge of what a killer feels like.

contexts.japanese: 自分を殺す為にやってきた事は空気でわかる
contexts.english: She knows what it feels like when someone comes to kill her.

findings.description: No need to check becomes need to check thoroughly.
findings.sourceReading: 確認とる必要なかったじゃない is explicit negated necessity, irritated that Illya failed to disclose existing knowledge.
findings.explanation: No need to check becomes need to check thoroughly.

contexts.japanese: いちいち確認とる必要なかったじゃない
contexts.english: we need to thoroughly check that out.

findings.description: His Projection exceeds ordinary level becomes his problem being more basic.
findings.sourceReading: そういうレベルの話じゃない distinguishes his Projection’s special status from ordinary-mage Projection, leading to correction of methods.
findings.explanation: His Projection exceeds ordinary level becomes his problem being more basic.

contexts.japanese: 貴方の投影はそういうレベルの話じゃない
contexts.english: your problem is more basic than that.

findings.description: Strengthening an existing object by Projection becomes Strengthening a Projection.
findings.sourceReading: 元からあるものを is the object; 投影で is the means; 強化する the operation.
findings.explanation: Strengthening an existing object by Projection becomes Strengthening a Projection.

contexts.japanese: 元からあるものを“投影”で“強化”する
contexts.english: 'strengthen' a Projection of something that already exists.

findings.description: Rin’s prohibition on removing cloth becomes no compulsion to remove it.
findings.sourceReading: 決して外させない means she will never permit his taking the cloth off, unpacking the arm-use ban.
findings.explanation: Rin’s prohibition on removing cloth becomes no compulsion to remove it.

contexts.japanese: 決して聖骸布を外させない
contexts.english: I wouldn't make you take off the shroud.

findings.description: Denial of yielding to happy atmosphere becomes avoiding spoiling the mood.
findings.sourceReading: 幸せそうな雰囲気に折れたワケではない denies atmosphere as the reason for not criticizing; next actually-tastes-good supplies his justification.
findings.explanation: Denial of yielding to happy atmosphere becomes avoiding spoiling the mood.

contexts.japanese: その幸せそうな雰囲気に折れたワケではない
contexts.english: Wouldn't want to ruin the mood.

findings.description: Feeling he saw this news long ago becomes the event ought to have happened long ago.
findings.sourceReading: 見たような気がする is déjà-vu perception of having seen the report.
findings.explanation: Feeling he saw this news long ago becomes the event ought to have happened long ago.

contexts.japanese: とっくの昔に見たような気がして
contexts.english: The story they're talking about should have happened a long time ago

findings.description: Not only that problem becomes that is not the problem.
findings.sourceReading: それだけじゃない adds missing people to already alarming area expansion.
findings.explanation: Not only that problem becomes that is not the problem.

contexts.japanese: 問題はそれだけじゃない
contexts.english: But that isn't the problem.

findings.description: Leaving two in the dojo becomes two sisters leaving it.
findings.sourceReading: Rin leaves Shirou and Illya inside; Sakura is already outside and is refused entry3.
findings.explanation: Leaving two in the dojo becomes two sisters leaving it.

contexts.japanese: 二人を道場に残して中庭に出る。
contexts.english: The two sisters leave the dojo and enter the yard.

findings.description: Now ingredients fragment becomes why we are talking about food.
findings.sourceReading: いまから食材を begins a prospective action concerning ingredients, left incomplete;11 recalls shopping decision.
findings.explanation: Now ingredients fragment becomes why we are talking about food.

contexts.japanese: いまから食材を
contexts.english: why are we talking about food

findings.description: White arm becomes white-hot pain.
findings.sourceReading: 真っ白な modifies the arm; pain belongs to that white arm.
findings.explanation: White arm becomes white-hot pain.

contexts.japanese: あの、真っ白な腕の痛みで
contexts.english: that white-hot pain in my arm

findings.description: Calling to stop her becomes holding his breath.
findings.sourceReading: 呼び止める describes calling Illya, who answers.
findings.explanation: Calling to stop her becomes holding his breath.

contexts.japanese: 呼び止める。
contexts.english: I hold my breath.

findings.description: Constant suppression of a particular concern becomes occasional sullenness.
findings.sourceReading: ある事をずっと押し殺している means she has kept something suppressed since Archer disappeared; this concealment allows ordinary smiles.
findings.explanation: Constant suppression of a particular concern becomes occasional sullenness.

contexts.japanese: イリヤはある事をずっと押し殺している。
contexts.english: she's become sullen at times.

findings.description: As we are now becomes only starting now.
findings.sourceReading: 今のままでいい accepts the present relationship without replacement/family rearrangement.
findings.explanation: As we are now becomes only starting now.

contexts.japanese: 今のままでいいから
contexts.english: even if we're only starting now?

findings.description: An existing lookalike object reinforced through Projection becomes a Projection supplemented by more magecraft. This changes the method being contrasted with Shirou's complete mental construction.
findings.sourceReading: Ordinary Projection can be layered onto an object resembling the original to reinforce it. Shirou instead must construct everything through his own mental image.
findings.explanation: An existing lookalike object reinforced through Projection becomes a Projection supplemented by more magecraft. This changes the method being contrasted with Shirou's complete mental construction.

contexts.japanese: オリジナルに似せた物に“投影”を重ねて“補強”する事はできる。
contexts.english: Projection magecraft, can supplement a Projection that resembles the original to a degree.

findings.description: Temporary memory impairment becomes the loss of a fleeting memory fragment. This belongs with Shirou's threatened loss of self.
findings.sourceReading: Using the arm will cause more than the temporary memory impairment Shirou experienced earlier.
findings.explanation: Temporary memory impairment becomes the loss of a fleeting memory fragment. This belongs with Shirou's threatened loss of self.

contexts.japanese: さっきみたいな一時的な記憶の欠損なんかじゃすまされない。
contexts.english: It'll take more than a fleeting fragment of his memories.

findings.description: Anxiety at inability becomes defeat at stopping.
findings.sourceReading: 出来なくなる is losing capacity for routine action; 不安 is anxiety about that loss.
findings.explanation: Anxiety at inability becomes defeat at stopping.

contexts.japanese: 今まで当たり前のようにこなしていた事が出来なくなるのは、不安以外の何物でもない
contexts.english: how defeating it must feel to stop doing something she's done routinely

findings.description: Sakura does not register observers becomes observers not seeing her.
findings.sourceReading: 桜には俺たちが見えていない makes Sakura the impaired perceiver, absorbed in her repeated effort.
findings.explanation: Sakura does not register observers becomes observers not seeing her.

contexts.japanese: 桜には俺たちが見えていない。
contexts.english: we don't see it.

contexts.japanese: ……見えていない。
contexts.english: We're not looking.

findings.description: Her repeated normality claim becomes his internal reassurance about dinner.
findings.sourceReading: 自分はいつも通りだ、と訴えるように follows Sakura as subject repeating gestures as if insisting she is normal.
findings.explanation: Her repeated normality claim becomes his internal reassurance about dinner.

contexts.japanese: 自分はいつも通りだ、と訴えるように
contexts.english: I tell myself it's just dinner as usual

findings.description: Denial of anything wrong becomes admission everything wrong.
findings.sourceReading: どこも悪くなんかない emphatically denies illness/abnormality, followed by purported retained faculties.
findings.explanation: Denial of anything wrong becomes admission everything wrong.

contexts.japanese: わたし、どこも悪くなんかないんです！
contexts.english: I'm doing everything wrong!

findings.description: Recognizing his face becomes reading his face earlier.
findings.sourceReading: 先輩の顔だって判ります means she recognizes Shirou’s face, claimed alongside remembering yesterday.
findings.explanation: Recognizing his face becomes reading his face earlier.

contexts.japanese: 先輩の顔だって判ります
contexts.english: I could tell from your face earlier, too!

findings.description: Claimed present normality becomes perfect past conduct.
findings.sourceReading: 今まで通りで心配されるようなコトなんかない says she remains as usual and there is nothing requiring worry now.
findings.explanation: Claimed present normality becomes perfect past conduct.

contexts.japanese: わたしは今まで通りで心配されるようなコトなんかない。
contexts.english: I've never done anything to make you worry before

findings.description: Thinking herself healthy becomes wanting recovery.
findings.sourceReading: 元気なつもり acknowledges her belief she is well while Shirou asserts lingering fever.
findings.explanation: Thinking herself healthy becomes wanting recovery.

contexts.japanese: 桜は元気なつもりでも
contexts.english: I know you want to get better

findings.description: Asking whom it resembles becomes denying it resembles anyone.
findings.sourceReading: 似ているのは、誰と is inward question pressing recognition.
findings.explanation: Asking whom it resembles becomes denying it resembles anyone.

contexts.japanese: 似ているのは、誰と
contexts.english: It doesn't look like anyone.

findings.description: Denial of depletion becomes explanation of being tired and literal disgust.
findings.sourceReading: He denies loss of physical strength or anything taken, describing only nausea.
findings.explanation: Denial of depletion becomes explanation of being tired and literal disgust.

contexts.japanese: 体力がなくなったとかそういうんじゃない。
contexts.english: that's not why I'm feeling tired.

contexts.japanese: 単に気持ちが悪くなっただけで、奪われたものはないと思う
contexts.english: I was just feeling literally disgusted.

findings.description: Mud evidence excludes individual visits becomes past expectation excluding residue on every house.
findings.sourceReading: 町中に残った泥からして uses observed residue to infer it did not visit houses one by one.
findings.explanation: Mud evidence excludes individual visits becomes past expectation excluding residue on every house.

contexts.japanese: 町中に残った泥からして一軒一軒訪ねていった……なんて事じゃなかった筈よ。
contexts.english: Before, I wouldn't have expected to find its muddy dregs on each and every house.

findings.description: Trying not to hate the world becomes trying to save it.
findings.sourceReading: 嫌おうとせぬ/嫌わぬよう努める describe resisting hatred of the world because her ally lives in it.
findings.explanation: Trying not to hate the world becomes trying to save it.

contexts.japanese: この肉はな、健気にも世界を嫌おうとせぬ。
contexts.english: This meat nobly tries to save the world.

contexts.japanese: その味方が住む世界を嫌わぬよう努めておる
contexts.english: it endeavors to save the world its allies live in.

findings.description: Boy sustained victim’s unexpected growth becomes boy unexpectedly grew and survived.
findings.sourceReading: 予想外の成長 resumes the sacrificial subject6–8; boy 保たせてくれた kept it going so he should supply ending.
findings.explanation: Boy sustained victim’s unexpected growth becomes boy unexpectedly grew and survived.

contexts.japanese: 予想外の成長ではあったが、あそこまで保たせてくれたのだ。
contexts.english: He has grown more than expected, but managed to survive this long.

findings.description: No margin after next runaway episode becomes unknowable next timing.
findings.sourceReading: 次に暴走したら後がない warns another episode leaves no further chance.
findings.explanation: No margin after next runaway episode becomes unknowable next timing.

contexts.japanese: 次に暴走したら後がない
contexts.english: There's no telling when she might go out of control again.

findings.description: No memories of fear or pain becomes fear and pain might never have existed.
findings.sourceReading: 記憶がない expressly locates the easy ending in absence of recalled pain/fear, crucial to training gaps.
findings.explanation: No memories of fear or pain becomes fear and pain might never have existed.

contexts.japanese: 痛かったとか怖かったとか、そういう記憶がないぐらい
contexts.english: the pain and fear might well have never existed.

findings.description: Cannot save all becomes all beyond saving.
findings.sourceReading: みんなは救えない in context of only one choice means cannot save everyone; one remains savable in Illya’s pressure.
findings.explanation: Cannot save all becomes all beyond saving.

contexts.japanese: みんなは救えないよ
contexts.english: we were all beyond saving.

findings.description: She has not approached like earlier becomes she cannot be that earlier Sakura.
findings.sourceReading: 頬を染めて寄り添ってきたワケじゃない negates current blushing approach like previous replenishment occasion.
findings.explanation: She has not approached like earlier becomes she cannot be that earlier Sakura.

contexts.japanese: あの時のように、頬を染めて桜が寄り添ってきたワケじゃない。
contexts.english: She couldn't possibly be the Sakura that came onto me that one night.

findings.description: Must ask dream content becomes should not ask.
findings.sourceReading: 聞かなくてはいけないのに says he ought to ask but cannot speak; embrace substitutes avoidance.
findings.explanation: Must ask dream content becomes should not ask.

contexts.japanese: 聞かなくてはいけないのに。
contexts.english: I know I shouldn't ask what they were.

findings.description: Wanted repeated embraces now becomes repeated past occasions of wanting.
findings.sourceReading: 何度も modifies embracing until awareness ceases, enacted by 実際そうした next.
findings.explanation: Wanted repeated embraces now becomes repeated past occasions of wanting.

contexts.japanese: 意識が途切れるまで、何度も桜を抱きしめたかった。
contexts.english: There's been so many times I wanted to hug Sakura until I pass out.

findings.description: He is more unsatisfied than Sakura becomes he is the satisfied one.
findings.sourceReading: 桜以上に満ち足りず contrasts her apparent need with his greater unfulfilled hunger.
findings.explanation: He is more unsatisfied than Sakura becomes he is the satisfied one.

contexts.japanese: 桜以上に満ち足りずにいる。
contexts.english: I'm the one who's being satisfied.

findings.description: Mind and body consumed becomes heart and mind.
findings.sourceReading: 心も体も covers psychological and physical person, both entirely consumed.
findings.explanation: Mind and body consumed becomes heart and mind.

contexts.japanese: 心も体も、それで残らず食べてしまえる。
contexts.english: It eats up their heart and mind without leaving a single drop.

findings.description: A warning about becoming adapted or integrated turns into a warning that something will take a liking to Sakura. The Japanese leaves the precise direction of that adaptation unstated.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh warns that once adaptation or integration has occurred, Sakura will no longer be able even to die. The sentence leaves the subject of 馴染む unstated.
findings.explanation: A warning about becoming adapted or integrated turns into a warning that something will take a liking to Sakura. The Japanese leaves the precise direction of that adaptation unstated.

contexts.japanese: 馴染んでしまえば死ぬ事もできなくなる
contexts.english: Once it takes a liking to you, you won't even be able to do that.

findings.description: Pain like dying becomes desire to die.
findings.sourceReading: 死にそうなぐらい intensifies pain to near death, then urgent need to wake to avoid dying.
findings.explanation: Pain like dying becomes desire to die.

contexts.japanese: 死にそうなぐらい痛い
contexts.english: It hurts so much I want to die

findings.description: Bloody consciousness extinguished in alley becomes mind sinking into blood and floor.
findings.sourceReading: 血にまみれたまま is blood-covered condition; 消え去った describes consciousness vanishing without waking in dirty alley.
findings.explanation: Bloody consciousness extinguished in alley becomes mind sinking into blood and floor.

contexts.japanese: 女の意識は血にまみれたまま、覚める事なく、薄汚れた路地裏で消え去った。
contexts.english: The woman's mind sinks into a pool of blood and disappears into the dirty alley floor, never to wake again.

findings.description: Repudiating his struggle as wrong becomes rejecting its goal.
findings.sourceReading: 自らの戦いが間違っていたと否定し says Kiritsugu recognizes his own struggle was wrong.
findings.explanation: Repudiating his struggle as wrong becomes rejecting its goal.

findings.explanation: Known death becomes the possibility of death.

contexts.japanese: そこまで判っていて、自分だって殺されるって判っていて、桜をそんなものにしたいのか……！」
contexts.english: You know all that, including the possibility that you might be killed, and you still want Sakura to go through with it!?"

findings.description: Learned pleasure becomes learned recreation.
findings.sourceReading: 快楽 refers to increasingly advanced and complex pleasures in the account of learning happiness.
findings.explanation: Learned pleasure becomes learned recreation.

contexts.japanese: 生きれば生きるほど違う幸福を知り、より高度で複雑な快楽を学習する」
contexts.english: As they live, they learn of different types of happiness, and they learn more advanced and complicated types of recreation."

findings.description: No initial happiness becomes not necessarily born happy.
findings.sourceReading: Character categorically says humans too are not happy from the outset, then explains zero knowledge of happiness.
findings.explanation: No initial happiness becomes not necessarily born happy.

contexts.japanese: 「だが、人間とて初めから幸福である事はない。
contexts.english: "However, humans are not necessarily born happy.

findings.description: Becoming good or evil becomes distinguishing good and evil.
findings.sourceReading: Which branch a human takes, good or evil, depends on learning; responsibility then concerns environment and self.
findings.explanation: Becoming good or evil becomes distinguishing good and evil.

contexts.japanese: 「善か悪か。どちらに別れるかは人間の学習次第だ。
contexts.english: "Our ability to distinguish good and evil depends on our education.

findings.description: Changing Kirei's own way becomes changing Hell's nature.
findings.sourceReading: After calling this his own way of life, Kirei says changing himself is difficult even if Sakura gives birth to Hell. Base 己 and ruby ソレ support the self/way reference.
findings.explanation: Changing Kirei's own way becomes changing Hell's nature.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜から生まれ出るものが地獄であろうと、己を変える事こそ難しい」
contexts.english: Even if Sakura Matou gives birth to Hell itself, it would be difficult to change its nature."

contexts.japanese: 「—私は今までそのように生きてきた。
contexts.english: "That is how I have always lived.

contexts.japanese: この生き方は私の物だ。
contexts.english: This way of life is my own.

findings.description: Eleven years of worm-pit days become days eleven years ago.
findings.sourceReading: 十一年に渡る modifies the duration of the days of 壺毒, eleven years spanning the conditioning.
findings.explanation: Eleven years of worm-pit days become days eleven years ago.

contexts.japanese: だが耐えよ。おまえの体は耐えられるとも。思い出すがよい、十一年に渡る壺毒の日々を！
contexts.english: But bear with it. Your body can take it. Remember the days you spent in the kodoku jar eleven years ago!

findings.description: The English assigns leaving a name and becoming the original to Illya, although Zouken is explaining the skull-masked Assassin's wish. This belongs in a dossier about that character's identity.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken explains the skull-masked Assassin's wish to leave his own name in history and become an original, enduring as a record.
findings.explanation: The English assigns leaving a name and becoming the original to Illya, although Zouken is explaining the skull-masked Assassin's wish. This belongs in a dossier about that character's identity.

contexts.japanese: 「そう訝しがるでない。おぬしの求める聖杯はあちらの娘だ。歴史に名を残し、自らが本物になる。記録としての永遠を望むうぬの願いはアインツベルンが叶えてくれよう。
contexts.english: "Don't be so suspicious. She is the Holy Grail you seek. She will leave her name in history and become the original. The Einzberns can grant your wish of being recorded in history.

findings.description: The singular Servant just identified as Angra Mainyu becomes plural “Servants.” This changes the referent of the inherited power, rather than anyone’s form of address.
findings.sourceReading: Rin first names Angra Mainyu and then refers back to that Servant and the power Sakura inherited.
findings.explanation: The singular Servant just identified as Angra Mainyu becomes plural “Servants.” This changes the referent of the inherited power, rather than anyone’s form of address.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の中にいるサーヴァントも、その力を受け継いだアンタも、一緒になって死んでくれるんだ」
contexts.english: You'll die for us, along with the Servants in the Holy Grail, whose power you've inherited."

contexts.japanese: 「まあいいわ。どうやってアンリマユと刺し違える気か知らないけど、わたしが士郎を連れて逃げれば心置きなく自滅できるって事ね？
contexts.english: "Fine, whatever. I don't know how you plan to take Aŋra Mainiiu down with you, but you'll be free to kill yourself if Shirou and I leave, right?

findings.description: Rin's declared killing intention is assigned to both her and Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she will go and assuredly kill Sakura; Shirou has just rejected abandonment and mutual self-destruction and later explicitly calls his intention the opposite of Rin's.
findings.explanation: Rin's declared killing intention is assigned to both her and Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「行くわ。行って、確実にアンタを殺す」
contexts.english: "We're going over there. We're coming to kill you."

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、遠坂の逆だよ。俺は桜を助ける事で戦いを終わらせる。俺は、桜にとっての正義の味方になるって決めたからな」
contexts.english: "Yeah, I'm the opposite of you. I'm going to save Sakura and end this war. I promised that I'd be her hero."

findings.description: Shirou trusting Rin becomes Rin trusting Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: After thinking that Rin nevertheless wants to save Sakura, the narrator concludes that he can entrust the task to her with confidence.
findings.explanation: Shirou trusting Rin becomes Rin trusting Shirou.

contexts.japanese: なら—安心して任せられる。
contexts.english: And she feels comfortable trusting me to do it.

contexts.japanese: それでも、なんだかんだと遠坂は、桜を助けたがっている。
contexts.english: But Tohsaka still wants to help Sakura.

findings.description: Azoth modeled on jeweled sword becomes found similar blade.
findings.sourceReading: Rin supplies an Azoth sword deliberately made as like the jeweled sword as possible, combined with Projection and support.
findings.explanation: Azoth modeled on jeweled sword becomes found similar blade.

contexts.japanese: 出来るだけ宝石剣に似せたアゾット剣と、士郎の投影とイリヤのサポート。うまくいけばオリジナルの複製とはいかないけど、半分ぐらいは能力の再現ができる筈よ」
contexts.english: I did my best to find you an Azoth Blade similar to the Jeweled Sword, and Illya will be supporting your Projection. If this goes well, we won't be able to replicate the original, but we should get something with about half of its power."

findings.description: Return to room becomes return to Rin's own room.
findings.sourceReading: Rin proposes returning to a calm room and immediately turns toward the living room.
findings.explanation: Return to room becomes return to Rin's own room.

contexts.japanese: 「そうね。それじゃ部屋に戻りましょう。落ち着いた場所じゃないと成功率が落ちるでしょ」
contexts.english: "Yeah. Let's go back to my room, then. You need a quiet place for the best chance of success."

contexts.japanese: ほら、と居間に足を向ける遠坂。
contexts.english: Tohsaka beckons us to follow her to the living room.

findings.description: Crucial-moment clumsiness becomes highest comparative likelihood.
findings.sourceReading: Her lack of rebuttal suggests she cannot deny possible mistakes at the crucial moment.
findings.explanation: Crucial-moment clumsiness becomes highest comparative likelihood.

contexts.japanese: 反論しないあたり、本人もここ一番でドジをかます可能性を否定できないらしい。
contexts.english: But she doesn't deny that she's the person most likely to make careless mistakes.

findings.description: Damage beyond the concept of pain becomes mismatched bodily pain perception.
findings.sourceReading: Boy falls into layered revolving pain while self-damage eats him, damage to which even recognition as pain no longer applies.
findings.explanation: Damage beyond the concept of pain becomes mismatched bodily pain perception.

contexts.japanese: 痛みのない、痛みという認識はもはや該当しない自己の損傷に蝕まれながら、何重にも回転する痛みの中に落ちていく。
contexts.english: There's no pain. My pain perception plunges into layers of spinning pain, but it's eroded by damage to my body which doesn't correspond to the pain.

findings.description: The circuit's resemblance to a huge rotating observatory becomes a view of Arizona through a telescope, changing the image used to describe the ritual structure.
findings.sourceReading: The enormous circuit resembles an enormous observation apparatus rotating alone in the Arizona wilderness.
findings.explanation: The circuit's resemblance to a huge rotating observatory becomes a view of Arizona through a telescope, changing the image used to describe the ritual structure.

contexts.japanese: アリゾナの荒野に独りきりで回る、大きな大きな観測装置に酷似している。
contexts.english: It's like I'm looking out across the landscape of Arizona through a huge telescope.

findings.description: Diverting attention to extraneous matters becomes cutting attention away from them.
findings.sourceReading: He gave part of his attention to unnecessary things; because attention was divided, his perceived body halved.
findings.explanation: Diverting attention to extraneous matters becomes cutting attention away from them.

contexts.japanese: 余分な事に意識を割いた。意識を割いたから、体が半分になった。
contexts.english: I cut my consciousness off from the excess. Because I cut my mind, my body becomes half its size.

findings.description: Need to use another Projection becomes should not try.
findings.sourceReading: Boy corrects can manage another to must use it, to save Sakura by a method different from Rin's.
findings.explanation: Need to use another Projection becomes should not try.

contexts.japanese: —いや、使わなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: Not that I should try.

contexts.japanese: これなら、あと一回ぐらいはなんとか投影が使える。
contexts.english: I should be able to manage one more Projection.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とは違う方法で桜を救う。
contexts.english: I'm going to save Sakura using a different way than Tohsaka.

findings.description: Involuntary consciousness interruption becomes deliberate disconnection.
findings.sourceReading: Consciousness breaks, and before he knows it Rin has taken his bloody hand despite seeming slow.
findings.explanation: Involuntary consciousness interruption becomes deliberate disconnection.

contexts.japanese: 意識が断線して、いつのまにか血塗れの右手を掴まれていた。
contexts.english: I disconnect my mind and realize that she's holding my bloody right hand.

findings.description: Unassuming accessory becomes everyday sight.
findings.sourceReading: Pendant is small or modest for a jewel-user like Rin and can accent her beauty.
findings.explanation: Unassuming accessory becomes everyday sight.

contexts.japanese: 宝石使いである遠坂にはこじんまりとした物だが、遠坂は美人なんだから、こういう小物の方が本人を引き立たせていいと思う。
contexts.english: To a jewel-user like Tohsaka, this is probably an everyday sight. But she's so pretty, I bet an accessory like this would really liven her up.

findings.description: Negligible remaining amount becomes below every use threshold.
findings.sourceReading: Boy's pendant retains a little insignificant mana, and its having been used is meaningful.
findings.explanation: Negligible remaining amount becomes below every use threshold.

contexts.japanese: 「違うわ。わたしのは空っぽだけど、士郎のは少しだけ残ってる。取るに足りない量だけど、それでも、使われたからには意味があるんだわ」
contexts.english: "No, they're not. Mine's empty, but yours still has a little left in it. It isn't enough to use for anything, but... It has meaning because it was used."

findings.description: Arm-side carrying becomes on waist in separate departure variant.
findings.sourceReading: He wraps Azoth in cloth and carries it under or beside his arm.
findings.explanation: Arm-side carrying becomes on waist in separate departure variant.

contexts.japanese: アゾット剣を布で覆い、脇に抱える。
contexts.english: I wrap up the Azoth Blade and keep it on my waist.

findings.description: Oversleeping becomes simply falling asleep.
findings.sourceReading: He remembers sometimes being woken when he overslept in the storehouse.
findings.explanation: Oversleeping becomes simply falling asleep.

contexts.japanese: 寝坊した時、たまに起こされるコトもあった。
contexts.english: When I fell asleep here, sometimes she would come to wake me up.

findings.description: Prepare a trump card before departure becomes save trump card for battle.
findings.sourceReading: Repeated guidance is to prepare the trump card before heading to final battle, then asks why the player failed to do their best.
findings.explanation: Prepare a trump card before departure becomes save trump card for battle.

contexts.japanese: その通り！　最終決戦に向かう時は『切り札』を用意してから行けと、毎回毎回言っているのに何故ベストをつくさないのか！
contexts.english: Exactly! They've told you over and over to save your trump card for the final battle, so why aren't you bringing your best to this fight!?

findings.description: Single hidden anchor worm becomes a body composed of insects.
findings.sourceReading: His actual host is the hidden worm distinct from crushed forest swarm;15 explicitly 一匹 and16 identifies heart parasite.
findings.explanation: Single hidden anchor worm becomes a body composed of insects.

contexts.japanese: いかに神父の聖言とて、本体である虫を潰さねばこの老魔術師は滅びない。
contexts.english: Even the priest's holy words cannot destroy the old mage, as long as the insects that comprise his real body remain intact.

contexts.japanese: 少女の首を挿げ替えようと一匹の虫が蠢く。
contexts.english: A worm wriggles its way into the girl's neck.

contexts.japanese: その本体、腐敗する魂を繋ぎ止める依り代は、間桐桜の心臓に潜む擬似神経体だったのだ。
contexts.english: His real body, the host for his decaying soul, is the pseudo-nerves enervating Sakura Matou's heart.

findings.description: Heart-hidden pseudo-neural host becomes nerves enervating heart.
findings.sourceReading: Soul-host is a pseudo-neural entity concealed in Sakura's heart.
findings.explanation: Heart-hidden pseudo-neural host becomes nerves enervating heart.

contexts.japanese: その本体、腐敗する魂を繋ぎ止める依り代は、間桐桜の心臓に潜む擬似神経体だったのだ。
contexts.english: His real body, the host for his decaying soul, is the pseudo-nerves enervating Sakura Matou's heart.

findings.description: Crawling through vessels becomes vessels wriggling.
findings.sourceReading: Sound is something crawling along blood vessels as worm receives brain-eating command.
findings.explanation: Crawling through vessels becomes vessels wriggling.

contexts.japanese: ずるずると血管を這う音がする。
contexts.english: There is a slippery sound of wriggling blood vessels.

findings.description: Certain counterfactual consumption becomes might have eaten.
findings.sourceReading: Without priest's destruction of the other body she truly would have been eaten.
findings.explanation: Certain counterfactual consumption becomes might have eaten.

contexts.japanese: 「あの神父さんには感謝しないといけませんね。あの方がお爺さまを消してくださらなかったら、本当にわたしが食べられていたところだった」
contexts.english: "I should thank that priest. If he hadn't erased the rest of you, you might have really eaten me."

findings.description: Hierarchy remained until revolt becomes Sakura waited for rebellion time.
findings.sourceReading: Until this present revolt, unhidden takeover aim and her nonresistance made the old hierarchy unproblematic.
findings.explanation: Hierarchy remained until revolt becomes Sakura waited for rebellion time.

contexts.japanese: こうして—少女が老魔術師に反旗を翻すこの時までは。
contexts.english: So... she only had to wait until it was time to raise the flag of rebellion.

contexts.japanese: 老魔術師は己の目的を隠そうともせず、少女は老魔術師の意向に逆らわなかった。
contexts.english: The old mage never bothered to hide his objective, and the girl could not defy his will.

contexts.japanese: だから問題などなかったのだ。
contexts.english: So there was no problem.

findings.description: Rider's injuries inflicted by Saber become Saber's injuries healing.
findings.sourceReading: Rider spends resources on natural healing of body wounded by Saber.
findings.explanation: Rider's injuries inflicted by Saber become Saber's injuries healing.

contexts.japanese: セイバーによって傷つけられた体を癒す自然治癒。
contexts.english: Any of Saber's injuries are automatically healed.

findings.description: Ignoring future cost becomes foregone outcome.
findings.sourceReading: Rider gives no thought to afterward while burning all resources to contain Saber.
findings.explanation: Ignoring future cost becomes foregone outcome.

contexts.japanese: 後の事など考えない。
contexts.english: The conclusion seems forgone.

findings.description: Offense preventing Saber attack becomes Saber stopping Rider with attacks.
findings.sourceReading: Rider keeps attacking in order to prevent Saber taking initiative; if Saber attacks both Rider and boy die immediately.
findings.explanation: Offense preventing Saber attack becomes Saber stopping Rider with attacks.

contexts.japanese: ライダーは攻め続ける事で、セイバーの攻撃を防いでいる。
contexts.english: Rider keeps attacking, while Saber stops her with attacks of her own.

contexts.japanese: セイバーが攻撃に転ずれば、自分はおろか主である少年まで瞬殺されるだろう。
contexts.english: Rider knows that she and the boy she calls Master will be killed instantly if Saber goes on the offense.

findings.description: Dying throughout body becomes every part already dead.
findings.sourceReading: At this moment portions throughout his body are dying, in ongoing erasure.
findings.explanation: Dying throughout body becomes every part already dead.

contexts.japanese: いや、この瞬間、体のいたるところが死んでいる。
contexts.english: No, in this moment, every part of my body is dead.

findings.description: Right lung cut open becomes torn out.
findings.sourceReading: Right lung is cut or torn open from within.
findings.explanation: Right lung cut open becomes torn out.

contexts.japanese: 右の肺が、内側から切り裂かれた。
contexts.english: My right lung is torn out from inside.

findings.description: Potential centimeters to heart become enacted thrust depth.
findings.sourceReading: Blade at his back needs only a further push of a few centimeters to pierce heart.
findings.explanation: Potential centimeters to heart become enacted thrust depth.

contexts.japanese: わずか数センチ、一押しするだけで心臓を穿つ、冷酷な死の重み。
contexts.english: The cold weight of death pushes in only a few centimeters, stopping just short of my heart.

findings.description: Unknown perception becomes unknown knowledge.
findings.sourceReading: Stripped of objective/subjective orientation, he is ruled by unfamiliar perception.
findings.explanation: Unknown perception becomes unknown knowledge.

contexts.japanese: 客観と主観を剥ぎ取られ、未知の知覚に支配される。
contexts.english: The objective and subjective are stripped away. Unknown knowledge dominates me.

findings.description: Petals shattered by black light become petals scattering black light.
findings.sourceReading: Four wings/petals have been shattered by black aurora and scatter as the chamber fills white.
findings.explanation: Petals shattered by black light become petals scattering black light.

contexts.japanese: 黒い極光に打ち砕かれた四枚羽を撒き散らしながら、
contexts.english: Four petals scatter the black light,

findings.description: Broken shield petals become black-light-scattering petals in other branch.
findings.sourceReading: Four petals broken by black aurora scatter before white light wins.
findings.explanation: Broken shield petals become black-light-scattering petals in other branch.

contexts.japanese: 黒い極光に打ち砕かれた四枚羽を撒き散らしながら、
contexts.english: Four petals scatter the black light,

findings.description: Ninety-percent cancellation line absent from chain-opening English.
findings.sourceReading: Japanese says Saber's holy sword cancels nine tenths of Bellerophon's light.
findings.explanation: Ninety-percent cancellation line absent from chain-opening English.

contexts.japanese: ベルレフォーンの光はその九割を、セイバーの聖剣によって相殺された。

findings.description: Only eight days becomes fewer than eight days.
findings.sourceReading: まだ八日しか is only eight elapsed days; the next self-correction says already eight.
findings.explanation: Only eight days becomes fewer than eight days.

contexts.japanese: 彼女を失ったあの夜から、まだ八日しか経っていない。
contexts.english: Less than eight days have passed since the night I lost her.

contexts.japanese: ……いや、もう八日と言うべきか。
contexts.english: ...No, I guess it's already been that long.

findings.description: Finest feast becomes an appetizer.
findings.sourceReading: The ingredient/person Shirou brought was the finest feast, in her grotesque meal metaphor.
findings.explanation: Finest feast becomes an appetizer.

contexts.japanese: —ごちそうさま先輩。先輩が連れてきてくれた食材は、最高のご馳走でした」
contexts.english: Thank you for the meal, Senpai. You brought me the most delicious appetizer."

findings.description: Not taking a life becomes not endangering it.
findings.sourceReading: The dagger broke only the contract without taking Sakura's life.
findings.explanation: Not taking a life becomes not endangering it.

contexts.japanese: それは桜の命を奪わず、彼女を縛り付けていた契約だけを破戒した。
contexts.english: It doesn't endanger Sakura's life. It only breaks the contract she was bound to.

findings.description: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Body is beyond saving, but stopping now might preserve meaningful selfhood for about a day; the next line calls this one-day life extension.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Pain cannot stop memory loss becomes he cannot stop both pain and memory loss.
findings.sourceReading: Even the pain of loss cannot halt disappearing memories.
findings.explanation: Pain cannot stop memory loss becomes he cannot stop both pain and memory loss.

contexts.japanese: 失み欠う苦痛も、記憶の消失を止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.

findings.description: Fortunately becomes absence of happiness.
findings.sourceReading: Fortunately he does not suffer, because sensation has nearly turned to iron.
findings.explanation: Fortunately becomes absence of happiness.

contexts.japanese: 幸い、苦しいなんて事はなかった。
contexts.english: I don't feel happiness or suffering.

findings.description: Nearly all sensation becomes all five senses.
findings.sourceReading: Most of his senses have turned to iron.
findings.explanation: Nearly all sensation becomes all five senses.

contexts.japanese: 五感は、そのほとんどが鉄になっている。
contexts.english: My five senses have already turned to iron.

findings.description: Baby has no sin becomes baby cannot commit sins.
findings.sourceReading: The recalled teaching says an infant has no guilt even if evil.
findings.explanation: Baby has no sin becomes baby cannot commit sins.

contexts.japanese: 「—ああ。たとえそれが悪であろうと、赤ん坊に、罪はない、と」
contexts.english: "Yeah. You said that a baby can't commit sins even if it's evil."

findings.description: Unwanted by anyone becomes wanting nothing from anyone.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei denies a being unwanted by anyone, alongside denying congenital evil.
findings.explanation: Unwanted by anyone becomes wanting nothing from anyone.

contexts.japanese: 何者にも望まれぬモノ、生まれながらに悪であるモノなどない。
contexts.english: There is no one who wishes for nothing from anyone, and no one who is born evil.

findings.description: Until birth becomes as soon as birth.
findings.sourceReading: He claims the entity has no grounds for punishment up to the very instant of birth.
findings.explanation: Until birth becomes as soon as birth.

contexts.japanese: アレは誕生するその瞬間まで、罰を受ける謂れはない」
contexts.english: There is no reason that thing should be punished as soon as it is born."

findings.description: No wish returning benefit to oneself becomes no wish to return to oneself.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou has no wish whose satisfaction returns something to himself; Kirei's opposite yet similar desire concerns himself.
findings.explanation: No wish returning benefit to oneself becomes no wish to return to oneself.

contexts.japanese: 自身に還る望みを持たぬおまえと対極に位置する、同質の願望だ」
contexts.english: It is a wish of the same nature, yet the antithesis to you, who has no wish to return to yourself.

contexts.japanese: ソイツが出て来たところで、アンタに返るものなんてないんだろう。なのに、どうして」
contexts.english: You're not going to get anything out of it being born. So why?"

findings.description: If I confess this becomes sentiment caused by having confessed.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei admits that his motive also involves sentiment.
findings.explanation: If I confess this becomes sentiment caused by having confessed.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふん。それにな、告白すれば感傷でもある。
contexts.english: "...Hmph. I should say, I feel sentimental having confessed this.

findings.description: Acquiring only a death-bearing way of life becomes killing anything he acquired.
findings.sourceReading: What he gained was only a way of living that brings death; next he cannot abandon that one possession.
findings.explanation: Acquiring only a death-bearing way of life becomes killing anything he acquired.

contexts.japanese: そうして得たものは死を運ぶという生き方のみ。
contexts.english: His life brought only death to anything he obtained.

contexts.japanese: なら—その、たった一つだけ在った生き方を、どうしてここで放棄る事が出来るだろう。
contexts.english: If it's the only way he ever lived, how could he ever abandon it now?

findings.description: Kirei's charge assigned to Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: The enemy charges straight in; Shirou lacks that leg power and lowers himself for a counter against the approaching opponent.
findings.explanation: Kirei's charge assigned to Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 地を蹴り、一直線に“敵”は敵を討ちに迫る。
contexts.english: I run and make a beeline at my opponent.

contexts.japanese: こっちにはそれだけの足がない。
contexts.english: My legs don't have much power left.

contexts.japanese: 腰を落とし、正面から襲いくる敵の胸元を見据え、
contexts.english: I drop my hips, eye the chest of my approaching opponent, and...

findings.description: Enemy who attacked at speed becomes enemy Shirou attacked.
findings.sourceReading: The enemy who assaulted him with that speed disappears from view, folds to his left, and strikes.
findings.explanation: Enemy who attacked at speed becomes enemy Shirou attacked.

contexts.japanese: あの速度。あの勢いで襲撃した敵は、一瞬で視界から消え去り、
contexts.english: The enemy I attacked with such speed and power disappears from sight.

contexts.japanese: 長身を折り畳むよう俺の左横に屈み、拳で腹を殴りつけ、
contexts.english: He bends his tall body to my left flank, drives a fist into my stomach,

findings.description: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Stopping now could preserve meaningful selfhood for about one day although body is already beyond saving; next calls it one-day extension.
findings.explanation: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.
findings.sourceReading: Sky is just a little farther, reachable merely by extending arm, before he realizes there is no power left and sinks.
findings.explanation: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.

contexts.japanese: ほんの少し、ただ腕を伸ばすだけで、空へ抜ける。
contexts.english: For just a moment, I lift my arm up and reach into the sky.

contexts.japanese: この体には、一欠片の魔力も残っていない。
contexts.english: There isn't a single bit of power left in this body.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が救ってくれた命が、沈んでいく。
contexts.english: The life she saved is sinking.

contexts.japanese: 手を伸ばす。
contexts.english: I reach out.

findings.description: Almost cliff-like slope becomes mostly descending small cliffs.
findings.sourceReading: Pathless mountain sometimes even requires descent over rock almost like a sheer cliff; ほとんど modifies cliff likeness, not frequency.
findings.explanation: Almost cliff-like slope becomes mostly descending small cliffs.

contexts.japanese: 山には獣道さえなく、ほとんど絶壁じみた岩肌を降りる事さえあった。
contexts.english: There aren't even any game trails out here, and we mostly have to drop down small cliffs and rock walls.

findings.description: Three intruders become both.
findings.sourceReading: Saber could face all three: Rin, Shirou and Rider, alone.
findings.explanation: Three intruders become both.

contexts.japanese: 桜を守る最強のサーヴァントであるセイバーなら、一人きりで俺たち三人の相手が出来る。
contexts.english: She's the strongest Servant protecting Sakura, and she could take us both alone.

contexts.japanese: 「士郎、貴方は後ろに。指示通り、セイバーの相手は私がします」
contexts.english: "Shirou, get behind me. I will engage Saber, as planned."

findings.description: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou takes encouragement as telling him to arrive while Rin can still keep Sakura held off.
findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.

contexts.japanese: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
contexts.english: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

findings.description: Remaining Shirou and Rider become Shirou alone.
findings.sourceReading: After Rin goes on, boy and Rider remain.
findings.explanation: Remaining Shirou and Rider become Shirou alone.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂が奥に進み、残されたのは俺とライダーだけだ。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's gone, leaving only me.

contexts.japanese: 「殺す、とは聞き捨てなりませんね。貴方が手にかけるのはこの道を通る者のみ。彼がこの場に留まるのなら、貴方に襲われる事はない筈ですが」
contexts.english: "Did I hear you correctly? You said that you would only kill those who attempt to pass. If he stays here, you should not attack him."

contexts.japanese: 違いますか、ライダー」
contexts.english: Am I wrong, Rider?"

findings.description: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.
findings.sourceReading: Ruby reads crushing as playing: humans find daily life boring and meaningless without play and suffer thirst without drinking. Sakura uses normal human needs to normalize her crushing and swallowing.
findings.explanation: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.

contexts.japanese: 人間は潰していないと毎日がつまらなくて意味がないし、飲まないと渇いて苦しいでしょう？
contexts.english: Humans live such boring, pointless lives before I play with them. And I get thirsty, too.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。だって、人を潰すのも呑み込むのも変わらないもの。
contexts.english: "Yes. After all, crushing people isn't any different from swallowing them.

contexts.japanese: ほら、だから同じ。姉さんと変わらない。わたしは当たり前のように、みんながしているコトをするだけです」
contexts.english: See? I'm just like you, Nee-san. I'm just doing what everyone else does."

findings.description: Volley becomes maximum firepower.
findings.sourceReading: 一斉射撃 is simultaneous shooting/a volley.
findings.explanation: Volley becomes maximum firepower.

contexts.japanese: 「Es läßt frei.Eilesalve—！」
contexts.english: "Es lässt frei. Eilesalve! (Release, maximum firepower!)"

findings.description: Reserve reaching trillions becomes billions or perhaps trillions.
findings.sourceReading: Not merely several hundred million: reserve reaches trillions.
findings.explanation: Reserve reaching trillions becomes billions or perhaps trillions.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜の魔力貯蔵量は数億どころか兆に届く。
contexts.english: Sakura's magical energy capacity is in the billions or even trillions.

findings.description: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.
findings.sourceReading: Rin silently cuts down the crying, imploring girl with shadow ruby; image overlays pleading Sakura and her approaching shadow.
findings.explanation: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.

contexts.japanese: 泣いて縋ってくる少女を、彼女は無言で斬り伏せる。
contexts.english: Rin cuts away the shadows clinging to the crying girl.

findings.description: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.
findings.sourceReading: Overwhelmed by sister, girl was on point of refusing the fight before despair renews curses.
findings.explanation: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.

contexts.japanese: 姉に圧され、戦いを拒否しかけていた少女は、絶望と共に呪いを具現化させていく。
contexts.english: Driven back by her sister and denied even a proper fight, the girl materializes more curses in her despair.

findings.description: Faintness becomes completed loss of consciousness.
findings.sourceReading: 気が遠くなる describes consciousness receding/faintness while he still moves, speaks and projects before self disappears.
findings.explanation: Faintness becomes completed loss of consciousness.

contexts.japanese: ……気が遠くなる。
contexts.english: ...I lose consciousness.

contexts.japanese: 自分が無くなる前に、前へ。
contexts.english: Before I'm gone, I need to go forward.

findings.description: Right leg becomes left leg.
findings.sourceReading: Shadow strikes target shoulder, chest, right leg and abdomen; the next line explicitly denies penetration.
findings.explanation: Right leg becomes left leg.

contexts.japanese: 肩と胸、右足と腹に影が突き刺さる。
contexts.english: Shadows strike at my shoulder, chest, left leg, and stomach.

contexts.japanese: 影は突き刺さらず、火花をこぼしてズレていく。
contexts.english: They get deflected and fail to pierce me, throwing up a shower of sparks.

findings.description: Unfulfilled historical project becomes world without evolution.
findings.sourceReading: 成らぬまま follows the thousand-/five-hundred-year pursuits: the continued world/project has remained unfulfilled/unrealized.
findings.explanation: Unfulfilled historical project becomes world without evolution.

contexts.japanese: 果てず、翻らず、成らぬまま、連綿と続けられた一つの世界が、ここに終わろうとしている。
contexts.english: A world that has continued without ending, changing, or evolving is finally coming to an end.

findings.description: Lineage dropping out becomes losing its way.
findings.sourceReading: The family simply fell out of the running; next page states its lifespan as a mage lineage had reached its limit and was declining in Zouken's generation.
findings.explanation: Lineage dropping out becomes losing its way.

contexts.japanese: 単に、彼らは脱落したのだ。
contexts.english: They simply lost their way.

contexts.japanese: その三百年が魔術師の家系として限界だった。
contexts.english: In those three hundred years, they reached the limits of their lineage.

findings.description: Tiny remaining distance compared with centuries becomes distant goal and wasted centuries.
findings.sourceReading: The distance is merely that little, dust-like when compared with his five hundred years, yet impossibly far for this body.
findings.explanation: Tiny remaining distance compared with centuries becomes distant goal and wasted centuries.

contexts.japanese: そう、死ぬ訳にはいかない。崩れる体が恨めしい。苦しいのは苦しい。とにかく苦しい。苦しいだけの五百年だった。苦しいだけの人生だった。それ故に永遠を求めて何がわるい。苦しんだ苦しんだ、満たされないまま苦しんだ、何も残せぬまま消えるなど出来るものか、苦しいまま死ぬなど出来るものか、目の前には聖杯が開いている、ならば我が望みを聞くがいい、問われれば答えてやろう、我が望みはシニタクナイ、あそこまで、あの崖を登れば願いが叶う、願いが叶うというのにこの体ではたどり着けぬ、たったあれだけの距離、この五百年を顧みれば塵にも等しい、たったあれだけの距離が、なぜ、なぜこんなにも遠いのか—！！！！
contexts.english: Yes, I must not die. Damn this rotting body. It's painful, so painful. Too painful. Five hundred years of pain. My whole life has been pain. Why fault me for seeking eternity? I suffered and suffered, never fulfilled, so how can I disappear without leaving anything behind? How can I die in agony? The Holy Grail is open before me. So listen to my wish, ask and I shall answer. My wish is that I DON'T WANT TO DIE, I need to get there, my wish will come true if I climb that cliff, it'll grant my wish but I can't reach it with this body, it's so far away, these last five centuries have been for nothing, it's so far away, why oh why is it so far away—!?!?!?

findings.description: Limited reach of the Makiri journey becomes tautological final resting place.
findings.sourceReading: Wherever the journey ends, the Makiri venture can after all reach only this sort of point/limit.
findings.explanation: Limited reach of the Makiri journey becomes tautological final resting place.

contexts.japanese: マキリの旅は、何処で果てようと、所詮はこんなところ止まりである。
contexts.english: Wherever the Makiris' voyage ended would be their final resting place.

findings.description: Too little time to reach the goal becomes too little to accomplish anything.
findings.sourceReading: How could they reach the desired destination with merely that span of years? Following lines specify distant maturation of humanity.
findings.explanation: Too little time to reach the goal becomes too little to accomplish anything.

contexts.japanese: たったそれだけの年月でどうして届こうか。
contexts.english: Far too short a time to accomplish anything.

contexts.japanese: これより幾星霜の時間を超え、千の年月、万の年月の末に手に入れる、人間という種の成長だ。
contexts.english: the maturation of humanity, whether it takes thousands or tens of thousands of years.

findings.description: Consciousness becomes memories.
findings.sourceReading: Both visual images and consciousness become white beyond return.
findings.explanation: Consciousness becomes memories.

contexts.japanese: 映像も意識も、戻れないところまで白く。
contexts.english: Images and memories become irreturnably white.

findings.description: Left flank becomes left armpit.
findings.sourceReading: 左わき腹 is the left side/flank of the abdomen.
findings.explanation: Left flank becomes left armpit.

contexts.japanese: 同時に左わき腹に衝撃。脳を切りきざむ刃に堪えて、もう一撃。
contexts.english: There's a simultaneous impact to my left armpit. I endure the blades stabbing my brain and attack again.

findings.description: Inclusive affection cutoff becomes exclusive.
findings.sourceReading: Illya affection 4 or lower blocks True; source also says even one extra Projection is too much.
findings.explanation: Inclusive affection cutoff becomes exclusive.

contexts.japanese: ぶっちゃけ、わたしの好感度が４以下だったり、投影を一回でも多く使ってるとトゥルーには行けないのでしたー！
contexts.english: To be blunt, if my affection level is below 4 or you use too many Projections, you can't reach the True ending!

findings.description: Around a day unconscious becomes favor regretted next day.
findings.sourceReading: Imitating Rider can make him insensible for roughly a full day.
findings.explanation: Around a day unconscious becomes favor regretted next day.

contexts.japanese: ライダーの真似事でいいなら、まる一日前後不覚にしてあげられるけど？」
contexts.english: If you're okay with me copying what Rider did, I'll do you a favor that you'll regret the next day."

findings.description: Disbelief in existence becomes hope no such person exists.
findings.sourceReading: そんなものがいるとは思えない says he cannot think such main source exists.
findings.explanation: Disbelief in existence becomes hope no such person exists.

contexts.japanese: ……そんなものがいるとは思えない。
contexts.english: ...I hope nobody like that exists.

findings.description: No matter how altered becomes no matter how it ends.
findings.sourceReading: However radically she is transformed, if Illya remains inside he recognizes known person.
findings.explanation: No matter how altered becomes no matter how it ends.

contexts.japanese: 「……たとえ、どんなに変わり果ててしまっても。
contexts.english: "No matter how this ends...

contexts.japanese: その中にイリヤがいるのなら、それは、俺の知っているイリヤだと思う」
contexts.english: If you're still somewhere in there, then you're the Illya I know."

findings.description: Rounded back becomes backing up.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura mocks sister hunching/rounding her back as seeming frightened.
findings.explanation: Rounded back becomes backing up.

contexts.japanese: 「……どうしたんですか姉さん。そんなふうに背中をまるめてると、まるで、わたしに怯えているように見えますよ？」
contexts.english: "...What's wrong, Nee-san? The way you're backing up almost makes you look like you're scared of me."

findings.description: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.
findings.sourceReading: No question of too late now: everything was already too late when Sakura reached for Illya.
findings.explanation: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.

contexts.japanese: 手遅れも何もない。
contexts.english: She was never ready to begin with.

contexts.japanese: そもそも間桐桜がイリヤスフィールに手を伸ばした時点で、もう、何もかもが手遅れだった。
contexts.english: From the moment Sakura reached for Illya, it was already over.

findings.description: Less than a second becomes less than a few seconds.
findings.sourceReading: Meal takes not even one second, 秒もかからなかった.
findings.explanation: Less than a second becomes less than a few seconds.

contexts.japanese: 『食事』は、それこそ秒もかからなかった。
contexts.english: The "meal" doesn't even last a few seconds.

findings.description: Way of attaining happiness becomes fortunate existence.
findings.sourceReading: Problem is mode of happiness: using evil to throw good into relief.
findings.explanation: Way of attaining happiness becomes fortunate existence.

contexts.japanese: 問題があるとすれば、それは悪を以って善を浮き彫りにする、という幸福の有り方だろう。
contexts.english: The only problem was its fortunate existence, as something which used evil to highlight good.

findings.description: Fourth Grail's narrowness becomes fourth war's abruptness.
findings.sourceReading: Fourth Grail too narrow, incomplete with two Servants remaining and gate promptly destroyed.
findings.explanation: Fourth Grail's narrowness becomes fourth war's abruptness.

contexts.japanese: 「四度目の聖杯は狭すぎたのだ。
contexts.english: "The fourth war was too abrupt.

findings.description: Even odds become partial solution.
findings.sourceReading: There is a method but chance roughly half and half, then narrow mental survival window.
findings.explanation: Even odds become partial solution.

contexts.japanese: 「手はある。だが半々というところだ。
contexts.english: "There is a way, though it is only a partial solution.

findings.description: Many tens of times becomes ten times.
findings.sourceReading: More than now, deaths many tens of times, 何十倍.
findings.explanation: Many tens of times becomes ten times.

contexts.japanese: 今よりもっと、何十倍もの命が失われる。
contexts.english: There will be ten times as many deaths.

findings.description: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.
findings.sourceReading: Soul-container brain worm's hiding location unknown; palm-sized main body anchors soul and must be found or soul purified.
findings.explanation: Palm-sized true body and brain-worm designation omitted.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。アレの本体は人体に寄生する蟲だからな。魂の容器にあたる脳虫が何処に潜んでいるかは知れんが、ソレが生きている限り人体の乗っ取りは易い。
contexts.english: "Yes. He is an insect which parasitizes human bodies. I do not know which insect contains his mind and soul, but it is easy for him to transfer himself to a new body as long as it is intact.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯はある意味不老不死だ。魂を世に留めている手のひらほどの本体を探し出すか、魂そのものを浄化させなければ完全には滅ぼせん」
contexts.english: He is immortal, in a way. He will never completely disappear unless you find the main body which anchors his soul, or cleanse his soul itself."

findings.description: The English increases the distance between the two men's objectives from somewhat better to a lot better. Shirou still rejects Kotomine's objective in the next line.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou regards Kotomine's objective as somewhat preferable to Zouken's, while still rejecting it.
findings.explanation: The English increases the distance between the two men's objectives from somewhat better to a lot better. Shirou still rejects Kotomine's objective in the next line.

contexts.japanese: だが、それでも臓硯に比べれば幾分マシだ。
contexts.english: But that's still a lot better than anything Zouken has planned.

findings.description: Future progressive destruction becomes already emotionless doll.
findings.sourceReading: Abusive taunt: fear, trembling, eventually losing feeling until no different from doll.
findings.explanation: Future progressive destruction becomes already emotionless doll.

contexts.japanese: おまえは間桐の女だ。卑しい魔術師くずれ、恐れ、怯え、やがて感情をなくし人形と変わらなくなる！」
contexts.english: You're a Matou woman. A lowly, cowardly has-been of a mage, no different from an emotionless doll!"

findings.description: Collapsing becomes limping over.
findings.sourceReading: Man bearing down falls/collapses when shadow strikes; immediately dead next page.
findings.explanation: Collapsing becomes limping over.

contexts.japanese: 圧し掛かっていた男が倒れる。
contexts.english: The man who had been bearing down on her limps over.

findings.description: Not gradually going wrong becomes gradual craziness all along.
findings.sourceReading: She realizes it wasn't gradually going wrong, next asserts broken from outset.
findings.explanation: Not gradually going wrong becomes gradual craziness all along.

contexts.japanese: 「—なんだ。少しずつおかしくなってたんじゃないんだ」
contexts.english: "...Oh. Looks like I've been slowly going crazy all along."

contexts.japanese: 「—見てください先輩。わたし、最初から壊れてたんです」
contexts.english: "Look, Senpai. I've always been broken."

findings.description: Mud rising from body core becomes starting at feet.
findings.sourceReading: Black mud from core/interior of body coats skin.
findings.explanation: Mud rising from body core becomes starting at feet.

contexts.japanese: 体の芯から、黒い泥が肌を塗りたくっていく。
contexts.english: Starting with her feet, the black mud coats her skin.

findings.description: The speaker's ability to touch Rin becomes the mud's ability to touch her.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou can touch Rin although he cannot remove her mud covering; 俺 understood from the voiced attempt and lifted Rin at page3.
findings.explanation: The speaker's ability to touch Rin becomes the mud's ability to touch her.

contexts.japanese: 「っ……！　なんだこれ、遠坂には触れるのに、どうして……！」
contexts.english: "Rrgh...! What it this!? It can touch Tohsaka, so why can't I...!?"

contexts.japanese: 抱き上げても返事はない。
contexts.english: I lift her up, but she doesn't respond.

findings.description: Disappear from his life becomes disappear in front of him.
findings.sourceReading: 先輩の前から消える is to disappear from his presence/leave him, because being together burdens him; the source departure and following inability to relinquish him establish sense.
findings.explanation: Disappear from his life becomes disappear in front of him.

contexts.japanese: だからわたし、先輩の前から消えないといけなかった」
contexts.english: That's why I needed to disappear in front of you."

contexts.japanese: 先輩にとって、わたしがどれだけ重荷なのかよく分かっています。先輩はわたしといるかぎり、ずっと苦しみ続けてしまう。
contexts.english: I know how much of a burden I am to you. You'll keep suffering as long as I'm here.

findings.description: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Ceremonial/formal dress isn't here; if Sakura wants to open the gate as successor, they must go to Illya's castle to fetch it.
findings.explanation: Fetching ceremonial clothing is replaced by escorting Illya.

contexts.japanese: けど正装はここにはないの。サクラが後継者として門を開きたいんなら、わたしの城まで取りに行かないと」
contexts.english: But my dress isn't here. If you want to open the gate as a successor, you'll need to take me to my castle."

contexts.japanese: 「……いいでしょう。自分で探す手間が省けますから。
contexts.english: "...Fine. It saves me the trouble of looking for it myself.

findings.description: Irresistible desire to kill everyone becomes claimed necessity to kill them.
findings.sourceReading: 今はもうみんなを殺したくて仕方がない is now wanting to kill everyone so badly she can't help it, contradicting her earlier choice to avoid killing.
findings.explanation: Irresistible desire to kill everyone becomes claimed necessity to kill them.

contexts.japanese: 誰も殺したくないから受け入れたのに、今はもうみんなを殺したくて仕方がないなんて、矛盾してるわよサクラ」
contexts.english: You let that part of you in because you didn't want to kill anyone else, but now you're saying you have to kill them all. You're contradicting yourself, Sakura."

findings.description: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.
findings.sourceReading: Illya says she will take Sakura away, identifying herself as the agent.
findings.explanation: The English reverses who takes whom away. Illya presents herself as taking responsibility for Sakura's departure; the English makes Sakura lead Illya away.

contexts.japanese: 後の始末はわたしの役目だもん。サクラはわたしが連れて行くから、シロウはもう休んでいいよ」
contexts.english: It's my duty to take care of the rest. Sakura's going to take me away, so you can rest now."

findings.description: Eat a lot becomes eat it all.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura made plenty and encourages Shirou to eat a lot.
findings.explanation: Eat a lot becomes eat it all.

contexts.japanese: 「はい、御代わりですね！　いっぱい作りましたから、たくさん食べてください」
contexts.english: "Oh, you want seconds! I made a lot, so be sure to eat it all!"

findings.description: Shirou's acceptance of his wandering attention becomes an effort not to be flustered. The change concerns his handling of attraction.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou accepts his involuntary attention to Sakura and will not make excuses for it.
findings.explanation: Shirou's acceptance of his wandering attention becomes an effort not to be flustered. The change concerns his handling of attraction.

contexts.japanese: 一人で顔を赤くしてるのも我慢するし、桜の一挙一動に目がいってしまうのも言い訳しない。
contexts.english: I'm already the only one blushing, so I can't let every single thing Sakura does throw me for a loop.

findings.description: Already discovered fact becomes a future revelation.
findings.sourceReading: 今回判明した事実 is fact discovered this time; it will continue into the future.
findings.explanation: Already discovered fact becomes a future revelation.

contexts.japanese: 今回判明した事実は、この先ずっと続いていく。
contexts.english: Once the truth comes out, it'll hound me for a while to come.

findings.description: Explicit retraction of attack threat becomes generic amendment.
findings.sourceReading: Rider withdraws the statement about attacking him, then gives conditional cooperation as long as he protects Sakura.
findings.explanation: Explicit retraction of attack threat becomes generic amendment.

contexts.japanese: 「……そうですね。貴方を襲う、というのは撤回します。
contexts.english: "...All right. Allow me to amend that statement.

contexts.japanese: 貴方がサクラを守るかぎり、私たちは協力者です。今後ともよろしくお願いします」
contexts.english: As long as you protect Sakura, I will cooperate with you. I hope you will find that satisfactory."

findings.description: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks Sakura should know obtaining Grail is best way of healing body.
findings.explanation: Best healing method becomes the only healing method.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を得る事が体を治す一番の方法だと判っているだろうに、それを考えようとしていない。
contexts.english: She should know that the Holy Grail is the only way to heal herself, but she doesn't even consider it as an option.

findings.description: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura warns that Shirou might inadvertently fall under the eyes' effect. Rider explains that even limiting her magical energy would not reliably exclude him.
findings.explanation: Sakura's warning about accidental exposure becomes a warning that Rider might attack on impulse. Rider's next lines still explain that she cannot reliably prevent her eyes from affecting Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「こ、困りませんっ！　だいたいですね、ライダーの目は魔眼なんですよ？　ちょっとした弾みで魔術にかかっちゃったらどうするんですか！」
contexts.english: "I-it doesn't bother me at all! Besides, Rider's eyes are Mystic Eyes. What if she hits you with her magecraft on impulse!?"

contexts.japanese: 私本人が魔力をセーブしたところで、貴方を対象外にするのは難しい」
contexts.english: Even if I conserve my magical energy, it would be difficult to stop them from affecting you."

findings.description: Deepening distress becomes realizing the situation.
