findings.sourceReading: The fact sinks her heart yet deeper: boy risks danger while she rests as its cause.
findings.explanation: Deepening distress becomes realizing the situation.

contexts.japanese: その事実が、彼女の心を一層深く沈ませる。
contexts.english: The reality sinks in.

findings.description: Wanting Shirou alone to survive becomes living her remaining time for him.
findings.sourceReading: Since she has little time, at least she wants him alone to go on living.
findings.explanation: Wanting Shirou alone to survive becomes living her remaining time for him.

contexts.japanese: それならせめて、彼にだけは生きていてほしい。
contexts.english: She'd prefer to live the rest of it for him.

contexts.japanese: どうせ自分は長くない。
contexts.english: She doesn't have much time left, anyway.

findings.description: Melting spine becomes fusing spine.
findings.sourceReading: Spine poignantly melts like viscous matter.
findings.explanation: Melting spine becomes fusing spine.

contexts.japanese: 止まらない呼吸、粘体のように切なく融ける脊椎。
contexts.english: She can't stop breathing. Her spine fuses together like sticky sap.

findings.description: Loss of memory of her own actions becomes fear about future behavior.
findings.sourceReading: When focus slips she no longer knows what she had been doing; memories vague, limb sensations gone and subjective day fragmented.
findings.explanation: Loss of memory of her own actions becomes fear about future behavior.

contexts.japanese: 今はちゃんとしてるけど、気を抜くとね、自分が何をしていたか分からなくなるの。……日に日に記憶が曖昧になって、手足の感覚もない。時間の感覚だってもうバラバラで、一日が長く続いてくれないんだ。
contexts.english: I'm still myself now, but if I lose focus, I don't know what I'll do... My memories are getting more vague each day, and I can't feel my arms and legs anymore. My sense of time is all over the place, and I can't even keep track of a day anymore.

findings.description: Apparent week since farewell becomes week during farewell.
findings.sourceReading: Though she saw him off this morning it feels a week has passed since doing so.
findings.explanation: Apparent week since farewell becomes week during farewell.

contexts.japanese: ……今朝だって。なんか、先輩を見送ってから、一週間ぐらい経ってる気がするの」
contexts.english: ...Even this morning, when I watched Senpai leave, it felt like a whole week went by."

findings.description: The English changes a warning that silence could cause irreparable harm into an expectation that speaking will change things. This belongs in a review of Shirou's decision to warn Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou expects irreparable consequences unless he tells Illya about both dangers.
findings.explanation: The English changes a warning that silence could cause irreparable harm into an expectation that speaking will change things. This belongs in a review of Shirou's decision to warn Illya.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯の暗躍と、あの、正体不明の影についても話しておかないと、取り返しのつかない事になるだろう。
contexts.english: I have a feeling that everything will change once I bring up Zouken's schemes and that unknown Shadow.

findings.description: Acceptance of embarrassing protective reason becomes understanding his embarrassment.
findings.sourceReading: He infers Rider has accepted the reason just given, one embarrassing to state to another person's face.
findings.explanation: Acceptance of embarrassing protective reason becomes understanding his embarrassment.

contexts.japanese: ……どうやら今の、人様に面と向かって言うのには気恥ずかしい理由に納得してくれたようだ。
contexts.english: ...Maybe now she knows why I'm embarrassed to say this out loud.

findings.description: Agreement to grant possible request becomes agreement to hear it.
findings.sourceReading: Rider says if within her power she will 聞き届ける, accept/grant the request.
findings.explanation: Agreement to grant possible request becomes agreement to hear it.

contexts.japanese: 「え、ええ。私にできる範囲でなら聞き届けますが」
contexts.english: "Y-yes. If it's within my power, I will hear you out."

findings.description: Whoever enters is recast as any number of people Shirou brings.
findings.sourceReading: Today, no person whatsoever will return alive; imagined trees voice an absolute warning.
findings.explanation: Whoever enters is recast as any number of people Shirou brings.

contexts.japanese: —今日だけは、何人たりとも生きては帰れん。
contexts.english: No matter how many people you bring, none will return alive.

contexts.japanese: 風で揺れる木々が、そう囁いている気さえする。
contexts.english: Even the trees seem to whisper that as their branches sway in the wind.

findings.description: Rin still ends the deadlock first, but break the ice omits her release of her fighting stance. Both versions keep Shirou lowering his wooden sword after her request.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks Shirou to lower the sword and is the first to release her stance; he then lowers his wooden sword. The omitted detail is her physical de-escalation, not all of her initiative.
findings.explanation: Rin still ends the deadlock first, but break the ice omits her release of her fighting stance. Both versions keep Shirou lowering his wooden sword after her request.

contexts.japanese: ……先に構えを解いたのは遠坂だった。
contexts.english: Tohsaka's the first to break the ice.

contexts.japanese: 「……ちょっと。いいかげん、それ下げてくれない？　お化け屋敷じゃないんだから」
contexts.english: "...Hold on. Would you put that down? We're not in a haunted house."

contexts.japanese: 釣られて木刀を下げる。
contexts.english: I lower the wooden sword as asked.

findings.description: The swordsman's cut through Berserker's unguarded body disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Black armor passes through greatsword and debris, then flashes a cut across the exposed body.
findings.explanation: The swordsman's cut through Berserker's unguarded body disappears.

contexts.japanese: 吹き荒ぶ風の元凶はあの黒い剣士なのか、黒い甲冑はバーサーカーの大剣と土塊をすり抜け、無防備な体を一閃する。
contexts.english: The black-armored Servant breezes past Berserker's greatsword and earthen assault, as if it's the source of this raging wind.

contexts.japanese: それを、黒い剣士は苦もなく切断する。
contexts.english: And the black swordsman easily slices it open.

findings.description: A darkness-swallowing-light simile becomes inky light threatening to swallow Berserker whole.
findings.sourceReading: The sword paints Berserker's flank black like light swallowed by lightless darkness.
findings.explanation: A darkness-swallowing-light simile becomes inky light threatening to swallow Berserker whole.

contexts.japanese: 無明の闇が光を呑むように、剣はバーサーカーの横腹を黒で塗りつぶしていった。
contexts.english: A sword paints Berserker's flank in black, the inky light threatening to swallow him whole.

findings.description: How Berserker takes her plea becomes whether he heard it.
findings.sourceReading: Narration asks how he interpreted/received what she said before he advances roaring.
findings.explanation: How Berserker takes her plea becomes whether he heard it.

contexts.japanese: それをどう取ったのか。
contexts.english: Did he hear it?

findings.description: Grabbing his own chest becomes grabbing the attached Shadow.
findings.sourceReading: The giant grasps his chest and rips away the black Shadow together with his adhering flesh.
findings.explanation: Grabbing his own chest becomes grabbing the attached Shadow.

contexts.japanese: 片手で胸を掴み、バリ、という音をたてて、黒い影を引き剥がした。
contexts.english: With one hand, he grabbed the Shadow that latched to his chest and tore it off with a ripping sound.

contexts.japanese: —絡みついた部分ごと、中身が覗こうという勢いで、自らの身体を剥いだのだ。
contexts.english: —He literally tore his body open wherever the Shadow had grabbed him, exposing his innards.

findings.description: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail is merely a receptacle into which material is poured/which is filled.
findings.explanation: The Grail being filled becomes an ungrammatical purpose to fill it.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯はただ注がれるだけのもの。
contexts.english: It is merely to fill the Grail.

findings.description: Their shared pursuit becomes a claim that they were fated to meet. The individual wishes survive, and this change belongs to Zouken's relationship with the skull-masked Assassin.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says their related aims explain their current joint pursuit: bodily immortality for him and an enduring name for Assassin.
findings.explanation: Their shared pursuit becomes a claim that they were fated to meet. The individual wishes survive, and this change belongs to Zouken's relationship with the skull-masked Assassin.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、大事だとも！　我が望みは不老不死、こやつの望みも永劫に刻まれる自身の名でな。我らは同じ目的の為、こうして邁進しておるという訳だ」
contexts.english: "Yes, I do! My wish is for immortality, and he desires a name that will be remembered for eternity. We were fated to meet because our goals are the same."

findings.description: Brain cells losing stored knowledge becomes withering and taking his intellect.
findings.sourceReading: Even now his brain cells lose the knowledge accumulated in them amid bodily decay.
findings.explanation: Brain cells losing stored knowledge becomes withering and taking his intellect.

contexts.japanese: 「当然じゃ。見よこの肉体を。刻一刻と機能を失い、悪臭を放ち、身体は内から溶け、こうしている今も脳細胞は蓄えた知識を失っていくのだ。
contexts.english: "Naturally. Behold this body. With every passing moment, it loses its functions and reeks of death, melting from within. Even now, my brain cells wither and take my intellect with them.

findings.description: Less than a day's extension becomes a full extra day.
findings.sourceReading: The hypothetical medicine prolongs life by only less than one day.
findings.explanation: Less than a day's extension becomes a full extra day.

contexts.japanese: おぬしとて木々の一本一本が寿命を延ばす妙薬とすれば、この森など瞬く間に食らいつくそう。たとえそれが、僅か一日足らずの延命だとしてもな。
contexts.english: If you knew that each tree in this forest could be made into a drug to extend your life, even you would cut down the whole forest in an instant. Even if it only meant an extra day of life.

findings.description: Zouken's claim that shared order no longer holds becomes a claim that he follows a universal law. This changes the reasoning by which he excuses sacrificing others for survival.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says that no sustaining order of interconnection can hold under humanity's destructive greed, then uses inevitable collapse to excuse breaking step himself.
findings.explanation: Zouken's claim that shared order no longer holds becomes a claim that he follows a universal law. This changes the reasoning by which he excuses sacrificing others for survival.

contexts.japanese: そこに、もはや連鎖すべき法則など成り立たぬ。いずれ破綻するのであれば、ワシ一人が足並みを崩したところで誰にも異論は挟ませぬわ……！」
contexts.english: I am merely following a law that governs us all. If we are all destined for ruin in the end, then who can criticize me for walking out of step with the masses...!?"

findings.description: A distant-sky comparison becomes a literal upward stare at the sky.
findings.sourceReading: The old magus focuses his eyes as though looking toward some distant sky, momentarily arrested by her ancestral question.
findings.explanation: A distant-sky comparison becomes a literal upward stare at the sky.

contexts.japanese: 老魔術師は、何か、遠い空を見上げるように眼を凝らし。
contexts.english: The old mage stares up at the sky in contemplation.

findings.description: The kick's location becomes less precise, while Archer's protective intervention remains clear.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin is knocked away by a kick to his flank.
findings.explanation: The kick's location becomes less precise, while Archer's protective intervention remains clear.

contexts.japanese: 俺たちの真横に並走していたアサシンは、そのわき腹に蹴りを食らって弾かれたのだ。
contexts.english: Assassin was running next to us, until someone kicked him in the stomach.

findings.description: Assassin's defeated attack becomes a parry performed by Assassin. The exchange is reversed, although Archer's overall advantage remains clear; it concerns the skull-masked Assassin.
findings.sourceReading: Assassin cries out while retreating after Archer cuts down his all-out attack.
findings.explanation: Assassin's defeated attack becomes a parry performed by Assassin. The exchange is reversed, although Archer's overall advantage remains clear; it concerns the skull-masked Assassin.

contexts.japanese: 渾身の一撃を斬り落とされ、後退しながらアサシンは声を上げる。
contexts.english: Assassin desperately parries a shot, retreating.

contexts.japanese: 「ヌ—貴様、何故動ける……！？」
contexts.english: "Ngh... How can you move!?"

findings.description: Perception becomes spirit.
findings.sourceReading: The burst dyes Shirou's field of vision and perception entirely black as he covers Illya.
findings.explanation: Perception becomes spirit.

contexts.japanese: 視界と知覚が、黒一色に染め上げられた。
contexts.english: my sight and spirit are dyed jet black.

findings.description: A black sun falling upon the scene becomes Shirou falling into it.
findings.sourceReading: Seeing clear blackness makes him wonder whether a black sun has fallen/come down.
findings.explanation: A black sun falling upon the scene becomes Shirou falling into it.

contexts.japanese: こんなにハッキリ見えているのに暗いってコトは、黒い太陽でも落ちてきたのか。
contexts.english: It's so dark, even though I can see clearly. I must have fallen into a black sun.

findings.description: Loss of touch becomes loss of every sense.
findings.sourceReading: Absence of tactile sensation feels more revolting than pain.
findings.explanation: Loss of touch becomes loss of every sense.

contexts.japanese: 痛みより、触覚がない喪失感が気色悪い。
contexts.english: The complete sensory loss is more revolting than any pain.

findings.description: The Shadow disappearing becomes Shirou disappearing.
findings.sourceReading: After the burst, the black Shadow melts away without trace, perhaps having exhausted its power.
findings.explanation: The Shadow disappearing becomes Shirou disappearing.

contexts.japanese: ……消えていく。
contexts.english: ...I'm disappearing.

contexts.japanese: 今ので力を使い果たしたのか、“黒い影”は跡形もなく溶けていった。
contexts.english: The Shadow melts away without a trace, as if it's expended all its power.

findings.description: A mistaken tactical estimate becomes belief that he could change anything.
findings.sourceReading: His error was judging that the planned dash, hand-grab and sideways jump could somehow work.
findings.explanation: A mistaken tactical estimate becomes belief that he could change anything.

contexts.japanese: —どうにかなると、判断した事が間違いだった。
contexts.english: I was wrong to think I could change anything.

findings.description: Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth Shirou's life. The English instead questions whether sacrifice exhausts what she means to him, changing the provocation.
findings.sourceReading: Having called life-sacrificing devotion beautiful, Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth that much to Shirou.
findings.explanation: Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth Shirou's life. The English instead questions whether sacrifice exhausts what she means to him, changing the provocation.

contexts.japanese: あの娘は衛宮士郎にとって、果たしてそれだけの価値があるのかどうか」
contexts.english: I wonder if that is all the girl really means to you."

contexts.japanese: 「—そうか。命を捧げるほどの献身は美しいがな。
contexts.english: "I see. Self-sacrifice is indeed a beautiful ideal.

findings.description: Keeping someone alive as satisfying desire becomes an act of greed.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei provocatively equates causing/allowing life with fulfilling desire, leaving the desire's owner and moral implication open.
findings.explanation: Keeping someone alive as satisfying desire becomes an act of greed.

contexts.japanese: 生かすという事は欲望を満たすという事。
contexts.english: Letting her live is an act of greed.

findings.description: The hammer-blow shock becomes a moment of understanding. That changes Shirou's reaction, but these pages do not establish a lost joke mechanism.
findings.sourceReading: Rin's offer hits Shirou like a hammer blow; he then recognizes his extraordinary good fortune.
findings.explanation: The hammer-blow shock becomes a moment of understanding. That changes Shirou's reaction, but these pages do not establish a lost joke mechanism.

contexts.japanese: ガン、とあたまをハンマーで叩かれた感じ。
contexts.english: Finally, a light bulb goes off in my head.

contexts.japanese: 突然の申し出は、これ以上ない程の幸運だった。
contexts.english: This sudden proposal is the best that could happen to me right now.

findings.description: Shirou still protests Rin's silence, but the English drops his reminder that she asked for his answer in the first place.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou complains that Rin has prompted his response and then fallen silent when he gives it.
findings.explanation: Shirou still protests Rin's silence, but the English drops his reminder that she asked for his answer in the first place.

contexts.japanese: 「遠坂？　おい、人に話ふっといて無視するな」
contexts.english: "Tohsaka? Hey, don't ignore me when I'm talking to you."

findings.description: A look like one used to blame the socially vulnerable becomes a look reserved for society's dregs.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou feels Rin's gaze resembles one condemning a socially disadvantaged or weak person.
findings.explanation: A look like one used to blame the socially vulnerable becomes a look reserved for society's dregs.

contexts.japanese: その目がこう、いかにも社会的弱者を責めるようで胃が痛い。
contexts.english: She's giving me a wince-inducing look reserved for the utter dregs of society.

findings.description: Shirou's criticism of his tangled reasoning becomes a joke about protesting too much. It makes the denial sound suspicious without establishing that Rin's insinuation is true.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou recognizes that his explanation has lurched from instinctive choice to a claim about being Illya's guardian.
findings.explanation: Shirou's criticism of his tangled reasoning becomes a joke about protesting too much. It makes the denial sound suspicious without establishing that Rin's insinuation is true.

contexts.japanese: あう、我ながらメチャクチャな論理展開。
contexts.english: Aargh. The man doth protest too much, methinks.

findings.description: Rin accusing Shirou of brazenly doubling down becomes saying his fighting spirit returned.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says he has opened up/brazened it out and stopped trying to excuse the position.
findings.explanation: Rin accusing Shirou of brazenly doubling down becomes saying his fighting spirit returned.

contexts.japanese: 「…………開き直ったわね。まあ、そこまで言うなら認めてあげてもいいけど、桜も大変ね」
contexts.english: "...Looks like you've got your fighting spirit back. If you're going to insist on it that hard, I'll respect your choice, but I feel bad for Sakura."

findings.description: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.
findings.sourceReading: Through stress-numbed hearing come Berserker's roar, strong wind noise, and an explosive sound so great it overwhelms even vision.
findings.explanation: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.

contexts.japanese: 視覚すら覆うほどの、爆音が流れ込んだ。
contexts.english: buffet me so violently I can't even see.

contexts.japanese: ……緊張で麻痺した耳には、狂戦士の咆哮と、強い風鳴りと、
contexts.english: ...In my ears gone numb from stress, the fierce howling of the wind and the mad warrior's roars

findings.description: Many Noble Phantasms exceeding the sword in craftsmanship becomes few being able to rival it.
findings.sourceReading: Numerous Noble Phantasms surpass the sword in fine modeling and skilled ironwork; its superiority lies elsewhere.
findings.explanation: Many Noble Phantasms exceeding the sword in craftsmanship becomes few being able to rival it.

contexts.japanese: 造型の細やかさ、鍛え上げられた鉄の巧みさで言えば、上回る宝具は数あろう。
contexts.english: Few Noble Phantasms can rival its elegant design and fine worksmanship.

findings.description: A sword outside nonhuman craft becomes not a work of mankind.
findings.sourceReading: The sword relies neither on myth nor on inhuman/nonhuman art; it is forged from human thought alone.
findings.explanation: A sword outside nonhuman craft becomes not a work of mankind.

contexts.japanese: 神話に寄らず、人ならざる業にも属さず、ただ想いだけで鍛え上げられた結晶だからこそ—あの剣は空想の身で、最強の座に在り続ける。
contexts.english: Neither a relic of myth nor a work of mankind, it is a crystallization crafted from our feelings alone—a sword of pure fantasy, sitting at the apex.

findings.description: A slash sharp enough to reap rice stalks becomes one precise enough to cut a grain of rice.
findings.sourceReading: The blade sweeps Shirou's exposed neck with the sharpness used to reap ears/stalks of rice.
findings.explanation: A slash sharp enough to reap rice stalks becomes one precise enough to cut a grain of rice.

contexts.japanese: 稲穂を刈る鋭さで、衛宮士郎の無防備な首を薙ぎ払う。
contexts.english: It's a slash precise enough to cut a grain of rice, coming for Shirou Emiya's head.

findings.description: Understanding the mechanism of pain becomes getting used to it.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks he has more or less grasped how the pain works, then explains his cooling/heat-transfer model.
findings.explanation: Understanding the mechanism of pain becomes getting used to it.

contexts.japanese: ……痛みの仕組みがどんなモノなのかはだいたい呑み込めた。
contexts.english: ...I've more or less gotten used to how the pain works.

findings.description: An illusion of a blade stirring inside his body becomes almost hearing grinding sounds.
findings.sourceReading: During red vertigo Shirou feels as though a long blade enters at the shoulder and grinds/stirs violently around inside his body.
findings.explanation: An illusion of a blade stirring inside his body becomes almost hearing grinding sounds.

contexts.japanese: この赤い目眩が起きるたび、肩から長い刃物を突き刺され、体ん中をギチギチとかき回される錯覚がする。
contexts.english: Every time the red vertigo comes, I feel a long blade stab me in the shoulder, and I almost think I hear grinding sounds inside my body.

findings.description: A guest room Rin noticed inside the detached annex on a prior visit becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way here.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks to be shown to the guest room in the detached annex, which she had marked out when previously admitted into the house.
findings.explanation: A guest room Rin noticed inside the detached annex on a prior visit becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way here.

contexts.japanese: ほら士郎、客間に案内して。前に上がった時、離れの客間に目をつけてたんだから。あ、イリヤはどこがいい？」
contexts.english: Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"

findings.description: The detached-annex guest room Rin noticed on an earlier visit again becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way there.
findings.sourceReading: Rin asks for the guest room in the detached annex that she marked out when previously admitted into the house.
findings.explanation: The detached-annex guest room Rin noticed on an earlier visit again becomes a separate guesthouse seen on the way there.

contexts.japanese: 「決まりね。それじゃあがらせてもらうわよ。ほら士郎、客間に案内して。前に上がった時、離れの客間に目をつけてたんだから。あ、イリヤはどこがいい？」
contexts.english: "That settles it then. I'm coming in. Come on, Shirou, take me to a guestroom. I saw a separate guesthouse on the way here. Oh, where do you want to sleep, Illya?"

contexts.japanese: 「？　いや、桜の部屋は離れの客間だけど」
contexts.english: "Huh? Sakura's room is in the separate guesthouse."

findings.description: Illya's sudden emergence from listlessness becomes a loss of enthusiasm. Her hostility toward Sakura is still visible, so the error primarily concerns Illya's changing mood.
findings.sourceReading: Illya's immediately preceding listlessness abruptly disappears as she glares at Sakura.
findings.explanation: Illya's sudden emergence from listlessness becomes a loss of enthusiasm. Her hostility toward Sakura is still visible, so the error primarily concerns Illya's changing mood.

contexts.japanese: さっきまでの元気のなさは何処にいったのか、イリヤは一変して桜を睨んだ。
contexts.english: Illya glares at Sakura, all of her earlier enthusiasm gone.

findings.description: Minimizing an immobile arm as no serious problem becomes claiming he still has options.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou orders himself that an arm not moving is nothing serious and to think about something else.
findings.explanation: Minimizing an immobile arm as no serious problem becomes claiming he still has options.

contexts.japanese: 「……大丈夫だ。ただ腕が動かないだけで、どうって事はない。悩むならもっと別のことを考えろ」
contexts.english: "...It'll be okay. I can't move the arm, but I still have options. There's plenty of other stuff to worry about."

findings.description: Thinking about how to save Sakura becomes postponing concern for himself. The surrounding English still establishes her urgent need for help.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou directs his present thinking toward how to defeat Zouken and obtain the Grail before Sakura collapses.
findings.explanation: Thinking about how to save Sakura becomes postponing concern for himself. The surrounding English still establishes her urgent need for help.

contexts.japanese: 悩むのならその方法だ。
contexts.english: I can worry about myself after that.

findings.description: Rider's words being true becomes Rider being sincere.
findings.sourceReading: Because Rider shares Sakura's sensations, Shirou treats what she says as unmistakable truth.
findings.explanation: Rider's words being true becomes Rider being sincere.

contexts.japanese: ただ、マスターである桜と感覚を共有するライダーの言葉は紛れもない真実だ。
contexts.english: But her words are utterly sincere, coming from someone who shares her senses with her Master.

findings.description: The expanding Shadow avoiding Shirou's depression becomes Shirou evading it in a ditch.
findings.sourceReading: Uneven ground shelters Shirou in a hollow: the Shadow passes around/avoids him, except for the exposed left arm.
findings.explanation: The expanding Shadow avoiding Shirou's depression becomes Shirou evading it in a ditch.

contexts.japanese: 広がった黒い影は窪みにいた衛宮士郎を避けて通った。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya evaded the Shadow in a ditch.

contexts.japanese: 森の地面が凹凸だった事が幸いしたのだ。
contexts.english: He was fortunate that the forest terrain is filled with crags and valleys.

findings.description: No meaningful difference between incapacitating and life-threatening injury becomes both events actually happening.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura realizes that wishing for injury sufficient to confine him and confronting a life-threatening wound are not safely separable categories: injury can mean this.
findings.explanation: No meaningful difference between incapacitating and life-threatening injury becomes both events actually happening.

contexts.japanese: その二つに違いなどない。
contexts.english: Both of these things actually happened.

findings.description: Archer creating projected weapons becomes him forging the original paired swords too.
findings.sourceReading: Because Archer is a forging-associated Heroic Spirit, he creates; anything seen and understood can be reproduced through Projection.
findings.explanation: Archer creating projected weapons becomes him forging the original paired swords too.

contexts.japanese: だから作る。
contexts.english: So he forged them, too.

findings.description: A frantic warning not to disrupt time and order becomes losing track of time and getting out of order.
findings.sourceReading: In overloaded internal protest, Shirou insists time must not be thrown out of joint and order must not be disturbed.
findings.explanation: A frantic warning not to disrupt time and order becomes losing track of time and getting out of order.

contexts.japanese: 時間を狂わせてはいけない秩序を乱してはいけないおまえが俺に手を貸すなんて、そんな事をされても俺には扱える技量がない—
contexts.english: Can't lose track of time, can't get out of order, even if you help me, I don't have the skill to handle it—

findings.description: Being unable to remove the restraining garment alone becomes being unable to change clothes.
findings.sourceReading: All but the right arm is fixed, and Shirou cannot take off the restraint by himself.
findings.explanation: Being unable to remove the restraining garment alone becomes being unable to change clothes.

contexts.japanese: その証拠に、動かせるのは右腕だけ。それ以外の個所はがっちり固定されていて、一人では脱げないようになっている。
contexts.english: The fact I can only move my right arm is proof enough. Everything else is fixed tightly in place. I can't even change my own clothes like this.

findings.description: The English supplies a lobby as Illya's destination. It preserves the dismissal and her refusal to leave Shirou alone, so this detail does not support the character dossier.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine tells Illya to leave the room if she has no business there.
findings.explanation: The English supplies a lobby as Illya's destination. It preserves the dismissal and her refusal to leave Shirou alone, so this detail does not support the character dossier.

contexts.japanese: 「あちらも持ち直した。こちらは事後説明だけだからな、用がなければ退室したまえ」
contexts.english: "She's recovering as well. I'm only going to debrief him, so if you don't have any business here, go wait in the lobby."

findings.description: Archer being brought to the church near death becomes Archer bringing Shirou there.
findings.sourceReading: After the completed transplant Archer vanishes; he was already moribund when he himself was transported there, and endured through the procedure via Independent Action.
findings.explanation: Archer being brought to the church near death becomes Archer bringing Shirou there.

contexts.japanese: 「移植が済んだ後、消滅した。ここに運ばれた時点で死に体だったのだが、よくも終わるまで保ったものだ。アーチャーの持つ単独行動故だろうがな」
contexts.english: "After the transplant, he disappeared. He was already on the verge of death when he brought you here. I'm surprised he lasted so long. It must be thanks to his Independent Action ability."

findings.description: Pain and attempted activation become alternatives.
findings.sourceReading: Even ordinary magical-energy circulation will cause both pain in the left arm and recoil as it tries to activate.
findings.explanation: Pain and attempted activation become alternatives.

contexts.japanese: だが安心はするなよ。魔術行使をせずとも、生きている限り魔力は肉体に通るものだ。その度に左腕には痛みと、起動しようとする反動が起きるだろう。
contexts.english: But do not be complacent. Magical energy runs through your body even when you aren't using magecraft. It may cause your left arm to react with pain or activation.

findings.description: Complaining as rejection of a life saved becomes disrespecting Archer's sacrifice.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou reasons that because the transplant was the means of keeping him alive, complaining would amount to abandoning the life he was given.
findings.explanation: Complaining as rejection of a life saved becomes disrespecting Archer's sacrifice.

contexts.japanese: それを生かす為の方法がアーチャーの腕の移植だったんだから、文句を言うって事は助かった命を放棄するって事になる。
contexts.english: Archer's arm transplant saved my life, so I would be making light of his sacrifice if I complained.

findings.description: Having no reason to be glared at becomes never remembering Rin glaring like this before.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou cannot think of anything he did to deserve Rin's current glare, but is relieved she is safe.
findings.explanation: Having no reason to be glared at becomes never remembering Rin glaring like this before.

contexts.japanese: ……あんなふうに睨まれる覚えはないが、とりあえず遠坂も無事だったと判ってホッとする。
contexts.english: ...I don't remember her ever glaring at me like this before, but I'm relieved that she's safe.

findings.description: Remaining Masters uniformly lacking Servants and the outcome being decided becomes victory being close because few Servants remain.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says the surviving Masters are gathered without Servants, so the result is effectively settled.
findings.explanation: Remaining Masters uniformly lacking Servants and the outcome being decided becomes victory being close because few Servants remain.

contexts.japanese: 残されたマスターがこうもそろってサーヴァントがいない状態では、もはや勝敗はついただろう」
contexts.english: Victory is close, with so few Servants remaining, despite this assembly of Masters."

findings.description: Shirou being unreliable becomes Illya not wanting to rely on him.
findings.sourceReading: Rin falsely paraphrases Illya as refusing the house because Emiya himself is not dependable, preferring her secure castle.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unreliable becomes Illya not wanting to rely on him.

contexts.japanese: 「言ってるじゃない。衛宮くんの家に行かないのは、衛宮くんが頼りにならないからでしょ？　だから安心できる自分の城に戻るって言ってるんじゃない」
contexts.english: "You're saying it right now. You don't want to go to Emiya's house because you don't want to rely on him, right? You'd feel better back at your own castle."

findings.description: The English preserves the ruby's name but loses the treasure chest and Illya's expectation that it will be beautiful. 'Sounds pretty nice' need not mean she likes the sound of the name.
findings.sourceReading: Illya expresses interest in the apparent beauty of a treasure chest used by a magician, with a proper name supplied through ruby.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the ruby's name but loses the treasure chest and Illya's expectation that it will be beautiful. 'Sounds pretty nice' need not mean she likes the sound of the name.

contexts.japanese: 「じゃ、わたしも行くね。遠坂の師の遺産になんて興味はないけど、魔法使いの使ってた宝箱はキレイそうだし」
contexts.english: "Then I should come, too. I'm not interested in Kischur's relics, but Zel Schweinorg sounds pretty nice."

findings.description: Kirei having no wish becomes never having any desires in his life.
findings.sourceReading: The narration affirms that Kirei has no wish of the kind the Grail would grant; what he has is relentless inquiry.
findings.explanation: Kirei having no wish becomes never having any desires in his life.

contexts.japanese: 金髪の青年には理解できぬだけで、もとよりこの男に望みなどないのだ。
contexts.english: The blond man simply doesn't understand that the priest never had any desires in his life at all.

findings.description: A wish fulfilling the self becomes a person fulfilling their own wish.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei distinguishes ordinary pleasures from a wish that realizes or fulfills the self; if the person realizes it by their own means, that does not save them.
findings.explanation: A wish fulfilling the self becomes a person fulfilling their own wish.

contexts.japanese: そのようなものは食事と同じだ。願いとは自身を叶えるもの。だが自ら願いを叶えては、人間は救われん」
contexts.english: It is no different from a meal. One should make one's own wishes come true. But this cannot save a human."

findings.description: A past era when Kirei still had a wish becomes an era of waiting for that wish to come true.
findings.sourceReading: He looks back more than ten years to the period when he still possessed something called a wish.
findings.explanation: A past era when Kirei still had a wish becomes an era of waiting for that wish to come true.

contexts.japanese: もう十年以上も過去となった、まだ望みとやらを持っていた時代の事を。
contexts.english: ...at a time more than ten years past, when he still waited for his wish to come true.

findings.description: A father valuing an excellent son becomes a son excelling at making his father happy.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei reasons that a child's excellence is naturally a parental joy, so his father likely values him for that excellence.
findings.explanation: A father valuing an excellent son becomes a son excelling at making his father happy.

contexts.japanese: 息子が優れているのは、親として喜ぶ事だ。だからこの男は自分を重宝するのだろう。
contexts.english: The son excelled at making his father happy. That was probably why his father valued him so.

findings.description: Something that should not exist becomes something that cannot exist.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei asks why a thing must be produced if it ought not be allowed to exist.
findings.explanation: Something that should not exist becomes something that cannot exist.

contexts.japanese: 有ってはならぬモノならば、なぜ、そんなモノが生み出されねばならないのか。
contexts.english: If such a person could not exist, then why was he born anyway?

findings.description: Asking where responsibility for the existence lies becomes asking where Kirei's own sin is.
findings.sourceReading: The man continues asking where the guilt, fault or responsibility for such an unwanted being's existence is located.
findings.explanation: Asking where responsibility for the existence lies becomes asking where Kirei's own sin is.

contexts.japanese: —男は、その罪の所在を問い続けた。
contexts.english: "Where is my sin?" the man kept asking.

findings.description: Kirei's interest in this war's outcome becomes interest in the ending of Kirei himself.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei Kotomine, the man who finds pleasure only in others' suffering, is interested in the present conclusion/outcome.
findings.explanation: Kirei's interest in this war's outcome becomes interest in the ending of Kirei himself.

contexts.japanese: 他者の苦しみにしか悦びを見出せなかった言峰綺礼は、此度の結末に関心を持っている。
contexts.english: He is interested in Kirei Kotomine's conclusion—in the end of a man who can only find happiness in the suffering of others.

findings.description: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.
findings.sourceReading: After the terse greeting, Illya walks to the living room behind/following Tohsaka.
findings.explanation: Illya following after Rin becomes leaving Rin.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは遠坂の後に付いて居間へ歩いていく。
contexts.english: Illya leaves Tohsaka and walks to the living room.

findings.description: Sakura silently continuing to eat after the shock becomes merely eating too.
findings.sourceReading: Crushed by Rin's superior cooking, Sakura says no more and wordlessly devotes herself to moving food into her mouth.
findings.explanation: Sakura silently continuing to eat after the shock becomes merely eating too.

contexts.japanese: ショックで打ちひしがれた桜は、それきりモクモクと料理を口に運ぶだけになった。
contexts.english: Sakura was stunned, but she still ended up eating the food too.

findings.description: Dreaming inside a breeding box becomes dreaming about one.
findings.sourceReading: The opening says the subject dreams in a rearing/breeding box; page2 deliberately shifts to dreaming of the box.
findings.explanation: Dreaming inside a breeding box becomes dreaming about one.

contexts.japanese: 飼育箱で夢を見る。
contexts.english: I dream of a box for breeding bugs.

findings.description: Practice in darkness becomes blindfolded training.
findings.sourceReading: The dojo claims a Fuyuki-wide power outage and says tonight's practice will therefore be conducted in darkness.
findings.explanation: Practice in darkness becomes blindfolded training.

contexts.japanese: 今夜は冬木市一帯が停電の為、闇稽古とあいなりました。
contexts.english: Due to the blackout across Fuyuki City, tonight will be blindfolded training.

findings.description: “Lady” removes the familiar older-sister address from the strange voice’s reply. The abnormal delivery remains, but the childlike familiarity changes.
findings.sourceReading: The strange voice answers Taiga’s identification question affirmatively, addressing her with the childlike, familiar オネエチャン.
findings.explanation: “Lady” removes the familiar older-sister address from the strange voice’s reply. The abnormal delivery remains, but the childlike familiarity changes.

contexts.japanese: —ウン、ソウダヨオネエチャン。
contexts.english: YEAH, LADY. IT'S ME.

findings.description: Shirou's muscles locking when the man stands becomes admiration of firm, strong movement. Shirou still freezes later as the hand approaches his neck.
findings.sourceReading: The man's act of standing instantly makes Shirou's muscles lock. The following approach provokes an expectation of being killed.
findings.explanation: Shirou's muscles locking when the man stands becomes admiration of firm, strong movement. Shirou still freezes later as the hand approaches his neck.

contexts.japanese: その動作だけで、筋肉という筋肉が硬直した。
contexts.english: are firm and strong.

contexts.japanese: 瞬間。
contexts.english: Just from a glance, I can tell that his movements

findings.description: Shirou accepting he will be killed becomes feeling he must fight for his life.
findings.sourceReading: Despite the man's ordinary approach, Shirou inexplicably resigns himself to being killed there.
findings.explanation: Shirou accepting he will be killed becomes feeling he must fight for his life.

contexts.japanese: それだけだというのに、何故—俺はこの男に、ここで殺されると覚悟したのか。
contexts.english: But then...why do I feel like I'm about to fight for my life?

findings.description: Shirou saying he would not visit Kirei even if asked becomes rejecting Kirei's stated reasons.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says he came solely with a question and otherwise would not come to Kirei's place even if someone begged him.
findings.explanation: Shirou saying he would not visit Kirei even if asked becomes rejecting Kirei's stated reasons.

contexts.japanese: 「—そんな訳ないだろ。単に聞きたい事があるから来ただけだ。そうでもなけりゃ、頼まれたっておまえの所になんて来るもんか」
contexts.english: "I don't intend to. I'm just here to ask you a question. Like I'd come just for the reasons you gave."

findings.description: Crawling fugitives become petitioners shot after turning their backs.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu made pleading Masters crawl, then put a gun to the skulls of those trying to flee and pulled the trigger.
findings.explanation: Crawling fugitives become petitioners shot after turning their backs.

contexts.japanese: ヤツは的確であり、周到であり、蛮勇であり、無情だった。敵にかける情けなどない。殺すと決めればただ殺した。サーヴァントを屠り、助けを請うマスターを這わせ、逃げようとする頭蓋に銃口を当てて引き金を引いた。殺した後の感慨もない。強さを誇る優越も、消えた弱者への罪悪もない」
contexts.english: He was precise, meticulous, predatory, and ruthless. He had no mercy for his enemies. Once he decided to kill someone, they would die. He butchered Servants and allowed their Masters to beg for their lives only to pull the trigger once their backs were turned. He felt nothing after each kill. He felt neither pride in his own dominance nor guilt for the fallen."

findings.description: Refusing a separate killer persona becomes adopting one.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says Kiritsugu could easily have prepared a separate 'cold-blooded' personality, but likely believed such a person could neither reach nor deserve the Grail.
findings.explanation: Refusing a separate killer persona becomes adopting one.

contexts.japanese: “冷徹である”という異なる人格さえ用意すれば容易いものを、そんな人間では聖杯に届かない、届く価値がないと信じたのだろう」
contexts.english: One so easily changed by magical suggestion or merely hardening their heart would not have been worthy of obtaining the grail. That must have been his belief. So he adopted the identity of a killer through and through.

findings.description: Shirou's two extremes and ordinary wounded human become avoidance versus embracing humanity.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou asks whether Kirei is different: neither one who suffers no wounds nor one who has nothing but wounds, but an ordinary human who is wounded when cut; is priesthood the difference from Kiritsugu?
findings.explanation: Shirou's two extremes and ordinary wounded human become avoidance versus embracing humanity.

contexts.japanese: 「……じゃあ、アンタは違うのか。傷を負わないのでもなく、傷しかないのでもない。斬られれば傷を負う、まっとうな人間だって。アンタは神父だから、そこが切嗣とは違うと……？」
contexts.english: "...And you're different? He was someone who avoided getting hurt. While you say you were hurt, as you took a path embracing humanity. Being a priest made you different from Kiritsugu...?"

findings.description: A childish wish becomes a wish held since childhood.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei calls Shirou and Kiritsugu people who retain an immature or childlike wish.
findings.explanation: A childish wish becomes a wish held since childhood.

contexts.japanese: 「幼いままの願望を持つもの。
contexts.english: "You've wished for something from an early age.

findings.description: Turning comedy into tragedy becomes substituting ugliness with either comedy or tragedy.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says humans forget even their own ugliness and replace comedy with tragedy; over time an evil-buried hero is recast as a victim.
findings.explanation: Turning comedy into tragedy becomes substituting ugliness with either comedy or tragedy.

contexts.japanese: ……まあ、自らの醜ささえ忘れ喜劇を悲劇にすり替えるのが人間だ。悪として葬られた英雄も、時が経てば被害者として扱われ純粋悪ではなくなってしまう」
contexts.english: ...It is, well, human to forget our own ugliness and substitute it with comedy or tragedy. With time, even reviled heroes are eventually treated as victims, and cease to be seen as pure evil."

findings.description: Growth untouched by human hands becomes growth thanks only to human involvement.
findings.sourceReading: The paradoxical being is created by humans yet grows without any human hand entering or shaping the process.
findings.explanation: Growth untouched by human hands becomes growth thanks only to human involvement.

contexts.japanese: ……人が生み出したモノでありながら、決して人の手が混ざらず成長するモノ。その矛盾こそがあらゆる抑止の圧力を免除される“世界の敵”である」
contexts.english: ...They are something created by humans, and grow only thanks to human involvement. That contradiction is what exempts these enemies of the world from the corrective forces that would otherwise eliminate them."

findings.description: The rarity of pure Anti-Heroes becomes an exception from the preceding account.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei qualifies that there are scarcely any pure Anti-Heroes, then says such a thing does not exist and is only a human wish.
findings.explanation: The rarity of pure Anti-Heroes becomes an exception from the preceding account.

contexts.japanese: 「……もっとも、純粋な反英雄などそうはいない。
contexts.english: "...Of course, this does not apply to pure Anti-Heroes.

findings.description: Changing one's decision for a belief becomes willing oneself into personal change.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says he could not, as Kiritsugu could, change his will or decision for the sake of what he believed.
findings.explanation: Changing one's decision for a belief becomes willing oneself into personal change.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。私は衛宮切嗣のように、信じる物の為に意思を変える、などという事はできなかった。まあ目的が違うのだから比べるべくもないのだが」
contexts.english: "Well, unlike Kiritsugu, I could never do anything like will myself into changing for something I believe in. Though our objectives were different, so you can hardly compare us."

findings.description: Kirei's fury becomes Kiritsugu's fury.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says that if there was a moment when he felt fury toward Kiritsugu, it was precisely when Kiritsugu betrayed himself at the end.
findings.explanation: Kirei's fury becomes Kiritsugu's fury.

contexts.japanese: ……ヤツに憤怒を覚えたといえば、まさしくあの瞬間だったろう。
contexts.english: He must have been so enraged in that moment.

findings.description: Kirei's dismissal of racial classification becomes praise for excellence surviving mixed ancestry, adding an ancestry claim and reversing the force of his qualification.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says racial classification would be ridiculous if the Tohsakas' grandmaster is as reported. The passage identifies a grandmaster relationship, not biological descent from him.
findings.explanation: Kirei's dismissal of racial classification becomes praise for excellence surviving mixed ancestry, adding an ancestry claim and reversing the force of his qualification.

contexts.japanese: 始まりの御三家、私やおまえでは太刀打ちできぬ歴史と血筋を誇る者たちがそれだ。この中で土着の者は遠坂だけだが、遠坂とて大師父はかの時の翁だ。尤も、遠坂の大師父が伝え聞く通りの人物ならば、人種分けなど滑稽だが」
contexts.english: The three founding families boast history and bloodlines the likes of which you and I can only dream of. Of them only the Tohsakas are natives of this land, but their grandmaster is the famed Schweinorg. If he is truly as capable as the stories say, then it is little wonder that their excellence has persisted in spite of mixed ancestry."

findings.description: A millennium without branches or intermarriage becomes only an unfragmented bloodline.
findings.sourceReading: Few lineages last a thousand years without creating branch houses and without mixing with outsiders.
findings.explanation: A millennium without branches or intermarriage becomes only an unfragmented bloodline.

contexts.japanese: 「……といっても、もともとこの聖杯はアインツベルンが考案したものだ。彼の一族の歴史は一千年。分家も持たず、他と交わらずに一千の年月を重ねた家系は少ない」
contexts.english: "...That said, the Einzberns originally conceived this Holy Grail. They have a thousand years of history. Few mage lineages have persisted for a millennium without fragmenting their bloodlines."

findings.description: A collective will that normally fades within a decade becomes a goal forgotten decades after inception.
findings.sourceReading: Even a group's will is forgotten and worn away on a scale of ten years; Einzbern repeated that span many times without once straying.
findings.explanation: A collective will that normally fades within a decade becomes a goal forgotten decades after inception.

contexts.japanese: 「故にアインツベルンの魔術師は魔の領域さえ突破している。十年単位ですら忘却され消耗する集団の意思を、その何倍も繰り返したあげくただの一度も道を誤らなかった怪物ども。
contexts.english: "The Einzbern mages have gone beyond the realm of mere evil. Over the centuries, those monsters have never once strayed from their dogged pursuit of a shared goal that was forgotten only decades from its inception.

findings.description: Sakura seeming strange two days ago becomes looking strange throughout the last two days.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou recalls that Sakura also seemed odd two days earlier.
findings.explanation: Sakura seeming strange two days ago becomes looking strange throughout the last two days.

contexts.japanese: 思えば二日前の桜も様子が変だった。
contexts.english: Come to think of it, Sakura has looked off for the last two days.

findings.description: Hesitation disappearing when Shirou nearly died becomes disappearing when he risked his life.
findings.sourceReading: In both patrol branches Shirou says his hesitation vanished when he was on the verge of death.
findings.explanation: Hesitation disappearing when Shirou nearly died becomes disappearing when he risked his life.

contexts.japanese: 躊躇いは死にかけた時に消えている。
contexts.english: Any hesitation disappeared the moment I risked my life.

contexts.japanese: 躊躇いは死にかけた時に消えている。
contexts.english: Any hesitation disappeared the moment I risked my life.

findings.description: A slow, lumbering target becomes a cautious target.
findings.sourceReading: Rider presses the attack as if cornering slow and heavy prey.
findings.explanation: A slow, lumbering target becomes a cautious target.

contexts.japanese: 敵は長い髪をなびかせ、鈍重な獲物を追い詰めるように畳み掛けてくる。
contexts.english: The enemy's long hair whips through the air, hounding her cautious prey.

findings.description: A treasure wasted on Shinji becomes Shinji himself being useless.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says Rider was wasted in Shinji's hands—宝の持ち腐れ, possession of a treasure one cannot use.
findings.explanation: A treasure wasted on Shinji becomes Shinji himself being useless.

contexts.japanese: 「そこまでだ。どうやらおまえでは宝の持ち腐れだったようじゃな、慎二」
contexts.english: "Enough. It seems you weren't useful after all, Shinji."

findings.description: Zouken's account of learning about the Grail and arranging his grandson's contract becomes an account centered on Shinji's actions. The preceding admission that Zouken selected him survives, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of Zouken's agency.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says he learned the Grail would appear and had his grandson contract in his place. He then addresses Shirou as someone belonging to a magical lineage.
findings.explanation: Zouken's account of learning about the Grail and arranging his grandson's contract becomes an account centered on Shinji's actions. The preceding admission that Zouken selected him survives, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of Zouken's agency.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯が現れると知り、ワシではなく孫にサーヴァントと契約させたのだ。おぬしとて魔道を究める血の末席。
contexts.english: When he learned of the Holy Grail, he—not I—made a contract with a Servant. Like you, he is the last of a line walking the ways of the wise.

findings.description: A change of Tohsaka family head becomes adoption of a daughter by Matou.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken recalls that leadership had passed from that man to the young girl; the split Japanese line completes 代替わりしたのであったな.
findings.explanation: A change of Tohsaka family head becomes adoption of a daughter by Matou.

contexts.japanese: おお、たしか彼奴から小娘に代替わりしたのであっ
contexts.english: Ah, yes. They let us adopt one of their

contexts.japanese: たな。
contexts.english: daughters, once.

findings.description: Uncertainty about Zouken's feelings toward the Tohsakas becomes amusement at their presumed feelings. This supplies a target for his laughter that the Japanese leaves open.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou cannot tell what feelings Zouken holds toward the Tohsaka family as Zouken laughs with apparent pleasure.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty about Zouken's feelings toward the Tohsakas becomes amusement at their presumed feelings. This supplies a target for his laughter that the Japanese leaves open.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の家にどんな感情を抱いているのか、間桐臓硯は愉快そうに哄笑する。
contexts.english: Zouken Matou laughs in amusement at whatever the Tohsaka family must be feeling.

findings.description: Not knowing that Matou practices magecraft becomes merely not being taught its arts.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken claims the sibling not chosen as heir does not even know that the Matou household belongs to the magical path.
findings.explanation: Not knowing that Matou practices magecraft becomes merely not being taught its arts.

contexts.japanese: 「慎二はマスターである以上、答えは明白であろう。後継者に選ばれなかった片割れは、間桐の家が魔道である事も知らぬわ。
contexts.english: "Shinji is the Master, so the conclusion is obvious. A sibling not even chosen as the heir would not be inducted into our arts.

findings.description: Shirou's cheeks loosening into a smile becomes his cheeks burning.
findings.sourceReading: Saber's indignant face is so fresh to Shirou that his expression involuntarily softens into another smile.
findings.explanation: Shirou's cheeks loosening into a smile becomes his cheeks burning.

contexts.japanese: そう抗議する顔すら新鮮で、つい頬が緩んでしまう。
contexts.english: Even her indignation is amusing, and my cheeks start burning.

findings.description: Saber jumping backward becomes flinching and taking one step.
findings.sourceReading: She springs backward with a sustained shuffling sound after Shirou calls her properly a girl.
findings.explanation: Saber jumping backward becomes flinching and taking one step.

contexts.japanese: ざざ、と後ろに跳び退くセイバー。
contexts.english: Saber flinches and takes a step back.

findings.description: Shirou's wish to make up for a leftovers lunch becomes an offer based on having leftovers available, changing why he insists on dinner.
findings.sourceReading: Because lunch was only leftovers, Shirou urges Saber to eat a proper evening meal before sleeping.
findings.explanation: Shirou's wish to make up for a leftovers lunch becomes an offer based on having leftovers available, changing why he insists on dinner.

contexts.japanese: 「魔力の温存は判ったよ。けど人間食事も大切だろ。昼は余りもので済ませちまったから、夕飯はちゃんと食べてくれ。寝るのはその後でいいじゃないか」
contexts.english: "I know you need to save energy, but meals are important, too. I still have some leftovers from lunch, so let me fix you dinner. You can go to bed after that."

findings.description: A cooking pot becomes a wok.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou chops daikon with comic force and throws it into a 鍋, the pot used for the dish.
findings.explanation: A cooking pot becomes a wok.

contexts.japanese: 大根をドッカドカにぶった斬って、ドバーっと鍋に投入する。
contexts.english: I start chopping daikon radishes and throw them into the wok.

findings.description: Shirou being unable to raise his cup becomes everyone refusing to drink.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou cannot bring himself to drink because even the sound of the teacup seems likely to echo; his hot green tea has gone cold.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unable to raise his cup becomes everyone refusing to drink.

contexts.japanese: お茶を飲もうにも湯飲みの音さえ響きそうで飲めず、熱い緑茶はとっくに冷めきっていた。
contexts.english: They don't even drink the tea to avoid making a sipping sound, leaving the hot tea to go cold.

findings.description: Bonito tataki becomes tuna.
findings.sourceReading: The first dish is a salad-style preparation of katsuo, skipjack bonito.
findings.explanation: Bonito tataki becomes tuna.

contexts.japanese: かつおのたたきサラダ風から始まって、ピリリと辛いねぎソースをかけた鶏肉揚げ、定番といわんばかりの肉じゃがと、トドメとばかりにえび天を筆頭に天ぷら各種を用意する。
contexts.english: The meal begins with a tuna tataki salad and fried chicken with a mildly spicy scallion sauce. It's followed by a somewhat standard main course of beef and potato stew, accompanied by an assortment of deep-fried tempura featuring fluffy shrimp.

findings.description: Sakura's claim that Shirou and Rin are unrelated becomes Rin being unrelated to both Sakura and Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura insists that Senpai and that person have nothing to do with each other, while she is the one who is here, repeating why in distress.
findings.explanation: Sakura's claim that Shirou and Rin are unrelated becomes Rin being unrelated to both Sakura and Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 「どうして、遠坂先輩がここに来るんですか。そんなのおかしいです。だってぜんぜん関係ない。ここにいるのはわたしで、先輩とあの人はぜんぜん関係ないのに、どうして」
contexts.english: "Why was she here? It's a little strange. She has nothing to do with us. Not me, or you, so why?"

findings.description: People with no recourse but to cling to the Grail become people close to it.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou concludes that people who can only cling to something like the Grail are the ones who become Masters.
findings.explanation: People with no recourse but to cling to the Grail become people close to it.

contexts.japanese: いや、もとより“聖杯”なんてものに縋るしかない人間がマスターになる。
contexts.english: In fact, people close to the grail itself are bound to become Masters.

findings.description: An obsession Shirou cannot contend with becomes one he cannot imagine.
findings.sourceReading: Einzbern's thousand-year fixation is not something Shirou can do anything about or stand against.
findings.explanation: An obsession Shirou cannot contend with becomes one he cannot imagine.

contexts.japanese: その執念は俺がどうこうできるものじゃない。
contexts.english: I can't even begin to imagine that level of obsession.

findings.description: A war likened to ordinary human life becomes something common within that same war.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says this killing contest is merely a common event and needs no special status, then calls it crystallized daily life and happiness.
findings.explanation: A war likened to ordinary human life becomes something common within that same war.

contexts.japanese: そう、特別視する必要などない。この戦いはよくある出来事にすぎないのだよ。
contexts.english: It isn't anything extraordinary. It's quite a common circumstance in this war, actually.

findings.description: Daily human activity and happiness become feats and blessings.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei calls the Grail War a crystallization of everyday human activity and people's happiness.
findings.explanation: Daily human activity and happiness become feats and blessings.

contexts.japanese: 日々の営み、人々の幸福が結晶化したものが聖杯戦争だ。参加する事、殺しあう事に罪悪などない」
contexts.english: The Holy Grail War is a crystallization of man's feats and blessings. One need not feel guilt in joining the war, nor killing over it."

findings.description: The Grail eliminating futile labor becomes shortening necessary effort.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail simply removes the accumulated futile labor that people call life.
findings.explanation: The Grail eliminating futile labor becomes shortening necessary effort.

contexts.japanese: —聖杯とは、単にその徒労を無くすだけのもの。
contexts.english: The Holy Grail simply abridges that necessary effort.

findings.description: Kirei admitting an unnecessary talk becomes saying he simply told Shirou not to worry.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says he spoke about something he need not have, and that adding doubt to one who came to dispel doubt would make him a failed priest.
findings.explanation: Kirei admitting an unnecessary talk becomes saying he simply told Shirou not to worry.

contexts.japanese: 「なに、しなくともよい話をしたからな。悩みを解きに来た者に、さらなる迷いを与えては神父失格だ」
contexts.english: "Oh, I simply told you not to worry. After all, I'd be a failure of a priest if I added to my flock's troubles, instead of lifting them away."

findings.description: Saber denying that Shirou's order was unreasonable becomes claiming she would never defy him.
findings.sourceReading: Saber begins to say she did not consider Shirou's instruction unreasonable.
findings.explanation: Saber denying that Shirou's order was unreasonable becomes claiming she would never defy him.

contexts.japanese: 「な、何を言うのです。私は別に、シロウの指示が無茶だとは思ってなど—」
contexts.english: "S-speak nothing of it! I would never defy your—"

findings.description: Saber looking nothing like her prior self becomes looking similar yet different.
findings.sourceReading: Her present indignant display is utterly unlike the gentle expression moments earlier, making Shirou smile.
findings.explanation: Saber looking nothing like her prior self becomes looking similar yet different.

contexts.japanese: そんな姿も、さっきまでの姿と似ても似つかなくて頬が緩んでしまう。
contexts.english: Her pouty face looks so similar yet different from the way she's been acting that I can't help but smile.

findings.description: Shirou's doubt about his own motives as a hero becomes doubt about the value of always doing right.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou wonders whether he is deeply distorted as a would-be hero, in light of the suggestion that this war fulfills his desire.
findings.explanation: Shirou's doubt about his own motives as a hero becomes doubt about the value of always doing right.

contexts.japanese: 正義の味方として、ひどく歪なのではないかと。
contexts.english: It made me wonder if always doing the right thing is actually a twisted way to live.

findings.description: A future identity as a champion of justice becomes habitual correct behavior.
findings.sourceReading: The fragment reasserts the vow: Shirou Emiya will become a champion of justice, for the sake of people unjustly killed.
findings.explanation: A future identity as a champion of justice becomes habitual correct behavior.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮士郎は正義の味方に。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya always does the right thing.

findings.description: Shirou's inability to make Saber dematerialize becomes his failure to learn to become a ghost.
findings.sourceReading: He understands that Servants can become spirit bodies, but unfortunately he cannot make or allow Saber to perform that feat.
findings.explanation: Shirou's inability to make Saber dematerialize becomes his failure to learn to become a ghost.

contexts.japanese: サーヴァントは霊体になれるらしいが、生憎俺にはそんな芸当はさせられない。
contexts.english: Apparently, Servants can turn into invisible ghosts, but alas, I never learned how do to that trick.

findings.description: The English substitutes a sense of Saber's reality for explicit awareness of her as a woman. The surrounding attraction remains, and this belongs in a dossier about Shirou's perception.
findings.sourceReading: The everyday reality of Saber's clothes makes Shirou involuntarily conscious of her as a woman.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a sense of Saber's reality for explicit awareness of her as a woman. The surrounding attraction remains, and this belongs in a dossier about Shirou's perception.

contexts.japanese: セイバーの服装はあまりにも現実感がありすぎて、否応なしに異性を意識してしまうのだ。
contexts.english: With Saber in that outfit, I can't help but actually think she's real now.

findings.description: Being cut becomes being cut in half.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou protests that Saber would have been cut if he had not intervened.
findings.explanation: Being cut becomes being cut in half.

contexts.japanese: 「な、なんだよそれ！　あの時はああでもしなけりゃおまえが斬られてたじゃないか！」
contexts.english: "Wh-what the hell! If I hadn't intervened, you'd have been cut in half!"

findings.description: Responding to Saber within Shirou's abilities becomes respecting her needs and actions.
findings.sourceReading: Because she cannot choose her Master, Shirou concludes he must answer or live up to Saber as far as he is able.
findings.explanation: Responding to Saber within Shirou's abilities becomes respecting her needs and actions.

contexts.japanese: なら俺は、自分に出来る範囲でセイバーに応えるしかない。
contexts.english: If it's true, I'll need to respect Saber's needs and actions as best I can.

findings.description: Weaponless people become innocent people.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says harming humans who bear no weapon violates a knight's oath.
findings.explanation: Weaponless people become innocent people.

contexts.japanese: 私は私が許す行為しか出来ない。自分を裏切る事は、私には不可能です。剣を持たぬ人間に傷を負わせる事など、騎士の誓いに反します」
contexts.english: I can only do things I allow myself to. It is impossible for me to betray my own beliefs. Harming unarmed innocents goes against a knight's oath."

findings.description: Kiritsugu's long inhalation becomes a contented sigh.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu says 'I see,' takes a long breath in, then says he is relieved.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's long inhalation becomes a contented sigh.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮切嗣はそうか、と長く息を吸って、
contexts.english: Kiritsugu made a long, contented sigh, and whispered,

findings.description: Shirou looking at his dead father becomes Kiritsugu looking at the moon.
findings.sourceReading: The child silently looks up at the winter moon and the man who had been his father, now entered into a long sleep.
findings.explanation: Shirou looking at his dead father becomes Kiritsugu looking at the moon.

contexts.japanese: 何をするでもなく、冬の月と、長い眠りに入った、父親だった人を見上げていた。
contexts.english: On a winter night, the man I called my father looked up at the moon and entered a long sleep.

findings.description: Molten lead poured into the stomach becomes hot lead forced down the throat.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou compares the churning inside his abdomen to having molten lead poured into his stomach.
findings.explanation: Molten lead poured into the stomach becomes hot lead forced down the throat.

contexts.japanese: 体は重いし、動く度に腹ん中がぐるんぐるんと回るよう。きっと胃に焼けた鉛を流し込んだら、こんな気分になるのではあるまいか。
contexts.english: My body feels sluggish, and my insides seem to churn whenever I move. I imagine this is about what it'd feel like if someone forced hot lead down my throat.

findings.description: Shirou's self-repair becomes Rin asking what she could have done.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says she can no longer perform the feat of reviving someone near death; Shirou himself somehow dealt with his scattered insides.
findings.explanation: Shirou's self-repair becomes Rin asking what she could have done.

contexts.japanese: 「まさか。死にかけてる人間を蘇生させる、なんて芸当は、もうわたしには出来ない。衛宮士郎は自分でぶっ飛んだ中身をどうにかしたのよ」
contexts.english: "No way. I can't revive someone on the verge of death. What was I supposed to do about your intestines scattered on the pavement?"

findings.description: Shirou's concern about taking something from Saber becomes generic help and excuse-making.
findings.sourceReading: He apologizes that when he gets hurt on his own, he receives or takes something from Saber.
findings.explanation: Shirou's concern about taking something from Saber becomes generic help and excuse-making.

contexts.japanese: 「分かってる。俺がかってにケガして、それでセイバーから何かを貰ってる、なんていうのは申し訳ない」
contexts.english: "I know. Saber had to help me because I went and got myself hurt. I don't have any excuses for that."

findings.description: Suicide as an apparent cause of death becomes natural causes.
findings.sourceReading: Deaths caused by an invisible killer would be treated only as accidents or suicides.
findings.explanation: Suicide as an apparent cause of death becomes natural causes.

contexts.japanese: 姿のない殺戮者に襲われた人間の死は、事故死か自殺としか扱われまい。
contexts.english: When people die to an invisible killer, those deaths will just be treated as accidents or natural causes.

findings.description: Berserker's standing among summoned Servants becomes standing among every legendary hero.
findings.sourceReading: Rin thinks no one in the history of Servants likely equals Berserker in close combat.
findings.explanation: Berserker's standing among summoned Servants becomes standing among every legendary hero.

contexts.japanese: 「正面からじゃ勝てないでしょうね。白兵戦ならアレは最強のサーヴァントよ。きっと歴代のサーヴァントの中でも、アレと並ぶヤツはいないと思う。わたしもバーサーカーに襲われたら逃げ延びる手段はないわ」
contexts.english: "Not in a straight-up fight. That's the ultimate close-quarters Servant. There probably isn't anyone who can match it even among all the heroes of myth and legend. If Berserker attacks me, there's no escape."

findings.description: Archer's expected half-capacity during recovery becomes only Rin remaining in the fight.
findings.sourceReading: Although full recovery will take time, Rin expects Archer can still perform at roughly half-fledged capacity.
findings.explanation: Archer's expected half-capacity during recovery becomes only Rin remaining in the fight.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。わたしのアーチャーは致命傷を受けて目下治療中。完全に回復するまで時間がかかるけど、それでも半人前ぐらいの活躍はできる筈よ。
contexts.english: "Yeah. My Archer's still recovering from a serious wound. That's going to take some time, but in the meantime, I'm not completely out of the fight.

findings.description: The Shirou–Saber team being half-fledged becomes Saber herself half as effective.
findings.sourceReading: Saber is faultless, but her Master drags the side down, leaving their unit half-fledged.
findings.explanation: The Shirou–Saber team being half-fledged becomes Saber herself half as effective.

contexts.japanese: で、そっちはサーヴァントは申し分ないけど、マスターが足ひっぱってやっぱり半人前。ほら、合わせれば丁度いいわ」
contexts.english: And while your Servant is superb, her Master's dragging her down, making her half as effective. See? Put the two of us together and you've got a whole."

findings.description: Archer's defeat becomes merely being hurt.
findings.sourceReading: Rin offers to wipe the slate clean over Archer having been defeated and to teach Shirou Master knowledge.
findings.explanation: Archer's defeat becomes merely being hurt.

contexts.japanese: 「同盟の代価ぐらいは払うわ。アーチャーを倒されたコトはチャラにしてあげて、マスターとしての知識も教えてあげる。ああ、あと暇があれば衛宮くんの魔術の腕を見てあげてもいいけど、どう？」
contexts.english: "I'll make it worth your while. I'll let you off for getting Archer hurt, and teach you what you need to know to be a Master. Oh, and if we have time, I can even give you some pointers on your magecraft. Deal?"

findings.description: Shirou's exhalation becomes a deep inhalation.
findings.sourceReading: Recognizing the time, Shirou lets out a breath and opens his eyes.
findings.explanation: Shirou's exhalation becomes a deep inhalation.

contexts.japanese: ほう、と息をついて目蓋を開けた。
contexts.english: I take a deep breath and open my eyes.

findings.description: Sakura's acknowledgment of Shirou's trouble becomes approval of his idea.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura accepts the breakfast request and politely acknowledges the trouble or effort involved in waking Taiga.
findings.explanation: Sakura's acknowledgment of Shirou's trouble becomes approval of his idea.

contexts.japanese: 「あ、はい。ごくろうさまです、先輩」
contexts.english: "Oh, okay. Good idea, Senpai."

findings.description: Illya running to the shed while shouting becomes stomping toward it.
findings.sourceReading: Still shouting at Sakura, Illya runs toward the shed.
findings.explanation: Illya running to the shed while shouting becomes stomping toward it.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは怒鳴りながら土蔵へ走っていく。
contexts.english: Illya fumes at Sakura as she stomps over to the shed.

findings.description: Dislike from the children around Illya becomes rejection by everyone.
findings.sourceReading: Taiga warns that being strict about money from a young age will make the other children around Illya dislike her.
findings.explanation: Dislike from the children around Illya becomes rejection by everyone.

contexts.japanese: 若い頃からお金にうるさいとまわりの子に嫌われちゃうぞー」
contexts.english: Nobody will like you if you're so stingy at such a young age."

findings.description: People Illya likes become a singular person she likes.
findings.sourceReading: Illya does not care what anyone other than the people she likes thinks of her.
findings.explanation: People Illya likes become a singular person she likes.

contexts.japanese: 「嫌われて結構よ。好きな人以外なら何を思われても関係ないもの。それよりタイガ、貸したお金ちゃんと返してよね。給料日、五日前だったんでしょ」
contexts.english: "That's okay. As long as the person I like doesn't think like that, I don't care what anyone else thinks. Oh, by the way, Taiga, I want the money you borrowed the other day back. It was payday five days ago, right?"

findings.description: Payroll details become details of a conversation.
findings.sourceReading: After citing Raiga as the source of Taiga's payday information, Illya offers to recite the itemized details.
findings.explanation: Payroll details become details of a conversation.

contexts.japanese: 「ライガに聞いたわ。お望みなら明細まで話してあげてよ」
contexts.english: "Raiga told me. I can give you the details of the conversation if you like."

findings.description: Becoming a child of Shirou's household becomes merely living there.
findings.sourceReading: Sulking, Taiga says Illya might as well become a child of this household.
findings.explanation: Becoming a child of Shirou's household becomes merely living there.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふん。いっそのコトここの子になっちゃえ、ばか」
contexts.english: "Hmph. She might as well just live in this house, for all I care...dummy."

findings.description: The school's entrance ceremony becomes schools generally starting a new year.
findings.sourceReading: On April seventh, Shirou's school is holding its entrance ceremony as the season turns to spring.
findings.explanation: The school's entrance ceremony becomes schools generally starting a new year.

contexts.japanese: 学校では入学式があって、季節は寒い冬を越えて春になっている。
contexts.english: Schools are starting the new school year, and the season has gone from the cold of winter to spring.

findings.explanation: The single circuit's poker-like, intangible form becomes a series of metal rods. The English retains qualified invisibility, so the problem is added multiplicity and concreteness rather than straightforward visibility.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page4:1

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page5:1

contexts.english: This is not a metaphor.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page5:1
contexts.japanese: 実際、衛宮士郎の背骨には、目に見えず手に触れられない“火箸に似たモノ”が、ズブズブと差し込まれている。

findings.description: Taking a chance with one's remaining aptitude becomes simply acquiring ability.

findings.explanation: Taking a chance with one's remaining aptitude becomes simply acquiring ability.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page12:1
contexts.japanese: で、そうなるとあとはもう出たトコ勝負。
contexts.english: It's just a matter of gaining the ability.

findings.description: Just under an hour becomes a little over an hour.
findings.sourceReading: Reestablishing the connection and making one pseudo-nerve takes slightly less than one hour.
findings.explanation: Just under an hour becomes a little over an hour.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page25:1
contexts.japanese: ……ここまでで、一時間弱。
contexts.english: I've been working on this for a little over an hour.

findings.explanation: A dozens-fold archery comparison becomes exactly tenfold.

contexts.english: This may be easy for a skilled mage, but since I have a hard time generating magical energy in the first place, even a task like this is as difficult as shooting an arrow and hitting a target several hundred meters from you.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page31:1

contexts.english: A typical archery target is twenty-eight meters away.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page31:1
contexts.japanese: その何十倍という難易度と言えば、それがどのくらい困難であるかは言うまでもない—
contexts.english: So it goes without saying how hard it would be to hit a target at ten times that distance.

findings.description: Shirou folding his body forward becomes his back arching.

findings.explanation: Shirou folding his body forward becomes his back arching.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page33:1
contexts.japanese: そのまま気を失いかねない目眩に、体をくの字に曲げて耐えた。
contexts.english: My back arches in an effort to keep me from passing out.

findings.description: Kiritsugu's sadness about accepting death becomes opposition to all magecraft involvement.

findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's sadness about accepting death becomes opposition to all magecraft involvement.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page42:1
contexts.japanese: —切嗣はそれを悲しげに言っていた。
contexts.english: Kiritsugu always looked sad whenever he brought that up.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page42:1
contexts.japanese: それは、俺にはそんな覚悟なんてしないでほしい、という意味だったのかもしれない。
contexts.english: Maybe it was his way of saying that he didn't want me getting into any of this.

findings.description: Doing everything possible toward an undefined ideal narrows into magical training.
findings.sourceReading: Because succession to Kiritsugu is fixed in his mind, Shirou has done whatever he can despite immaturity; since he does not know what a hero of justice is, he can now approach it only through acts useful to others within his reach.
findings.explanation: Doing everything possible toward an undefined ideal narrows into magical training.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page47:1
contexts.japanese: だから未熟なままでも、出来るかぎりの事をしてきた。
contexts.english: That's why I've been doing everything I can despite how sorely I lack in experience.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page47:1
contexts.japanese: 正義の味方っていうのが何者なのかは分からない。
contexts.english: I don't know exactly what it means to be a hero of justice.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page47:1

contexts.english: But because I don't know, I've trained myself to the best of my abilities in hopes I'll be useful to somebody.

findings.description: An unresolved way of becoming the different thing becomes an intellectual task of distinguishing two labels.

findings.explanation: An unresolved way of becoming the different thing becomes an intellectual task of distinguishing two labels.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page49:1
contexts.japanese: 人助けと正義の味方っていうのは違うと思う。
contexts.english: Saving someone and being a hero of justice are two different things.

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page49:1
contexts.japanese: それが分かっているのに、どうすれば違ったモノになれるのか、と。
contexts.english: I know that. But what do I have to do to differentiate them?

contexts.ref: セイバールート一日目-15:page49:1
contexts.japanese: その肝心な部分が、この五年間、ずっと掴めないままだった。
contexts.english: I've yet to understand that crucial concept for the past five years.

findings.description: Losing five hundred while trying to save a thousand becomes overlooking them.

findings.explanation: Losing five hundred while trying to save a thousand becomes overlooking them.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page5:1
contexts.japanese: 千を得ようとして五百をこぼすのなら。
contexts.english: If in the process of trying to save a thousand, you overlook five hundred...

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page5:1
contexts.japanese: 百を見捨てて、九百を生かしきろう。
contexts.english: ...then I will abandon one hundred to save nine hundred.

findings.description: The definition of a hero changes from attempting an unattainable ideal to being capable of performing miracles.

findings.explanation: The definition of a hero changes from attempting an unattainable ideal to being capable of performing miracles.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page7:1

contexts.english: Because that's what a hero of justice was: someone who could still perform miracles, no matter how idealistic or unattainable they may be.

findings.description: Kiritsugu's unfinished contrast is completed into a hierarchy that contradicts his first clause.

findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's unfinished contrast is completed into a hierarchy that contradicts his first clause.

findings.explanation: The English keeps the joke about excessive composure but removes Taiga's reference to indulging her own tastes. Her implied credit for Shirou's temperament becomes criticism of his excess.

contexts.english: "Of course. Even from my point of view, Shirou is really composed. So much so, he might be overdoing it."

findings.explanation: Ten tiles become ten stacks of tiles, enlarging Rin's comic threat. The sarcastic delight and playful pressure on Shirou remain.

findings.explanation: Rin denying enjoyment becomes denying that she is joking.

contexts.japanese: ああ、誤解なんてしないって。
contexts.english: Yeah, there's no misunderstanding here.

contexts.ref: セイバールート七日目-00:page57:1

contexts.english: She's enjoying this.
